195000.description:
Hayakawa and Konno go on a drive date. Where are they going...?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Originally published as an applicant-only bonus booklet during the release of Hishakai Shindo Volumes 1 and 2. It was then digitally released on November 1, 2019.
synonyms: 行きたい場所　【被写界深度 応募者限定小冊子2018】
Ikitai Basho [Hishakai Shindo Oubosha Gentei Shousasshi 2018]
The place where I want to go

195001.description:
Banxia, the legitimate daughter of the Marquis, was murdered by her stepsister and her beloved Crown Prince. When she woke up again, she was reborn a few days before returning to the capital. With the memories of her past life, she tore apart the facade of her wicked stepsister and hypocritical stepmother. People called her “stupid”? Fine. Then she would let everyone know that she would get back at those who had messed with her.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 腹黒太子様にはもう騙されない

195002.description: Collection of old horror manga by Miu.

title.native: 美羽のちょっと怖い話

195003.description:
1. Chihiro no Oshiro (ちひろのお城)
2. Ichijiku no Koi (いちじくの恋)
3. Namida Dechau (涙がでちゃう)
4. Bayer no Shirabe (バイエルの調べ)
5. Onikai wa Shinsatsushitsu (お二階は診察室)

title.native: 千明初美作品集「ちひろのお城」
title.romaji: Chigara Hatsumi Sakuhinshuu: Chihiro no Oshiro

195004.description: A young man's introspection on love and life experience.

195005.description:
The definitive 400 pages collection of Bonten Taro's legendary showa tatoo dramas, collecting stories from the late 60s/early 70s

Note: This collection was the result of a successful crowdfunding campaign that closed December 13th 2024

title.native: うっかり油断したねゆずちゃん
私も名前で呼ばれたい

195008.description:
Ziye Zhao, who has lost his will to live and was forced to play a terrifying "Nightmare Game". If Ziye wants to continue living, he needs to emerge victorious from each and every twisted round. Is it possible for him to find out what the nightmare that lies between life and death is all about?

(Source: INKR)

195009.description:
The rich boy You Gan encounters a strange black rain, which instantly turns all of his 200 servants into monsters and thrusts the whole planet in unprecedented danger. Food is scarce, rescue is not in sight and money has gone from his hands… But You Gan finds an exclusive virtual shop and is using it to face the apocalypse head on. Now he is buying like a madman to return the world to its former glory!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Strongest Trader on the Surface

title.native: タイガーマスク ザ・スター

195011.description: After graduating from Tracy University, she opened a pet shop. With her loving nature, she was passionate about rescuing various pets and strange animals, and she also had a boyfriend whom she deeply loved. However, her beloved puppy didn’t like him and always bared its teeth at him. One day, her peaceful life was disrupted when a strange black-clad customer came into the store. He demanded information about a monster he had brought with him, but the pet dog in her shop suddenly spoke, saying, “Danger! From hell!”

title.native: 女神の不思議なペットショップ

195013.description:
I’m a middle-aged man on the inside, but I look like a high school girl on the outside!? I swear I’ll take my own body back!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Changed Into A High School Girl
title.native: 女子高生に着替えたら

195014.description:
Princess Shina was sentenced for treason and offered as a sacrifice to be fed to the evil dragon. But when she was thrown into the dragon's lair, no evil dragon was to be found—only a barely conscious, naked, dark-skinned man lying there instead.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Sacrificial Bride Abducted the Evil Dragon!

title.native: 祭品新娘把恶龙拐跑啦！
title.romaji: Jipin Xinniang Ba Wu Long Guai Pao La

195015.description:
During a divine item bestowal ceremony, Bale’s memories of a past life resurface, and he realizes he’s been reborn into a video game he once played! After being kicked out of his household, he heads to a secret dungeon, wielding the "Dragontree Sword"—an item packed with farming buffs! What follows is the start of a new chapter in Bale’s life, filled with easygoing farming and cute girls!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)

title.english: Dungeon Farm: Kicked Out of My Home, So I'm Homesteading in a Dungeon!
title.native: ダンジョン・ファーム～家を追い出されたので、ダンジョンに農場をつくって暮らそうと思います～
title.romaji: Dungeon Farm: Ie wo Oidasareta node, Dungeon ni Noujou wo Tsukutte Kurasou to Omoimasu

195016.description:
Himori Mikoto was born on the small remote island of Himonjima as the heir to a shrine. On this island, it was said that if one enters the forbidden area, they will be cursed by the immortal princess. One day, Mikoto is forced to step into the forbidden forest, and an unprecedented earthquake occurs, resurrecting the curse of the immortal princess... Mikoto, who possesses a special power, will save the world with her own "body."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 女王の烙印〜滅びの国の夜伽巫女〜
title.romaji: Joou no Rakuin: Horobi no Kuni no Yotogi Miko

195018.description:
After getting dumped by her boyfriend and falling into a lazy slump, Honoka ends up moving in with her childhood friend, Ao. She had always thought of him as a little brother, but reuniting after 13 years, she realizes he’s grown into a gorgeous, flawless guy who even handles the housework!
Just as she thinks their new life together will be smooth sailing, Honoka discovers that Ao has a hidden side...

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

title.native: うらはらエメラルドにご用心

195019.description:
Gyu-Ha, who had a hard time getting Tae-Oh, whom he had a crush on in high school, to date. The two dated for 10 years without any major problems. Until Tae-Oh got into an accident. Tae-Oh collapsed in a building fire and strangely lost all of his memories of Gyu-Ha. Instead of his old, affectionate self, he returned to his usual, annoying self. Will Gyu-Ha be able to get Tae-Oh back?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the Geogeoikseon: Heavenly Original Webtoon Danpyeonseon (거거익선~헤븐리 오리지널 웹툰 단편선~) Collection.
synonyms: プラスチック・ラブ～再び輝く俺達の恋愛～

title.romaji: Kimi wa Boku no Risou no Kareshi
Kimi wa Boku no Risou no Kareshi

195022.description:
Noah, who fell in love with the older twin brother, Louis, and moved into the house where the two brothers lived. Until then, Noah got drunk and slept with Lucas instead of Louis. Feeling threatened, persuaded, and secretly attracted to Lucas, Noah ended up spending the night with Lucas for about three months without Louis knowing. The relationship between the three of them, which had been peaceful, changes one day when Louis sees the two of them...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the Geogeoikseon: Heavenly Original Webtoon Danpyeonseon (거거익선~헤븐리 오리지널 웹툰 단편선~) Collection.

195024.description:
Ui-Seong feels more than just a friend to his long-time pen pal. Then, Seok-Won, who he broke up with when he was graduating from high school due to studying abroad, appears. The two meet again at a school reunion just like in a novel and crave each other, while Hee-Seong is troubled between his past lover and his pen pal…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the Geogeoikseon: Heavenly Original Webtoon Danpyeonseon (거거익선~헤븐리 오리지널 웹툰 단편선~) Collection.

title.native: Hな風習がある我が家の、エロすぎる日常。
title.romaji: H na Fuushuu ga Aru Wagaya no, Erosugiru Nichijou

title.native: 深青さん、今日もズルいです！

195027.description:
Joshua, who was backstabbed in-game, transmigrated into a world filled with swords and magic after he died, and that world was based on the game he was currently playing. Based on his in-game experience as well as depending on an innate System, Joshua fought against a rebellion, took in female servants, acquired divine weapons, and became the Territory Lord of the Empire’s Northern Lands in one go. However, his actual challenge—which included the mysterious Dark Tide in the northern Black Forest, various bloodthirsty monsters, and the chaotic forces behind all this—had yet to begin. What would Joshua do?

(Source: Webnovel)

195028.description:
Since then, he's been entangled by her charms...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2017-09

title.native: ひとりじめゲラッシーズ

195030.description:
Leo is a photographer who moved to Tokyo from the countryside to become a landscape photographer, but things didn't go so well, so he makes a living by taking photos for catalogs in gossip magazines and taking candid photos of celebrities in scandals.

One day, after being rejected by the editorial department of a magazine, he is walking along the riverside while drinking to drown his sorrows, when a girl in a dress floats by...

A romantic love story between a count's daughter who was chased out of her family home and a down-and-out photographer who should never have met.

(Source: Comic Ride, translated)

title.native: レンズ越し、たった一度の恋をする～失踪令嬢とカメラマン～
title.romaji: Lens Goshi, Tatta Ichido no Koi wo Suru: Shissou Reijou to Cameraman

title.native: 淫魔ちゃんはいつでも腹ペコ
好き好き大好き超×2愛してる

195035.description:
High school students Nia Shinoda and Ibuki Oohashi have been childhood friends since elementary school. Living together in the same dorm room, Nia worries about Ibuki, who’s single-mindedly focused on kendo and a bit muscle-brained. One day, Nia discovers Ibuki posing as a drawing model in the art room—and can't get the image of his body out of his mind. He touches Ibuki’s nipples a few times in a playful mood, and after a while, Ibuki, worried that his nipples feels strange, asks if he might be sick. Nia, being mischievous, tells him he needs to train it—leading Ibuki to believe him and ask for his help in training it…!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I want to hug your boobs

195036.description: Note: Includes the one shot "Sakura-kun no Hatsukoi wa Natsuiro ni Saku (さくらくんの初恋は夏色に咲く)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: Please show me everything about you.

title.native: ナカから全部教えてよ
日々は過ぎれど飯うまし

195038.description:
Perhaps, this is a surer thing than memory could hope to be.

(Source: Official Site)
synonyms: 暮歳閑談：映画を撮ろうか

title.english: Sui's Daily Slices: Wanna Shoot a Picture?

195039.description:
Behind the curtain, beyond the applause, the crimson stage of death is now in full readiness.

(Source: Official Site)
synonyms: 序言組曲：クリムゾンソリティア

title.native: 食べちゃだめなのにおいしいです

195041.description:
Someone in this family is a killer--Ryou Azuki's manga adaptation of the best-selling novel Yurigokoro, originally written by Mahokaru Numata.

The day Ryousuke brings his fiancée Chie home to have a happy dinner with his family signals the beginning of their misfortunes. One day, he finds a notebook containing the confessions of killer in a closet in his family's house. Who wrote this diary? As he keeps on reading, the truth he arrives at is...

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

195042.description: Amir Waker is an archer who’s been banished from an S-Rank party "The Band of Prodigies", which mainly consisted of nobles. He then falsified his identity and registered himself as an F-Rank adventurer. He took an escort quest to the countryside. The quest was supposed to be an easy task for him as a former S-Rank. But surprisingly, the client of this quest is none other than the 3rd princess who’s being targeted for some certain reasons! Will Amir be able to escort the princess safely from the "strongest" knight’s division of the kingdom? Amir is thus dragged into the political struggles and conflicts of the kingdom.

title.native: 日陰のアミル　追放されて無双する最強弓使い
title.romaji: Hikage no Amir: Tsuihou sarete Musou suru Saikyou Yumizukai

195043.description:
"I won't date anyone until I make it."

Gerald started work as the assistant to one of the most successful adult webtoon artists. He doesn't want to date anyone, but women keep throwing themselves at him!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.native: ネバーランドと渡り鳥

195045.description:
Nine years with my girlfriend and counting... (?) Is she the one for me? Or...

(Source: Toomics)

synonyms: I can't be the protagonist but,

title.native: 主人公にはなれないけど

195047.description:
When his only younger brother Yoji succumbs to heatstroke, Shuichi is forced to confront the complex feelings of inadequacy he's always harbored toward his talented sibling. Through the simple act of cutting grass, unfolds a tale of family, regret, and redemption.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: My Brother Died and Now the Grass is Overgrown

195048.description:
We were introverts while they were extroverts. We thought our paths would never cross. That was until my friend Kobayan made a desperate confession of love to one of the extroverts he had never even spoken to before…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195049.description:
"Witches" - mysterious beings that have existed since before recorded history. Hasumi, a researcher of witches, struggles to connect with his son Sayaka. But when Sayaka encounters a powerless witch, everything changes…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ボーイ・ミーツ・ウィッチ

195050.description:
Although it is a supernatural show, there is my Prince Charming, Fan Chuan! Go on, don't be afraid the ghost! But - why do I be in a group with a man called Huang Yexue?! What's the meaning of my life if not being close to my Prince Charming! And... There really are ghosts!" - From the spiritual girl Xia Xiaoman's wailing!!

(Source: WebComics)

195051.description:
Ahn Jae-Ha was never going to be a shaman. Not in this life. He drank, he fucked, he sinned—anything to reject a divine being his family had served for generations. But the divine being came anyway. Now Jae-Ha can’t get him out of his head. Or his body. “You’ll come to need me,” he said. And Jae-Ha can already feel the craving setting in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195052.description: An Suha and Chanyeong have been friends since childhood. However, An Suha's feelings have long transitioned from their simple platonic friendship. An Suha feels an immense attraction to Chanyeong's hands and, as an adult he's reached a point where he has been secretly pleasuring himself using Chanyeong's hands while he sleeps.

195053.description:
Sana Jumonji is addicted to the popular game "Magic Magic." However, ever since she discovered that her favorite character is the same as her friend's, she has been unable to admit that she likes her favorite character. Then, one day, she meets Nagumo Sora, a bishoujo game otaku who talks passionately about "moe"...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime August 2025 issue.

195054.description:
No matter how hard 26-year-old virgin Rin Kagaya works on herself, her dates never seem to end in lasting relationships. In the wake of her latest failed relationship, she heads to work and gets handed a new trainee to look after Yamato Tachibana. He's got stunning looks, flawless style, and a cute personality to boot. The perfect recipe to heal Rin's broken heart. But he has a secret...

Now Rin goes home every night and gets herself off to thoughts of her new trainee, but... how did he find out?! As he takes her for himself, his tongue teases her throbbing, sopping loins. His merciless obsession making Rin surrender herself to pleasure.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Cute, Naughty Rin: Surrendering to Her Obsessed Trainee Next Door
title.native: やらしくて可愛い俺の凛ちゃん。～隣人後輩くんのイキすぎた執着にハメ堕とされる～
title.romaji: Yarashikute Kawaii Ore no Rin-chan.: Rinjin Kouhai-kun no Iki Sugita Shuuchaku ni Hameta to Sareru

195055.description:
A world where humans and beastmen coexist. The 20-year-old white tiger beastman Tae-Hyung meets Ji-Soo, a famous person in school and a giant rabbit senior, at a freshman orientation and falls in love at first sight. He gets drunk and his heart races. While he is in a daze and commits various bizarre acts and builds up his dark history, "Do you have white pubic hair too?"

Can I really like this senior?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: Planting a Flag on the Head of the Tiger on Mt. Baekdu

title.native: 백두산 호랑이 머리 위에 깃발 꽂기
title.romaji: Baekdusan Horangi Meori Wie Gitbal Kkotgi

195056.description:
Grace Gurton has her eyes on Richard Spencer, captain of the rugby team. Despite his narcissism, she can't help but pine for him. Then one day, Grace gets an unexpected adoption offer from Richard's aunt, Mary Montague. Can Grace navigate her feelings for Richard now that she’s part of the family?

(Source: Manta)

195057.description:
Doggy-younger man Nam-Hyeok X Grumpy older man Ho-Su.

Ho-Su, a returning student who had always been lucky no matter what he did, ends up spending a night with Nam-Hyeok, a freshman he met at a drinking party, while drunk. However, he was only satisfied with the amazing relationship for a moment, and when a shining pattern appeared on Ho-Su's stomach, Nam-Hyeok screamed as if he fainted...

"I, I think I accidentally put a curse on my senior!"

It was shocking that the person he spent a night with turned out to be a witch, but isn't it a bit strange that the way to lift the curse is to receive the witch's semen periodically? Wait, is this really effective?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195058.description:
To pay off her family's debt, Ochako has to go on a diet! Her life-or-death struggle lasts for a week, but at the end of it, she transforms into a slender beauty! Now that she has lost her weight, is she about to find romance instead?!

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: Pocha-Meshi: Stuff Your Cheeks With Love!
title.native: ぽちゃっと恋をメシあがれ!
title.romaji: Pocha to Koi o Meshi Agare！

195059.description:
The boy I've had a secret crush on for four years kissed me in my dream... Is it true that my family members have dreams that predict future events? Four characters, entangled relationships, and clashing desires. When it comes to their future and love, how will they make choices in the final year of school?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

195060.description:
The ancient Aspect of War Chiyou found himself hoodwinked down into the Mortal Realm where he was forced to share a physical body with a young middle-schooler.

To separate themselves, they needed to work together to find a powerful artifact and defeat terrible enemies! So began their perilous adventure together!

(Source: Webnovel)

195061.description:
On the cusp of calamity, the dead have risen! Corpses that have long grown cold return to steal warmth from the living, and the natural order dangles by a single thread of fate—a pair of lovelorn enemies tethered intrinsically by ice and fire. Together, Selena and Millard may yet salvage an era that’s torn between bitter frost and scorching flame. They must enter the enigmatic Magic Tower with only one another to rely on, knowing they may never return…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Un amour tout feu tout glace
แด่คู่แค้นที่แสนดีของฉัน

195062.description:
Kim Ji-Hoon is a first-year intern at the prestigious Seoul Hospital. Having grown up as a poor orphan, Ji-Hoon worked his way through college, dreaming of one day becoming a professor of general surgery at his alma mater. He's passionate and eager to learn, but the unexpected politics at the hospital startle him. Even his fellow interns seem to care more about themselves than the patients. Can Ji-Hoon still become a great surgeon, or will the power struggle leave his dream in cardiac arrest?

(Source: Tapas)

195063.description:
he strongest in the martial world, leader of the Hojeongdan, Lee Hwan! During a mission, he battles the Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Sect, Deung Gwang-cheon, and loses consciousness... When he opens his eyes, he's at home? No... This is my childhood home? It's hard to believe, but if I really have returned to the past, this time I won't just stand by and do nothing! On the night of August 8th, when he was 17 years old, a sudden, splitting headache strikes, and something comes to mind. "Cheonsu Ilgi Hap (Thousand Hands One Energy Unification), Deukwon Gang (Obtain Original Strength)..." he muttered absentmindedly and then paused. "Wait, this is the Absolute Demonic Art of the Heavenly Demon! How do I know this technique? Am I going crazy?!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Youngest Disciple of the Martial Arts Leader

195064.description:
How lucky can one girl be? The cure to my illness is to marry a handsome duke, and I don’t even mind his half-demonic bloodline. I love his family, my family loves me, and once society gets to know the Blightons, I’m sure they’ll love them, too. Now, if I remember the novel's storyline correctly, all I have to do is stop his little brother from getting bullied and make sure he meets his one true love… and then we’ll all get our happily ever after, right?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 余命僅かで結婚した男主人公の兄が私に執着する
시한부라서 남주의 형과 결혼했더니 내게 집착한다
Because I was Terminally Ill, I Married the Male Lead's Brother, and Now He's Obsessed with Me

title.english: Married His Brother and Now He's Obsessed

195065.description:
For 200 years, Amarzan the Great Sorcerer strived to become a god. So when he was told that he still lacked something, he chose to start over. Now, he has been reborn as Shuriah, one of the Brionia Empire's greatest beauties and Crown Prince Lenkaizer's maid. Despite trying to focus on finding what she lacked as Amarzan, Shuriah finds herself overcome with the urge to kill Lenkaizer whenever he shows her interest. Is she in danger, or is this just a new emotion she's never experienced before?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 太陽を染める華～天使には秘密がある～

title.english: The Flower That Swallowed the Sun

195067.description:
1-2. Occult Kenkyuubu "Jintai Rensei" (オカルト研究部「人体錬成」); Comic Aun 2024-08, 2025-04
3-4. Nitamo no Doushi Nakayoshi Koyoshi (似た者同士なかよしこよし); Comic Aun 2023-06, 08
5. Kaze to Watashi to Sensei to (風邪と私と先生と); Comic Aun 2022-06
6. Migawari Gasshuku (身代わり合宿); Comic Aun 2021-06
7. Nyan Nyan Gokko (にゃんにゃんごっこ); Comic Aun 2021-10
8. Watashi dake wo Mite Hoshii (私だけを見てほしい); Comic Aun 2021-12
synonyms: オカルト研究部「人体錬成」
似た者同士なかよしこよし
Kaze to Watashi to Sensei to

title.native: 子作りHに興味津々な処女っ子達
title.romaji: Kozukuri H ni Kyoumi Shinshin na Shojokko-tachi

195069.description:
Mouse was just a regular college student when her legs suddenly started to go numb. At first, she brushed it off, thinking it was nothing. But as the symptoms worsened and even walking became painful, a visit to the hospital revealed something she never expected. What do you do when your body begins to betray you, and nothing feels certain anymore?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: It Ain't That Big of a Deal

195070.description:
In 1866, during a time of Catholic persecution in Hwayeonguk, a boy named Mum-Yeong lives abandoned and downtrodden. Born to a Baek-Jeong—an untouchable social caste forced to work as butchers and regarded as less than human—he does whatever it takes to survive, earning the cruel nickname "Dog Bastard." One day, Eun-Hak, a Catholic scholar, enters his life, and Mum-Yeong's slaughterhouse becomes a secret place of worship.

A boy who wanted only to live, no matter how defiled or broken he became… A cruel and sorrowful love blossoms on the border between salvation and ruin.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: ゲス野郎〜親に捨てられた男の話〜

195071.description:
What do you call a past flame you never officially got together with? "The one who got away"? For Seowoo, the answer is simple: “this asshole.” Once infamous as “The Itaewon Twink,” Seowoo is now a reformed high school teacher whose life consists entirely of wrangling teenagers and rotting in bed. His quiet routine is shattered when his ex-partner, Jihyeok, transfers to his school. Forced to confront a history he buried deep, Seowoo hits rock bottom when Jihyeok catches him with a newly delivered adult toy...

“I want to see you use that thing myself.”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

195072.description:
Do-Jun has a crush on the affectionate and mature college senior Han-Eul, but Han-Eul is always accompanied by the bustling popular kid Shin-Woo. Do-Jun, who is reluctant about the seemingly frivolous Shin-Woo, tries to approach Han-Eul, but Han-Eul is a heterosexual to the core, and even Shin-Woo finds out about his feelings for Han-Eul. But what's this? Shin-Woo suggests to Do-Jun that they should be partners since they both like guys anyway. Do-Jun is conflicted, but ends up in a relationship with Shin-woo, who is honestly a "good guy."

Will Do-Jun, who suddenly becomes the best friend and sex partner of his unrequited love, be able to maintain a clean, selfless relationship?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

195073.description:
"Me? A garbage collector like you."

Jin Seong-Won, a member of a garbage collector organization that cleans up the garbage of society. His only hope is to quickly achieve his goal, get paroled, and live with his younger sister, under the watchful eye of Director Kang, who manages the garbage collector organization, equating the organization's justice with his own justice and punishing the villains, but one day, everything starts to go wrong...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

195074.description:
Ye Huang was summoned by the Goddess Association to the Lanling Empire for execution after her family was destroyed by a scumbag. Luckily, she was rescued by Ji Wuyan. After that, the two of them started their adventure where they joined hands to get rid of the enemies and rise to the top.

(Source: Webnovel)

195075.description:
Teenager Chen Xing forges a pact with Lily, the prophesied "Sovereign of Destiny" from the Crystal Beast Realm. This makes him the very first Awakener to contract a humanoid Crystal Beast, granting him a unique power: the ability to transform these beasts into gorgeous girls! Now, he sets out on an epic quest of combat and power-ups to claim the title of "Strongest Crystal Beast Master."

Jealous? For me, an army of beautiful beast girls is just the beginning!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

195076.description:
Born from humble beginnings and with only average talent, the young Luo Xiu's destiny is changed forever when he unexpectedly fuses with an ultimate treasure forged from the very essence of the laws of life and death. Now, with the legendary Wheel of Life and Death of the Myriad Realms hidden within him, he seizes control of reincarnation itself. He will forge his own supreme techniques, become a Great Emperor of his era, and stand proudly above all, past and present.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

195077.description:
Yachiru is a Hasshakusama youkai living in the human world. Because the prevailing public image of Hasshakusama is that they're lewd (not scary), her powers have weakened and her height has shrunk from its original 8 shaku (240 cm) to about 190 cm. She strives to correct that impression, but each day is another failure. However, while at the cinema to study horror films, she meets Seiichirou, a young man who is a huge fan of Hasshakusama. That's when Yachiru realizes that whenever Seiichirou praises her, her height returns to its original size...!!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: やちるさんはほめるとのびる

195078.description:
San once found comfort in Hee-Min’s kindness. Years later, he confesses the love he has kept hidden, not to win Hee-Min over but to finally walk away with closure. To his surprise, Hee-Min accepts his feelings without hesitation. Struggling to trust something that feels too easy, San finds himself torn between doubt and longing. He yearns for a kind of love he has never learned how to receive. A tender and tangled love begins between a black-haired beast still learning how to be human, and the man who never turned him away.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: The Love of a Black-Haired Beast
恩知らずな俺は、おじさんに恋をした

195079.description:
Abandoned by his parents at a young age, Juu has assassinated people for over 30 years as part of an assassin organization. In return for a break from the assassination business, he is given the final mission of assassinating a hero. This is the start of a second life where a worn-out middle-aged man with no redeeming qualities other than assassination can finally grasp "freedom"!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)
synonyms: Ex-assassin who killed the hero.: Jobless middle-aged man starting a new life

title.native: 勇者殺しの元暗殺者。～無職のおっさんから始まるセカンドライフ～
title.romaji: Yuusha-goroshi no Moto Ansatsu-sha.: Mushoku no Ossan kara Hajimaru Second Life

195080.description:
When his partner was murdered and the killer went free, Yoonseok took justice into his own hands. Now he's the pawn of a prosecutor who sends him into danger, his body sexually violated by criminals as a way to gather information. He's little more than a husk, hoping for death, when he begins investigating the gangster Baek Gitae, whose violent sadism triggers something in Yoonseok. Is he seeking out the gangster's sexual aggression as a way to escape his pain? Or is he beginning to enjoy it?

(Source: Tapas)

195081.description: On a journey to save the world, a brave man and his companions kill a saint. From that moment on, eerie events start happening around them... If they hear the saint's breath, no one will survive...!

title.native: 殺されて井戸に捨てられた聖女がチート怨霊になりました
title.romaji: Korosarete Ido ni Suterareta Seijo ga Cheat Onryou ni Narimashita

195082.description:
Based on the erotic game by DWARFSOFT.

Toshio is a serious but passionless middle-aged businessman who loves the sex industry. He was laid off from his company due to poor performance, and while walking through a busy downtown area at night, a beautiful girl in a uniform called out to him. With blonde hair, blue eyes and big breasts that are hard to believe for a Japanese woman, she introduced herself as Iris and asked Toshio to teach her how to please a man. Not understanding what was going on, he followed her and found himself in another world. In this other world, Toshio ends up teaching Iris the sexual service techniques he had developed while frequenting the sex industry.

(Source: Parabook, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters in the digital limited edition.

title.native: ピュアピュア☆ぺろぺろ☆プリンセス ～純心魔法王女のドスケベ快楽レッスン～
title.romaji: Purepure Peropero Princess: Junshin Mahou Oujo no Do Sukebe Kairaku Lesson

195083.description:
Yuichi and Sumi were childhood friends who were always together. However, as they grew up, they drifted apart, but a chance encounter brings them back into each other’s lives…

(Source: Manga Plus)

195084.description:
Salarymen rise to success by doing it!! Nakada, who works at a cosmetics company, is a plain, ordinary salaryman with no redeeming features. He suffers from erectile dysfunction (ED), and no matter what he does or sees, he can't get an erection. One day, when he goes to work, he passes by his stunningly beautiful female boss, Benikawa, and falls in love at first sight. At that moment, Nakada's penis becomes erect for the first time in years. Nakada becomes a "man". From then on, Nakada begins to show his talents at work, and eventually he ends up with a female subordinate!

(Source: Magazine Pocket, translated)

195085.description:
Se-Hwa Lee deals drugs to pay off his debts, but his life is disrupted when he is taken in for questioning by military officer Tae-Jeong Ki, who is investigating the drug ring. Their relationship soon becomes sexual, and Se-Hwa realizes that the key to his freedom might be found in bed with Tae-Jeong.

(Source: Manta)

195086.description:
One day, Sena, a college student, is suddenly approached by a frivolous handsome man named Ruka. Sena's true feelings of unrequited love for his best friend seem to be seen through by Ruka's words, and Sena instinctively runs away from the scene. Even though Sena doesn't want to get involved, Ruka keeps getting involved in various ways, and when Sena gets drunk and tries to forget his unrequited love, he approaches him and says, "I'll take care of you"...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Stitch it with love and seal it with kisses

title.native: 愛で縫ってキスでふさいで

195087.description:
Aiden is a man who works as a soldier in a certain kingdom. He has memories of being an office worker in another world, and in his previous life, he enjoyed visiting hot springs to relieve the fatigue of daily work. He wants to visit the hot springs in this world, but his job as a soldier doesn't allow him to take consecutive days off, so he can only go to nearby hot springs. The story begins when he finds out that Milka, the princess of the country, also likes hot springs.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 異世界サイハテ温泉紀行

195090.description:
Men and women of all ages, gangsters, mysterious beauties, and even aliens study at a part-time high school. The daily lives of various teachers and students will take you to a different dimension...

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

195091.description:
A deadly romance between a foolish mermaid and an invincible? prince!

They say mermaids become unhappy when they come ashore. To dispel this superstition, a young mermaid girl, Nagi Uonome, comes ashore. But just when she thought she could live a happy life on land, she meets Fujimaru, a boy who hates mermaids, and he makes a certain request (threat!?).

(Source Hakusensha, translated)

Notes:
- Only the first 12 chapters were compiled into the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

195092.description:
Featuring eerie urban legends that became popular on the internet, faithfully adapted into comics by skilled authors. A true horror anthology for urban legends!

Cover illustration: Izumi Tomoki
1. Yamamichi no Kaidan (山道の怪談) [Shimizu Aki]
2. Chika no Maruana (地下のまる穴) [Kitaoka Tomo]
3. Ten Soumetsu (テンソウメツ) [tomura (tom等)]
4. Kurutta Kazoku (狂った家族) [Saitou Shunke]
5. Otsukaresama deshita. (おつかれさまでした。) [Tegure]

title.native: 死ぬほど怖いネット掲示板百物語～都市伝説コミック怪談集～
title.romaji: Shinu hodo Kowai Net Keijiban Hyaku Monogatari: Toshi Densetsu Comic Kaidanshuu

195093.description: Volume 2 of Madara Project Official Side Stories
synonyms: MADARA Side Story: Gilgamesh of the Dead Sea

title.native: MADARA外伝 死海のギルガメシュ

195094.description:
Me: "Hey, you ate me! The least you can do is give me some compensation, right?"
Dragon King: "Fine! I'll give you a cultivation technique on an advance. You get the knowledge now, and you can complete the training later!"
Me: "How is that enough? I had to smell your rancid breath! That's double the mental damage!"
Dragon King: "Then what do you want!?"
Me: "From now on, we're two immortals sharing one HP bar. You're going to tank all the damage!"
Dragon King: "Fuck! You lunatic! Why does the health bar for this majestic, sovereign body of mine feel a little short all of a sudden? Looks like it's time to go out and get a job!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

195095.description:
Princess Lena, the future queen of Kimshirt, was injured and lost her memory in an assassination attempt. She met Dante, the king of the Kingdom of Drakona, under the guidance of fate. With fragments of memories flooding into her dreams and intimate nicknames appearing in her mind, mysteries emerged one after another, all hinting at a complicated past between her and King Dante...

(Source: Webnovel)

195096.description:
Ye Shuling is a psychologist with the ability to enter other people's dreams, while Su Yi is a highly self-esteem-driven patient with depression. Bound by destiny, they join forces to help those who suffer from mental issues...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

title.native: 人間ちゃんの警戒心が薄すぎる!

195098.description:
"My wife... once she's naked, it's really game over..."

A glimpse at CCTV footage reveals the neighbor woman - completely nude. Wracked with guilt he shouldn't feel, Scott is caught off guard when Harry makes a dangerous offer:

"Wanna have her? On one condition... Do it right in front of me."

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: A Dangerous Deal and The Girl Next Door
人妻は夫の前で抱かれる

title.english: A Dangerous Deal, and the Woman Next Door

195099.description:
After playing the game Guardian of Humanity for years and becoming an expert, Je-u Han finds himself dragged into a new server of the game and forced to play at the weakest level. The problem is, death in the game means death in real life too. As Demon Kings rise and imperial forces collide, even the routes he once mastered twist into unfamiliar danger. Can Je-u break free from the patterns that doomed every past run, or will a world that no longer follows its established routes prove too much of a challenge?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195100.description:
One night, while walking out of a hotel with another man, Keisuke Ibuki is spotted by his ever-so-uptight colleague, Masatsugu Taga. Keisuke attempts to make Masatsugu his partner in crime by sleeping with him, but Masatsugu ends up proposing to him right after they do the deed...!
This is the story of a battle between a straight-laced, purehearted office worker and his boss who's experienced in bed but inexperienced in love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
195100.hashtag: #セックススーツラブバトル

title.native: セックススーツラブバトル

195101.description:
With a growing interest in matters of sex, high schooler Masamune has developed a desire to fondle tits like his life depends on it. Unfortunately for him, he only has access to the burly pecs of his childhood friend, Hajime. He doesn't mind, though, and gives them a nice, firm squeeze. Hajime's chest is hard, muscular and without a hint of softness, but fondling it still makes Masamune feel all tingly! Masamune might just be in love with Hajime('s tits)! A handsome, silent type and an airheaded cutie! Two childhood friends brought together by a love for boobs!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: はじめと正宗(とおっぱい)

195102.description:
Late-night poison!!! Don't watch it when you're hungry! The cooking battle surpasses "The Cooking Master Boy"! The chef battle is entangled with a century-old feud; the victory or defeat depends on the cooking skills. The competition of exquisite dishes is related to the whereabouts of "The Book of Longevity of the Qin Emperor"... It's hard to get a dish with a lot of money, "The World of Cooking" is the ultimate benefit for foodies!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

195103.description:
Ever since the first time flower designer Sena Nakagiri laid eyes on international supermodel Jun Asakura, " the human embodiment of a flower," he's been captivated by him. When Jun personally requests him for another photo shoot, Sena finds himself increasingly flustered by Jun's closeness and his openly adoring gaze. After the shoot, Jun whisks Sena away in his car for ramen at his favorite local spot, eager for Sena to get to know him better despite his supermodel status. There, their tender and beautiful romance starts to bloom.

(Source: Renta!)

195104.description:
Masanori Makita and Yuta Okamoto are old friends. Yuta might be two years younger, but he matured early and decides to help the earnest Masanori buy some adult toy! Masanori gets excited looking at dirty magazines... but he's too big to fit into the toy he bought for himself! Unable to just sit back and watch, Yuta decides to lend a hand... As much as Masanori wishes he'd go limp from the embarrassment, he's entranced by the pleasure of being milked.

Realizing how off-putting it must all be for his friend, Masanori looks at Yuta's face... only to be shocked at how he looks... and even more shocked at what he does next...! What will happen now that the two are no longer just old friends...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Go Forth, Young Man! -Masanori And Yuta-
title.native: サカれ！青少年～マサノリくんとオカモトくん～

195105.description:
While studying at the library one day, Ryosuke catches sight of a man who resembles a friend he had back in high school. Kei was a bespectacled boy more interested in books than people, but somehow the two had become friends. However, when messing around at Kei's place one day, Ryosuke ended up making Kei pee his pants, and both of them got hard as a result. Following that, their friendship fell apart, and Ryosuke feels a sense of regret over it. When the two reunite, it seems that Kei has developed a new fetish... and Ryosuke can't help but get drawn back in.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: メガネ司書の躾けかた

195106.description:
Siesta, a duchess with the power to rewind time when she dies, is born into a noble family that ultimately betrays and shames her. Facing her tenth death, she realizes their love was merely emptiness, and resolves: “This will be the last time I shed tears for these people.”

In her eleventh life, armed with time-reversal, teleportation, and the ability to turn objects into butterflies, she sets out to enact revenge against those who hurt her. Once disregarded like a sacrificial pawn, Siesta uses her abilities and intellect to triumph with stunning elegance.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter Will Not Forgive Anymore

title.native: 公爵令嬢はもう許さない

195107.description:
Set in a rural town in northern Tohoku, this coming-of-age story follows a girl who feels suffocated by life in the small town and a boy who is here to escape from the city. They meet through a certain piece of music, and gradually open their hearts to each other.

(Source: HEROS flat, translated)

title.native: さくらいろダイアローグ

195108.description:
Struggling with a severe case of writer's block, web novelist Han Xiaoxiao collapses from a stroke and falls into a coma. Just then, the "God of Plot Twists" appears and offers her a chance to recover.

The mission: She must enter the world of her own story, "reform" its tyrannical CEO male lead, and turn her unpopular webnovel into a chart-topping hit — all within one month.

If she succeeds, she lives. If she fails, her real-world self dies for good.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Arrogant President Wants to Change the Scenario and Fall in Love!
The Arrogant CEO Wants to Rewrite Fate and Fall In Love

title.english: Did the Male Lead Change Today?
title.romaji: Jin Tian Zongcai Gai Le Mei

195110.description:
Tired of being bound by her sacred duty, a Saintess enters an unexpected contract with the Demon King. Leaving behind the Holy Temple’s rigid teachings, she settles in the Demon King’s castle in which her permanent residency will be decided by a majority vote. Determined to stay in this castle full of brooding demon brothers, loyal attendants, and opportunities to fulfill her forbidden desires, the Saintess decides to secure her place there through any means possible… including sweet temptation and spicy blackmail. Will she gain the votes and hearts of the demons around her?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: How the Fallen Saint Lives With the Devil ~Please Give Me One Precious Shot~

title.english: How the Demons Fall for the Fallen Saintess : Take Me, Please!
title.native: 타락 성녀가 악마와 더불어 사는 법 ~소중한 한 방 부탁해요~
title.romaji: Tarang Seongnyeoga Angmawa Deobureo Saneun Beom: Sojunghan Han Bang Butakaeyo

195111.description:
Alcohol, cigarettes, men.

Ha-Yoon, a 20-year-old repeat student who had been living her life with all the bad things, meets her homeroom teacher, Hyung-Won! Ha-Yoon feels curious about him who doesn't care about the rumors others gossip about and always breaks expectations, and for the first time, she learns of love.

"I like that teacher."

"That's not love. You have a lot of delusions at your age."

But unlike other men who would fall for you if you teased them a little, he's the world's most stubborn man, so it's not easy... But it's okay, because I'll break down all those stubborn walls!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

195112.description:
People encounter strange phenomena at twilight, when their faces are hard to see and they don't know who they are. We encounter eerie, unidentified strange phenomena in the mountains, rivers, forests, the sea, and sometimes even by the roadside or in a patch of grass. But for me, Nakiri Tetsu, the strange phenomena are usually in my parents' house.

Yes, my house is full of strange phenomena...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: おれん家フォークロア

195113.description:
Chung-Won, a narcotics officer, goes undercover to stop "Pink Out," a new drug in Korea. The dealers slip away, leaving only Yeong. Every test comes back clean, yet after much doubt, Chung-Won takes home the bewildered 21-year-old who is so unworldly, it's as if he's been shut away his whole life.

(Source: Manta)

195114.description: A man returns to his hometown with his son to see an old friend.

195115.description:
Media personality from space, Ameno, introduces a story about foolish humans and the strange things on Earth! Why not take a peek at a scary story with a cream soda in hand in the depths of hell? You might be cursed after destroying a shrine, or your usual train might take you to a strange world...? A new sensation that will make you chuckle, shiver and cry a little!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 地獄でクリームソーダ

195116.description:
Hirasaka Town is a gloomy, rural town with a lot of taboos. It is said that anyone who breaks a taboo will be spirited away... In response to a request, Yomika Inugami, a psychic negotiator, arrives as a transfer student...! Will she be able to solve the town's creepy mystery?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195117.description:
1. Fumihazusareta Michi (踏み外された道, Off the Beaten Path); Comic Bavel 2024-09
2. Kore de Saigo Dakara... (これで最後だから･･･, Because This is the Last Time...); Comic Bavel 2025-02
3. Shiranai Ichimen (知らない一面, A Side I Don't Know); Comic Bavel 2024-12
4. Monde! Senpai!! (揉んで!先輩!!, Fondle Them, Senpai!!); Comic Bavel 2024-07
5. Hadaka no Tsukiai (裸の突き合い, Naked Butting); Comic Bavel 2024-06
6. Yasashiku Shinaide (やさしくしないで, Don't Be So Friendly); Comic Bavel 2024-03
7. Anta no Tame ni Funde Ageru (あんたのために踏んであげる, I'll Step on You For Your Sake); Comic Bavel 2024-01
8. Boku no Karada wa Shita no Ue (僕の身体は舌の上, My Body is Atop Her Tongue); Comic Bavel 2023-10
9. Youki to Naiki na Seijuu (陽気と内気な性獣, Cheerful & Shy Sex Beast); Comic Bavel 2023-07
synonyms: Because This is the Last Time...
Anta no Tame ni Funde Ageru
あんたのために踏んであげる
I'll Step on You For Your Sake
Boku no Karada wa Shita no Ue
My Body is Atop Her Tongue

195118.description:
The apocalyptic prophecy came true: Earth has been transformed into a twisted survival game! All of humanity has been reduced to mere NPCs, helplessly slaughtered by alien players for sport. Just when the world falls into despair, he awakens a hidden class and gains the power to fight back against the players! Now, with Earth as the ultimate battleground, the war between NPCs and players officially begins...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Player Elimination Plan! When Anomalies Descend Upon the Human World
National NPC: I Can Kill Players

title.english: The Player Purge: When the World Becomes a Game
title.native: 玩家清除计划！当异变降临人间
title.romaji: Wanjia Qingchu Jihua! Dang Yi Bian Jianglin Renjian

195119.description:
The next stage for Doka Cook, Kyobashi Kensaku, is the otherworldly Vermilion Islands. Princess Lapis, hero of the "Ten Year War" that divided the island in two, is fed up with the people who continue to fight over trivial matters even though peace has come. The same thing happens at construction sites. When a small quarrel breaks out at a construction site where the same dishes are cooked over and over again, Doka Cook steps up.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ドカクエ 異世界ドカコッククエスト

195120.description:
Lucky Kandamori is a new YouTuber who has become extremely popular for his courage challenge videos. He has an extremely powerful guardian spirit who will always protect him from any disaster. However, it is a vengeful spirit that has possessed the Kandamori family for generations, and it is a curse that will ensure that he will be killed by it in the end. What's more, he is often cursed by his envy and jealousy on a regular basis...

This is the cursed memorandum of Daikichi Kandamori.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 呪殺ナビ～ラッキー神田守の呪われ備忘録～
title.romaji: Jusatsu Nabi: Lucky Kandamori no Noroware Bibouroku

195121.description:
Duke Valerio, who is also a commander of the Royal Knights, is having a hard time finding a bride. Due to his fearsome and stern look, all of his proposals end up in rejection. Right when he is about to give up, a meeting is arranged with a daughter of an earl, called the Phantom Flower by other nobles. Despite Valerio's worries, she accepts his proposal right away. Why would the beautiful Phantom Flower choose him of all people? Could she be hiding a secret? A heart-warming love story begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Fearsome and Stern-faced Duke's Engagement to the Noble Phantom Flower
title.native: 厳つい顔で凶悪騎士団長と恐れられる公爵様の最後の婚活相手は社交界の幻の花でした
title.romaji: Ikatsui Kao de Kyouaku Kishi Danchou to Osorerareru Koushaku-sama no Saigo no Konkatsu Aite wa Shakoukaino Maboroshi no Hana Deshita

195122.description:
High school student Akira Mizutane, whose mother is a genius scientist, spends his days trying to follow in his mother's footsteps. However, he feels that he has reached a dead end in his research and becomes depressed, thinking that he doesn't have the talent his mother has. One day, Akira is advised by a friend that a man can become more powerful by having a girlfriend, so he creates an artificial human girlfriend, "No. 0".

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195123.description:
In his past life, Wen Yu loved Ji Anning deeply, but his dominant and indomitable behavior made Ji Anning view him with fear and distrust. After Ji Anning accidentally fell from a building, Wen Yu took revenge for her and ended up being arrested.

Reborn, Ji Anning tries to avoid Wen Yu, fearing that he will repeat the same mistakes, but, little by little, she begins to recognize his sincerity as he insists on staying by her side. When he reaches his lowest point, she comforts him. In the end, the two, who have gone through great changes, join forces to face the storms of life and rewrite the destiny of this new life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

195124.description:
Hatanuki, a young employee who works hard at a small game company in Tokyo, is suggested by tired writer Inue to take a vacation to an abandoned school cafe in Kagawa Prefecture that is rumored to be haunted. The cafe is run by Arise Rui, who was with him in a university drama club a year ago. Hatanuki, who cannot forget his memories with Rui, hesitates but heads to the cafe...

A fantastical romantic comedy about the relaxed life of a mermaid, a desperate man, and ayakashi in a seaside town.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 人魚と逃避リーマンのあまい海暮らし ―瀬戸内あやかし廃校カフェ―
title.romaji: Ningyo to Touhi Riiman no Amai Umi Kurashi: Setouchi Ayakashi Haikou Café

195125.description:
Did a very important dragon (VID) just fall in love with me? Despite being nobility, Pearl was ostracized for being 'cursed' and was sold off to a neighboring liege. But she was kidnapped on her journey there, and by none other than Eric, the beautiful, yet callous sole heir of the Great Dragons. And the first thing he demanded was for Pearl to say she loved him…?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: The Bride who Raises the Villainous Dragon
The Bride Who Raised the Evil Dragon

195126.description:
Ohana lives as a dancing shrine maiden at the island shrine with the chief priest and his familiar spirit, Toki. When the chief priest is injured, Ohana and Toki must stand up to the various supernatural phenomena that are rampant in Edo!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195127.description:
After reawakening from a C-rank to the strongest A-rank Esper, Ha Jae-Il is pushed to the brink by insomnia and unresolved trauma, unable to endure even the slightest touch. His only match is Seung-Hyeon, an A-rank Guide with a 98 percent compatibility who comes from the lawless District 13 and lacks all formal guiding skills. With no other options, the Haon Division orders an extreme solution: the two must share a bed twice a week. But when Jae-Il wakes to unfamiliar hands in the dark and sees Seung-Hyeon looming over him, he realizes that something else has awakened as well - and it is already guiding him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195128.description:
Shin Ha-Jin, a student in the Department of Physical Education at Hankuk University. He has a handsome face and a kind personality, and there are rumors that he has a girlfriend, but he is actually a virgin who has never even kissed her. Ha-Jin had been bickering with Kwon Do-Kyung, a student in the Department of Physical Education, before returning to school, and when he was alone with him, he unexpectedly got an erection. After that, he began to develop feelings for Do-Kyung that were different from before.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

195129.description:
The Houn Group, one of the largest illegal arms/drug trafficking companies in Asia disguised as a food company. The real successor of this group, Che-Ran, suddenly disappeared two years ago. Her husband, Kang-Woo, who had been keeping her disappearance a secret, was eventually caught by his father, the chairman of Houn Group, as the release date of the new medicine was approaching. Since the disappearance of Che-Ran, the only one in the group who could perfectly implement the medicine recipe, could cause enormous losses to the company, Kang-Woo belatedly began to track Che-Ran's traces. Soon after, Kang-Woo obtained information that Che-Ran was living in a certain 1k in Setagaya Ward, Tokyo, Japan. However, when he arrived there, Che-Ran, whom he had been desperately searching for, had already disappeared, and instead, he encountered Do-Hwa, a man who claimed to have been Che-Ran's housekeeper.

The thrilling love story of two men who started with the strange purpose of having to meet a woman began in the rain on a hot summer day.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: How to Escape From the Circle
The Story of How a Cool Gyaru Became My Onahole

title.native: クールなギャルがオナホになってくれる話
title.romaji: Cool na Gal ga Onaho ni Natte Kureru Hanashi

195131.description:
Ja-Ye was sold as a fake wife for Jeong Seon-Woo and became a talisman to ward off evil. The two lived as a show window couple for three years, realizing their feelings for each other, and their love deepens day by day… However, what stands in the way of their love is not the fact that Ja-Ye is a talisman to ward off evil, but the twisted maternal love of her mother-in-law, Ok-Hyun. In the end, the two make an irreversible decision to protect each other…

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Time of Mr. and Mrs.
Kao dake Yoi Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi

title.native: 顔だけ良いクラスメイトが、やたらとグイグイ来る百合の話。
title.romaji: Kao dake Ii Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi.

title.native: 巨乳JKが本気を出したら、義父(パパ)はもう逃げられない♥
title.romaji: Kyonyuu JK ga Honki wo Dashitara, Papa wa Mou Nigerarenai♥

title.native: 巨乳JKが本気を出したイチャラブ小旅行(ハネムーン)♪
title.romaji: Kyonyuu JK ga Honki wo Dashita Icha Love Honeymoon

195135.description:
In a time when demon possession was despised and executed. 17-year-old girl Olivia is a heretic exorcist who, while being an exorcist, has a demon living within her. A lost client visits the office run by her partner, the handsome young man (who is often naked), Ru-kun, and her familiar, the perverted fly (who is actually handsome...!?) Bessan.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

195136.description:
Finally living alone like he wanted! But university student Akizuki has started sharing a room with his friend Hayase. As soon as he moves in, he is bewildered by Hayase, who says he can't imagine life without hugs, and for some reason he ends up hugging him every day...? And if he forgets his duty or doesn't hug him, he has to pay a fine and do whatever he tells him...? Akizuki is gradually getting used to the skinship with Hayase, but...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195137.description:
Welcome to a fun world unknown to humans: Eggnog, a town known as the special area where monsters who have been chased out of their homes by humans live. Dahlia, the daughter of a mummy, lives happily every day with her friends Molt, a werewolf, and Rosetta, a vampire. But one day, Dahlia's father goes missing after going to the human town. Dahlia goes to the human town with Molt and Rosetta to look for her father! But in fact, Dahlia has a big secret...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195138.description:
A mobster who never smiles and a cheerful nightclub host live together for a week!

Kotaro's a friendly, positive nightclub host with good looks. One day, a customer disappears after coming to his club, and a scary man locks Kotaro up as a result!! Kaoru, his guard, takes his virginity in a bid to force him to confess where the missing woman has gone. Despite his sullen poker face, Kaoru's a real stud, threatening Kotaro with more unbearable pleasure if he doesn't talk the next day. Worse, Kotaro's happy life will surely end when Kaoru's boss returns from a trip in a week... And he's desperate to get away before then!!

(Source: Renta!)

Notes:
- During serialization, Chapters 5 and 6 were split into two parts, while Chapter 7 was split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume release.
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Taking Him Back To That Night

195139.description:
The Great Demon King Veit and the hero Keel were facing their final battle at the Demon King's Castle. However, a cliff collapsed and they were washed ashore on a deserted island. Although the two were sworn enemies, they had to become friends in order to escape the island...

Will the Great Demon King and the hero be able to connect with each other?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 勇者と我輩の無人島漂流記
title.romaji: Yuusha to Wagahai no Mujintou Hyouryuuki

synonyms: A story about a neighbor who was about to die

title.native: 隣人が死のうとしてた話
title.romaji: Rinjin ga Shinou to Shiteta Hanashi

195147.description:
Keiichi Hachiya's fiancee calls him "boring in bed" and dumps him. While he's drowning his sorrows in alcohol, he signs up for a hardcore hookup site and decides to meet Miyuki, who's a dom. However, Miyuki turns out to be Reiji Miyuki, who's a guy! Keiichi is skeptical at first, but Reiji is a good listener, and his heart isn't the only thing Keiichi opens up to him... He finds himself in bed with Reiji! He can't believe he's letting a guy he just met do these things to him... but it feels so good!! The next day, he discovers that Reiji works at the same company as him! He's not sure how to react, but before he can decide, his friend begins taking advantage of him...! Two smart, handsome businessmen want Keiichi in this unbelievable romance story.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: First released in long strip format with one chapter split into three parts.
synonyms: 3P Nonke Kaihatsu: Elite 2-ri ni Nerawareta Ore

title.english: A Straight Guy's Three-way -Two Guys Are After Me-
title.native: 3Pノンケ開発～エリート2人に狙われた俺
title.romaji: 3P Nonke Kaihatsu: Elite Futari ni Nerawareta Ore

195148.description:
His company was acquired, and he was "optimized" right out of a job. To make matters worse, the game-loving nerd Ye Fei just got dumped by his girlfriend. Will he fall into despair or just throw his life away?

Ye Fei shakes his head: "I refuse to choose either!" His salvation arrives in the form of a stunning AI beauty, bringing with her a billionaire system. The rule is simple: the more he spends, the more he earns! His new cheat power is on its way, and it's bringing a whole harem of beauties with it! Navigating the dual rules of wealth and love, he dives into an adrenaline-fueled corporate battlefield. In this high-stakes game, who will become the final diamond ring to grace his finger?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: After Being Laid Off, I Got Hundreds of Millions of Systems, and I Upgraded Them Alone

title.native: 被裁员后获亿万系统，我独自升级
title.romaji: Bei Caiyuan Hou Huo Yiwan Xitong, Wo Duzi Shengji

195149.description:
This is a world that is no different from modern society during the day, but once the dusk dividing line is crossed, darkness is forcibly opened, and it becomes a world where evil spirits and ghosts roam the night. My original world had just been destroyed, and when I traveled to the new world it was the end of the world again? It’s the end of the world, but I’m also possessed by an evil spirit? Being chased by villagers? Faced with various survival crises, how can I hide my identity as a traveler and survive?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

195150.description:
Takes place a few years after the ending of Yumeguri Yurimeguri and focus on the Valentine's Day between Nagi and Yuuka.

Note: Released at COMITIA 151.

195151.description:
Loner Tsukuyo Kagemoto is on her daily search for a spot to eat lunch when she notices an unused classroom and tries the door. To her surprise, she finds her classmate Tomoka Hinoue touching herself. Caught looking, she tries to run away, but Tomoka stops her and makes a surprising offer.

"If you do something naughty with me, I'll let this slide."

Bowled over by an enthusiastic Tomoka, Tsukuyo gets caught up in a secret tryst.
synonyms: Until the lunch break is over

title.native: お昼休みが終わるまで

195152.description:
After her college entrance exams, Su Yao's sister frantically recommended a smutty novel called [Coincidentally, I Like You Too.] Driven by a noble pursuit of knowledge, a desire to explore the unknown, and a thirst for academic innovation, Su Yao decided to peruse this work one dark and stormy night. The result? She transmigrated directly into the book.

She became a nameless, faceless background character—and thank god for that! If she had been anyone with even a remote connection to the plot, she would have died from pure disgust. After all, who in their right mind would want a starring role in a smut fic?!

Her new rules for survival: The Male Lead? Stay far, far away. The Female Lead? Never, ever offend her. A fellow Background Character? Now that's a safe bet. And so, Su Yao—now living as Lin Zhinian—confidently befriends another "background character," Shen An.
Everything is going perfectly until the day she personally hears the novel's original male lead call Shen An...
"Brother"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: After Transmigrating Into the Novel, I Am Not Even a Female Supporting Character
I Entered an Adult Novel And Not Even as a Secondary Character

title.native: 穿书后我连女配都不是
title.romaji: Chuan Shuhou Wo Lian Nü Pei Dou Bushi

195154.description:
Keita and Mio Tachibana are a newlywed couple. The two met at an arranged marriage meeting, but they both have a secret that they don't want each other to know. That secret is that in order to impress Mio, Keita plays the role of the hero from Mio's favorite shojo manga, and Mio pretends not to notice, but she knows all about it. Nothing happens, but it's still fun. What kind of laid-back and sometimes heart-fluttering newlywed life will the two of them lead?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 橘花夫妻のかくしごとな新婚生活
title.romaji: Tachibana Fusai no Kakushigoto na Shinkon Seikatsu

195155.description:
High school student Haru Mitsuhashi is confessed to by the boy she admires, Shiki Touma. She happily accepted, as she had harbored feelings for him ever since he helped her out on the day of their entrance ceremony. The two begin dating and immediately decided to walk home together. However, even though she should love him, for some reason Haru finds Shiki disgusting. And at that moment, Shiki appears as an ugly frog to her...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: カエルになった王子様

195156.description:
During the spring break of his second year of high school, Mutsuki is confessed to by Nanami, whom she has always liked. However, right after that, Nanami gets into an accident. The moment she fervently wishes, "I don't care if I die in your place, please don't take Nanami away...!", she wakes up to find himself back on the first day of her second year...! Then, the mysterious Grim Reaper tells her that the condition for saving Nanami is "to repeat her second year of high school without Nanami confessing his love to her"!? An unwanted love fight begins as Mutsuki continues to avoid the confession from the person she has mutual feelings for!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: ごめん、名波くんとは付き合えない

195157.description:
Hagi and Fuku are siblings with completely opposite personalities who are living together for the first time in eight years. They have been living their lives in their own way, each with their own difficulties in life. Sometimes they feel frustrated and wonder why they can't live more easily, so they drink, cook and eat delicious food, and complain to their housemate... Nothing is particularly resolved, but they have the strength to live another day.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: よなよな。－今夜も呑んで忘れましょう－

195158.description:
A world where technology has developed and people have eliminated fantasy and no longer seek stories. A boy named Saigo, who writes fantasy novels, is treated as a weirdo by those around him and is isolated at school. One day, a boy named Maori appears before Saigo, claiming to be the descendant of a witch and his destined partner. Suspicious of Maori, Saigo rejects his proposal of marriage. However, when Maori loses his emotions and causes a supernatural phenomenon, Saigo, sensing danger, agrees to marry him.

This is a dark fantasy about a descendant of a witch and a boy who seeks something out of the ordinary.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Last Witch is Bad Luck Charm

title.native: さいごの魔女のお祝い

195159.description:
Satoshi started living together with Misako, whom he met two weeks prior while trying to pick up women. Life was going well for Misako, and she was happy to live with Satoshi as if they were husband and wife. One day, however, Satoshi finds a picture of Misako in marriage photos with a man he doesn't know... What is love? What is cohabitation? This is a story of men who could not grow up, and women who could not help but love them.

(Souce: Shogakukan, translated)

195161.description:
One day, Haru, a high school girl with a strong desire for approval, finds an old guitar in the music room's storage room. She carelessly touches it thinking it's okay to just scratch it a little, but ends up dropping it and scratching it...? Haru quietly returns the guitar and pretends nothing happened, but when she gets home, the guitar is in her room for some reason! A girls' band comedy about Haru, a modern high school girl who dreams of becoming a buzzkill, and Aki, a high school girl from the 90s who was obsessed with guitars!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195162.description:
The story is set in a world where Seekers, a profession that involves broadcasting dungeon strategy guides, are ranked number one in the list of most desirable professions. Rin, a rich girl who works as a low-tier Seeker, has an uncle who is a low-tier streamer that she can't take her eyes off for some reason. His name is Tooru. Although he looks like an ordinary old man, he displays surprising powers when Rin is in trouble...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: シーカーズ～迷宮最強のおじさん、神配信者となる～
title.romaji: Seekers: Meikyuu Saikyou no Oji-san, Kami Haishinsha to Naru

7. Yoi ko no Machikado [Hoshuu Jugyou] (よいこの街角〈補習授業〉)

9. Yoi ko no Machikado [Mirai no Fuyu no Hi] (よいこの街角〈未来の冬の日〉)
10. Jijii no Densetsu (じじいの伝説)

title.native: よしもとよしとも珠玉短編集

195164.description:
A collection of one-shots by Yoshitomo Yoshimoto:

1. Ahiru no Ko no Blues (アヒルの子のブルース)
2. Tokyo Boueigun Ni (東京防衛軍2)
3. Elise no Tame ni (エリーゼのために)

6. Roku-gatsu no Sakura (6月の桜)
7. Jijii no Densetsu (じじいの伝説)

title.native: コレクターズ・アイテム

195165.description: One-shot published on Twitter during the Covid-19 pandemic through MANGA Day to Day.

195166.description:
After years of grueling training, Ku Hwa-Yun finally leaves the legendary Shaolin Temple to test his limits in the outside world. Packing only the essentials for an endless trek, he steps into a realm far more dangerous than he imagined. As expected, deadly foes, hidden traps, and ruthless monsters await him at every turn…but there is another, far more sinister force that may be extra “hard” to defeat.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Conquer the World♥ With One Bottle of Potion

195167.description:
Chesterville’s resident romance novelist, Sweetpea Rabbithole, knows how to write desire—but she’s never tasted it. Determined to change that, she sets out to find someone who can show her what she’s been missing. But when her childhood friend Edward learns of her plan, he's determined to be her first and only lesson. With a mask, a mysterious identity, and a master plan to show her he can be more than the little boy she grew up with, will these friends finally realize what was there all along?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [순애 단편선] 토끼야, 오늘 밤엔 문을 열어 둬
[Sunae Danpyeonseon] Tokkiya, Oneul Bamen Muneul Yeoreo Dwo
[True Love Anthology] Bunny, Leave The Door Open Tonight
Rabbit, Please Keep the Door Open Tonight

title.english: Bunny, Leave the Door Open Tonight
title.native: 토끼야, 오늘 밤엔 문을 열어 둬
title.romaji: Tokkiya, Oneul Bamen Muneul Yeoreo Dwo

195168.description:
“I’m the real Edith Abina?!”

Trapped in a reverse harem game. Even becoming a villain who has killed countless times! The protagonist, a player in the virtual reality game, “Experience! The Scene of Life: Saint Edition,” wakes up in the body of the villainess “Edith Abina,” not the game’s protagonist, the saint “Gian.” But no matter what I do, I can’t log out-?! On top of that, in order to figure out a way to return to reality, I have to beep-- beep- with 5 other characters to find true love?

“What the heck~~~!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Fake Saint of a Reverse Harem Game

195169.description:
There are many manga adaptations of Journey to the West, but this one is truly unique! It is a legendary adventure that intertwines fiction with historical facts from the Tang Dynasty, and features familiar characters such as Sun Wukong and Zhu Bajie as humans rather than demons. However, many monsters, demons, and supernatural events also make appearances.

(Source: ComicDays, translated)
synonyms: 西游妖猿传 西域篇

title.native: 西遊妖猿伝 西域篇

195170.description:
Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that her intentions are anything but benign. Thus begins the deadliest dance of all: a ballet of love, death, and war.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: At the Place Where the Golden Rose Broke

title.english: Where the Golden Rose was Plucked

195171.description: The Magical War Arc is the third story in the Yu-Gi-Oh! OCG Stories manga series. It is centered around the storyline of the cards "Endymion" and "Witchcrafter".
synonyms: Yu☆Gi☆Oh OCG STORIES: Magical War Arc

センパイ、私と浮気してみませんか？　～幼馴染を親友に寝取られたので、これから元親友の妹を寝取り返したいと思います～

195175.description:
Those who wield powers that defy the skies and shatter the earth—arts that move mountains and drain seas—are known to the world as Cultivators. This is an adventure set in their world. Formidable foes, demonic beasts, ancient ruins, and grudges passed down through generations of cultivators… All will unfold, one by one, in this realm where strength defines destiny.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

195176.description:
1-3. Sunadokei (砂時計), COMIC Megastore Alpha 2018-05, 07, 09
4. Sayakuchi-sensei wa Hoki desu kara (鞘口先生は本気ですから); Comic Megastore Alpha 2018-01
synonyms: 鞘口先生は本気ですから

195177.description:
Nagisa and Ikki have a great relationship, but there's just one problem... He's never made her orgasm. Realizing that they need help with their sex life, they decide she should try going to a certain hardcore club. Will the club really be just what they need or are they making a horrible mistake?

(Source: FAKKU)

title.native: ひどいこと“され”クラブ

195178.description:
In Kamanari City lies the restricted “K-Zone,” a place off-limits to the public.

Supernatural phenomena are said to occur within its boundaries.

High school trio Chuuta, Kirimai, and Kawanakajima set out to uncover the mysteries of the K-Zone!

195180.description:
A collection of one-shots depicting the beauty of living true to one's self. Includes one-shots originally posted on Fujichika's pixiv.

1. Utsukushii Hito (美しいひと)
2. Komarimasu, Okyaku-sama (困ります、お客様)
3. Takarajyan! (タカラジャン！)
4. Kibou no Asada-chan (希望の朝田ちゃん)
5. Ari no Manma no Anata (ありのまんまのあなた)
6. Yogoreta Canvas (汚れたキャンバス)
synonyms: ありのまんまのあなた

title.native: 世界でいちばん美しいひと　ふじちか短編集
title.romaji: Sekai de Ichiban Utsukushi Hito: Fujichika Tanpenshu

title.native: 密姦合宿〜男子部員のご褒美メスオナホ〜
title.romaji: Mitsukan Gasshuku: Danshi Buin no Gohoubi Mesu Onaho

title.native: 幼馴染のお姉さんが寝取られたので、僕はあなたの妹とセックスしてもいいですか？
title.romaji: Osananajimi no Onee-san ga Netorareta node, Boku wa Anata no Imouto to Sex shite mo Ii desu ka?

synonyms: How To See The Other World

title.native: 溺愛が止まらない寡黙な後輩による開発計略
title.romaji: Dekiai ga Tomaranai Kamoku na Kouhai ni Yoru Kaihatsu Keiryaku

195188.description:
A story about a master-servant duo who fight against evil by rewriting letters using a brush. A mysterious boy who calls himself a "stationery master" appears in front of Momo, a fifth-grade elementary school girl whose hobbies are calligraphy and studying kanji...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 新こちらパーティー編集部っ！ ひよっこ編集長ふたたび！
title.romaji: Shin Kochira Party Henshuu-bu! Hiyokko Henshuu-chou Futatabi!

195190.description:
Twins Sakura and Momo are polar opposites but are super close, and they're changing their lives with makeup! A new chapter in the beauty miracle story begins!!

(Source: Ciao Plus, translated)

195191.description:
A historical drama set in the Sengoku Era, but with modern-day concepts such as "menhera" (mentally unstable person), "oshi" (fave) and "riako" (a girl obsessed over an idol or actor).
A page is madly in love with his lord, but soon he will learn he has to compete with other men to win his beloved's attention.

195194.description:
On his way home from work, Ryota Mine mistakenly goes into a dangerous park and is attacked, only to be saved by a young guy named Souma. Souma warns Ryota to "stay away from my world," but Ryota can't forget Souma's alluring eyes and goes to see him again. When he gets close to Souma, he feels a warmth he's never felt inside anyone else before... but still, this is his first love and he can't stop...! This is a passionate love story between a young guy who's dangerously attractive and a guy who's never felt love before. Contains newly published stories. From the characters appearing in the "Drawn into Love" series, a new couple is born!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Sono Koi wa Kare wo Mushibamu

195195.description:
Talent agency manager Akane Watanabe has been dating Seigo Ozaki, successor to a printing company, for three years now. Ozaki is still infatuated with Akane and never fails to let him know it. But, now that Ozaki's had a taste of love, he's grown terribly clingy, both physically and emotionally. One night, in front of Ozaki's apartment, Akane runs into Ozaki's little brother, Kota, who suddenly demands that he break up with Ozaki! Determined not to give in to Kota's threats, Akane decides to fight fire with fire...!

A story of an adult couple who can't let go of their maddening love!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes "Doujin Nihon Mukashi Banashi: Kaguya-hime (同人日本昔話〜かぐや姫〜)" and one extra chapter.

title.english: Loosen Me Up With Your Sweet, Sweet Fingertips
title.native: 甘い指先で舐めてほぐして

195197.description:
Jonak is on his way to find a fabled dragon god said to aid humans so that he can save the village that he comes from. Finally, as Jonak stands before the god, Adain, he asks only for Jonak's body in exchange. The dragon god known to many as a tragic and passionate has come to be quite high and mighty in attitude... and Jonak is now his mate...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

195198.description:
Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195199.description:
Yuki Tsukishiro is an honor student at his high school and a national judo champion admired by both his classmates and teachers alike. But, he harbors a secret. A secret that Kei Arima, the ringleader of a band of delinquents one year younger than him, has become aware of. One afternoon's series of events culminates in the nurse's office, when Yuki and Kei come face-to-face. As the door clicks shut behind them, Yuki's secret is poised to unfold.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195202.description:
Grasse is a knight who is feared by those around him and is called the "Black Lion." Felicia, the daughter of a duke who will become his wife, dotes on Grasse. However, the two of them still have a pure relationship. One day, Felicia is kidnapped by an assassin who is after Grasse's life. When Grasse is attacked, Felicia realizes that time has rewound to her wedding with Grasse. Believing that she was responsible for Grasse's attack, Felicia decides to take action to save him and get him divorced...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
