195203.description:
A lowborn boy with a gift for magic sets out to defy precedent and win a place in the prestigious Royal Academy. Its infamously challenging entrance exam forces him to team up with the daughter of one of the kingdom’s most powerful nobles in a meeting that will change both their lives forever. The aristocratic old guard scorns Allen for his humble origins, no matter how many times he proves himself as a sorcerer, and calls Lydia “cursed” because she can barely cast a spell, no matter how often she shows her skill with a sword. But as long as they support each other, they can be more than a match for anything the academy throws at them. Joined by a misfit princess and an enigmatic student from abroad, the pair take their first steps toward proving the world wrong. Meanwhile, whispers of a potent drug and a dragon-worshipping cult have the kingdom’s leaders on edge.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter 0

195205.description:
Kio has a crush on his streaming partner, the incredibly attractive model Kira!

It was love at first sight when Kira stepped in to save him from two guys at a club. Kio couldn't believe his luck when Kira agreed to pair up with him, leading the two to start the KiraKio Channel. Though Kio knows his love is unrequited, he wants to at least try to convey his feelings to Kira...! Thus, he decides to do a prank video where he confesses his feelings to Kira while livestreaming. Much to his surprise, though, during the prank Kira kisses him!

A precious love story between a "business couple" whose one-sided feelings aren't as one-sided as they seem!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Asfi is never not busy, so it takes some doing to get her to accept a quest to investigate a mysterious ship that keeps showing up recently. While enduring an endless stream of inexplicable phenomena, the ship takes them to a place that shouldn’t exist—Asfi’s lost homeland.

In the dark corners of a 1920s city where wealth and poverty, dreams and despair all coalesce, a boy named Sangha lives humbly with his beloved little sister. Their fragile happiness is soon shattered by the iron fist of the mafia that rules over the city. Sangha is left broken, sinking into the depths of despair, until someone reaches out to him—a man with a carefree, frivolous smile. What awaits Sangha next, salvation or damnation?!

But precious few have seen its enigmatic boss, Lucy. And so, when she’s targeted by a series of escalating attacks, the suspects are limited. Someone among Amrita’s top brass is a traitor, but who?In the violent, crime-ridden underworld of Broken Ark, everyone knows Amrita—it’s one of the biggest gangs in the city, and also the most philanthropic. But precious few have seen its enigmatic boss, Lucy. And so, when she’s targeted by a series of escalating attacks, the suspects are limited. Someone among Amrita’s top brass is a traitor, but who?

195216.description:
In this modern age where androids are in full swing, romance is all about cost-effectiveness, and a human lover is no longer of any use. In this era, Tsuzure Fuuta was born under the unfortunate star of being allergic to androids. Fuuta strives to be popular with human women. His childhood friend Gabe Ren, who watches over him, secretly promotes herself as a potential girlfriend, but the insensitive Fuuta doesn't notice. Realizing that their love will not bear fruit at this rate, Gabe Ren makes a big decision. She will pretend to be a prototype android that is allergy-resistant and become Fuuta's lover! Will she be able to enjoy her youth without being found out? The double life romantic comedy of a childhood friend and an android begins!

195217.description:
Patricia, daughter of Count Sainraime, was rather happy when her fiancé, Claude, told her he wanted to break off their engagement. She had already prepared perfectly for this day...all the documents that proved that she could receive a certain amount of money as compensation. Claude couldn't believe his eyes, for Patricia was a carefree girl in front of him for a long time. He didn't know that Patricia remembered her previous life as Akiko, an office worker, on her sixteenth birthday. There was no choice for him but to sign the documents. With the money, Patricia bought her parents a second house and headed off to a town far away. She wanted to find a place to work. But when she found a job at a mercenary guild, it was a tough place...!

Elite prosecutor Nakamura Yuki attempts to prosecute the president of an IT company for a heinous traffic accident, but ends up being killed by the powers of darkness. When he comes to, he finds himself faced with a goddess who asks him to "bring order to her world with the power of law." Yuki accepts the proposal and is given the skills to be a guardian of the law, then reincarnates into another world. Each participating manga artist has selected a Fujiko F. Fujio work that he or she loves so much that he or she wants to pay tribute to it! You can also enjoy this collection of Fujiko F. Fujio's gems.

Genji’s way of conquering dungeons is completely different from modern common sense. He ends up lecturing an obnoxious streamer he happens to run into. Various things pile up, and before long, he goes viral all around the world. Today as well, Genji drives his beloved mini truck toward the dungeon.

Lulu, the daughter of a poor merchant, becomes a maid for the Marquis family in exchange for helping her pay off their debts. The head of the family, Gerald, is so impressive that the ladies all admire him, but in front of me, Lulu childhood friend, he's so arrogant and nasty! While she was working engrossed in the job, he attacks her, saying, "Just be honest and let me spoil you," and demands that she sleep with him!? Is that even a maid's job?!

195238.description:
I'll decide my own fate! A plucky young man changes his fate, against all odds! High school student Li Gaolou discovers the Book of Life and Death in his school bag one day. The Book can change his fate. Saving a damsel in distress, making a fortune, becoming powerful… Things he'd never dreamed before are now possible!

A sudden encounter at a college welcome party ignites an instant spark in Yori when he's disarmed by the gentle smile of the diligent Rei. What starts as a simple crush quickly consumes Yori, his desire to be close to Rei intensifying with every passing day, even into his subconscious as vivid, tactile dreams. Then, after a night of revelry, Yori returns to an unbelievable sight: Rei, slumbering peacefully in his bed. This must be the ultimate dream, a chance to finally explore every forbidden sensation. The warmth of Rei's skin, the soft rhythm of his breath, it's all so incredibly real. The line between fantasy and truth shatters in Yori's mind, only to be utterly obliterated by Rei's invitation. Yagami awoke to a stranger towering over him and pleasuring himself?! This soft spoken punk is serious at heart and found himself in a perilous situation. "Hey... Can I kiss you?"

The childhood friend who was supposed to hate him suddenly gives him a kiss that feels so good he could melt...!? High-school students Sota and Ryuji used to be best friends in their childhood. However, something caused the two of them to quarrel. But, bumping heads one day made Sota hear Ryuji's inner voice...!! Plus, despite thinking that Ryuji hated him, what he heard instead was "He's so cute. I wanna kiss him" and other sweet words... The unexpected true feelings of his childhood friend made his heart race...!

Keiichi is a businessman who doesn't get along with his subordinate, Souma, who's always treating him with contempt. But, one day, when Keiichi's down after being dumped by a girl, Souma suddenly kisses him! On top of that, things escalate and they head straight to the bedroom... As Keiichi tries to comprehend how Souma can be so passionate with him... he then suddenly hears Souma's sweet voice as they make love. Keiichi wonders if what he's hearing are Souma's genuine feelings, since they've never gotten along up to that point. With each passing day, Keiichi starts thinking more and more about Souma... 195251.description:
He loves him, but he doesn't know if these feelings are truly his.

In order to get through a bout of writer's block on his latest romance novel, author Aoi Miyashita takes the advice of his editor, Kairi Kurihara, and the two begin a simulated romantic relationship. Aoi hopes that by doing this, he'll be able to understand just how the female protagonist of his story is feeling. He ends up being possessed by her, confusing his own feelings with hers. Are his feelings for Kairi real, or all pretend...? In the meantime, Kairi begins to develop his own special feelings for Aoi whenever the author glances his way or gives him a certain look. Will their relationship end when Aoi finishes writing his novel...?
A wondrous love story between an author and his editor as they engage in a pretend romance all while living under the same roof.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: First released in long strip format with one chapter split into three parts.

195252.description:
This is a heartwarming love story between the class hottie with a heart as pure as gold and a closeted average Joe.
Afraid of being outed, class loner Mitsuru has a goal now that's he's in high school: he wants a boyfriend. He signs up for a dating app, but it isn't long before class heartthrob Jiro catches him checking out other guys. Mitsuru thinks his high school life is over... But it turns out Jiro's into guys, too!

(Source: Renta!)

195256.description:
Desperate to escape his painful past, 24-year-old Hyun-Oh has cut ties with everyone he once knew. But when he unexpectedly runs into Cha-Mi, his former high school friend, Hyun-Oh's world is turned upside down. He does everything in his power to push Cha-Ni away, only for Cha-Ni to insist on sticking around. With no other options, Hyun-Oh fakes a confession of love, hoping it will drive Cha-Ni away for good—only for Cha-Ni to admit he feels the same.

Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country? Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Roah Egleydon is an avid lover of bread, so when a conference takes her to the home of the famous Everrose Bakery, she is determined to get her hands on some delicious baked goods. After a day of waiting in line in the sweltering sun, she finally makes it to the bakery, only to find them all sold out! That's when she meets Klimt, a mysterious, sexy baker who offers her a sample of his sweet cream baguette. Roah is intrigued by this handsome stranger, but is she biting off more than she can chew?

(Source: Tapas)

Ji-Woon, who decided to date the younger man Joo-Hyung, seemed to be having a smooth love life, but...

Yeong-Mo accidentally loses Jin-Cheon's belongings while delivering a package. Feeling sorry, he tries to pay a large amount of compensation, but Jin-Cheon demands something else from Yeong-Mo instead of money... What is the future of Yeong-Mo's butt hidden behind Jin-Cheon's sinister smile?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

195269.description:
Kim Yun didn't mind being the one to confess first, especially since he knew Kwon Yong-Ha felt the same. But "no" wasn't the answer he expected, and he definitely didn't expect his rejector to burst into a fit of sorrowful tears! Yong-Ha clearly wants him, so why is he pushing him away? Yun is determined to find out what kind of strange destiny is keeping them apart, even if he has to drag the truth out of Yong-Ha himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Hachankong Danpyeonseon (하찮공 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Short Stories About Insignificant Tops] What Is His Destiny?
โชคชะตาบ้าอะไรของมันวะเนี่ย
命運這東西，請不要相信

195270.description:
Do-Hyung meets Ji-Won, whom he had a crush on for a long time, at the university he had difficulty entering. However, just as he was puzzled by his slightly different attitude from the Ji-Won he knew, he finds out that he is not Ji-Won, but Ji-Won's younger brother Ji-Hyeok. Ji-Hyeok proposes a one-night stand with a face that resembles his old love, and Do-Hyung is helplessly swept away by him...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ヌードル・オブ・ジ・エンド

195272.description:
Hina, who works part-time at an Izakaya, happens upon an old high-school friend he excommunicated named Shinichiro. Shinichiro was Hina's first crush. Hina always loved Shinichiro for his cool, calm, and kind demeanor, but the fear that Shinichiro would find out led Hina to run away from Shinichiro upon their high school graduation. Resigned to his fate of reunion with Shinichiro, Shinichiro surprisingly forgives Hina for running away and proceeds to interact warmly toward Hina. This display of kindness makes your heart flutter! Though he swears in his heart not to run away again, something happens...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

195273.description:
Karada Sagashi is back! Set in an amusement park after midnight, this latest installment in the hit survival horror series is set to hit theaters in Japan in September 2025 as a live-action film. Don't miss the manga adaptation before the movie drops!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: カラダ探し THE LAST NIGHT

195274.description:
Gaikaku, a genius mage with unparalleled magical prowess, lives in quiet seclusion under the employ of a gluttonous regional lord, Borick. While earning pocket change through secretive assignments, he devotes himself freely to magical research, surrounded by a diverse group of girls from various races. However, after taking down a certain elite elf, his incredible talents as a mage begin to draw attention across the land...!? The ultimate mix of tactical mastery, magical engineering, and knightly valor—a harem fantasy manga adaptation begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Was Found to Be Competent By a Heroic Female Knight and Lead a Beautiful Harem of Knights.

title.native: 英雄女騎士に有能とバレた俺の美人ハーレム騎士団 ガイカク・ヒクメの奇術騎士団
title.romaji: Eiyuu Onna Kishi ni Yuunou to Bareta Ore no Bijin Harem Kishidan: Gaikaku Hikume no Kijutsu Kishidan

195276.description:
A slightly strange boy-meets-girl adventure set on Mars.

(Source: Comic Nora, translated and edited)

195277.description:
A Grand Immortal Venerable, grievously wounded, is forced to descend from the heavens and reincarnate into the body of a mortal scumbag named Jiang Tianchen.

This ten-thousand-year-old virgin suddenly finds himself with a wife and daughter who are being targeted by vicious underworld forces. When they threaten to defile his wife and kidnap his daughter, he doesn't hesitate—he crushes them instantly.

His new philosophy? If the enemy is ruthless, I'll be even more ruthless. For every one that comes, I'll drain them completely dry and turn them all into cultivation resources for myself, my wife, and my daughter.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Reincarnated as a Scumbag, I Use My Wife and Daughter to Prove Immortality

title.native: 转生渣男我带妻女证长生
title.romaji: Zhuansheng Zhanan Wo Dai Qi Nü Zheng Changsheng

195278.description:
Normal things don’t interest Erin, She’s looking for something a little more… fun.

(Source: Toomics)

195279.description:
When Cang Qiong the monk stops a fight between a pair of Loong brothers, he accidentally kills Bai Mo, a Diven Loong. Full of remorse, he spends the next ten years searching for his soul fragments and creating a younger version of Bai Mo using his blood and qi. Their life is peaceful until Bai Rong, another Divine Loong drops in on them uninvited.

(Source: WebComics)

195281.description:
In order to protect his crush, [Cake] Zhuang Cheng, [Fork] Qinghe, who usually lurks around in the dark, follows him one night. Unexpectedly, he discovered his true face—

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

195282.description:
After illegal human replication services begin spreading through the underground, tragedy strikes, a plane crash takes the life of his newlywed wife. Consumed by grief and temptation, he faces an impossible question:
Should he bring her back by copying her? But when memory, identity, and love can all be replicated, one unsettling doubt remains, is the person who returns truly her, or just a perfect imitation?

(Source: Webnovel)

195284.description:
Nobunaga grew up at a dormitory full of long-distance runners training for the Ekiden marathon. He dreams of being a runner, but struggles to take the first step. But when he gets pulled into a race at school, he'll catch the attention of the running club.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195285.description:
After losing her father, the king of Hillvalley, Princess Stella is thrown into the middle of a succession crisis. Her stepsister Illusia wastes no time in trying to assassinate Stella and seize the throne, but all her attempts mysteriously go awry. Little does anyone know that the young princess has a hidden protector…in the most unlikely of places!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 絶対死なないステラ姫

195286.description:
Born with beautiful white hair, Mark is persecuted as the "child of the devil" and has only been kept alive to be offered to the "evil god Nerodias." time...

On the day of the covenant between the evil gods and humans that occurs once every 100 years, Mark is sent to another world where the evil gods live, where he encounters the legendary "evil god" with such great power that he could destroy the world. time...

However, it seems that the legend has been transmitted incorrectly over a long period of time...

The most extreme loner and the strongest loner join hands across the world! time...

Together, they can become endlessly strong! Friendship burst fantasy!

(Source: Suiyoubi no Sirius, translated)

title.native: 大精霊の契約者 ～邪神の供物、最強の冒険者へ至る～
title.romaji: Dai Seirei no Keiyakusha: Jashin no Kumotsu, Saikyou no Boukensha e Itaru

195287.description: Haguro Shoumaru and Nijikawa Jun have known each other since the 3rd grade. With their middle school buddies, they formed their own gang group. Their goal? To become the top gang in the area to attain the right to dig up the "treasure" hidden inside the military base in their town. Legend tells that this treasure was hidden by the once top gang group known as Infinity. Only the strongest have the right to this treasure. With Shoumaru stuck behind bars after covering for his friends, will Nijikawa be able to lead his gang to become the top gang group in the area?

title.native: 転生したオバサンは、枯れヒロイン目指して仕事に生きます
title.romaji: Tensei Shita Oba-san wa, Kare Heroine Mezashite Shigoto ni Ikimasu

title.native: おまつり！ピース電器店

195293.description:
Robou is a corporate drone with an extraordinary passion for giant humanoid robots. One day, he's deeply hurt when a colleague bluntly states, "There's no need for giant humanoid robots." Later that evening, he's approached by a being from another world who pleads with him to "fight using a giant robot." After some hesitation, Robou chooses to reincarnate into this new world. There, he finds himself inhabiting Volcamion—a mighty humanoid mecha revered by the Volcami Empire. Thus begins Robou's second life as a god within a giant robot.

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: 帝国機神ヴォルカミオン

195295.description:
Ami is an alien who worked for a large corporation in a distant galaxy, but because she bad-mouthed the company, she got demoted to the planet Earth. To make matters worse, she crashes her spaceship and loses all means of communication... she is rescued by Aoi, a sex android made to look exactly like an earthling, and reluctantly accepts her help while secretly looking down on her. This is the beginning of an everyday sci-fi yuri manga about a grumpy alien and a clumsy robot.

(Source: Heroes, translated)

title.native: 花とメオト -大正溺愛お伽草子-
title.romaji: Hana to Meoto: Taishou Dekiai Otogizoushi

195298.description:
Kuze is a first-year student at a boarding school attended by the sons of wealthy Japanese families. One day, the serious and good-natured athlete is suddenly nominated to become a Prefect. The nominator is Hanabishi, Royston Academy's biggest playboy. He is one of the richest, smartest, and most talented Prefects in the academy. Why did the student representative's right-hand man nominate him of all people...!? Kuze wasn't a fan of Hanabishi's, but the more he gets to see and know Hanabishi, the more attracted he becomes.

The start of a dramatic love story where the underclassman takes the lead at a school with its own rules and hierarchy!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: プリフェクトの熾火-おきび-

195299.description:
Shin, the third-born prince of the great kingdom of Garche, has lived with his servant Liandros since he was born... and now, Liandros has disappeared. Lia remained loyal despite Shin's "adventures" around the world and all the trouble he'd gotten them in. Unexpectedly shaken by this turn of events, Shin tracks Lia down to the small village of Barako on the fringes of Garche, where ancient religious structures still stand. There, he finds that Lia is receiving some sort of treatment from a suspicious so-called "shaman," and refuses to come home. That's when Shin starts to come down with a mysterious disease specific to the region... This is a story of deep, intense, and eternal love between a reckless prince and his loyal servant.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Irgendwo auf dieser Welt – Die Wiege blauen Himmels

title.english: Cradled by the Wild Blue Yonder
title.native: その世のどこか、蒼天のゆりかご
title.romaji: Sono Yo no Dokoka, Souten no Yurikago

title.native: となりの君は、愛ばっか考えてる
title.romaji: Tonari no Kimi wa, Ai Bakka Kangaeteru

synonyms: はらぺこフルコース ～最高の提案～
Harapeko Full Course: Saikou no Teian

195303.description:
Kirio is a female college student who strives to make a living by broadcasting her visits to haunted places. To gain more views, she heads to an abandoned hospital with a bad reputation, but there she witnesses a showdown between a psychic boy and a vengeful girl...? A little bit scary and super cute! A supernatural comedy♡

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: ハラペコゆうれい禍那子さん

195304.description:
The story is set in the mid-Showa period, shortly after the war. Underwear was nothing more than a practical item, and enjoying it as fashion was considered taboo. Meanwhile, novice female editor Yuri Itokawa comes across a garter bustier at a general store and learns that underwear is an invisible "armor for the soul." In an era where men are deeply superior to women, Yuri struggles to convey the appeal of underwear, but... This is the biography of a woman who dedicated her life to making underwear.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ランジェリー・リリィ
僕の吸血姫を笑わせたい
title.romaji: Boku no Kyuuketsu Hime wo Warawasetai

195306.description:
Barbarus, is a half-human, half-vampire known as a “Varf,” and is literally “invincible.” However, the Varf are looked down upon as low status, and their clan is persecuted. One day, Barbarus succeeds in capturing Princess Regina, after the vampire king Dracul announced that whoever captured her would be granted “unparalleled glory for himself and his clan.” Barbarus attempts to bring the princess to King Dracul to earn the reward, but upon seeing her, his appetite becomes uncontrollable—!?

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

195307.description:
After a drunken one-night stand, Susannah finds herself involved with an insatiable man. “I can’t stop thinking about you. I’m yours now.” When she retches violently at a party and repeatedly kicks him, he purses his mouth in a self-satisfied smirk.

(Source: WebComics)

195308.description:
The hapless salaryman named Gu Qianwang was chosen by the Demon Lord to become his human vessel in our world. He was intimidated by his newfound powers, but they also opened new opportunities for him. As he became the center of attention for the women at his company, he realizes that his workplace might not be as simple as it seemed. With the help of the Demon Lord and his women, Gu Qianwang tries to uncover the mystery hidden deep within his company.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Devil Teaches You How to Be a Human

title.romaji: Mowang Jiao Ni Zenme Zuo Ren

title.english: The Vampire and the Chocolatier: A Genius Alchemist's Sweet Obsession
title.native: 吸血鬼とショコラティエ～天才錬金術師の甘美な探究～
title.romaji: Kyuuketsuki to Chocolatier: Tensai Renkinjutsushi no Kanbi na Tankyuu

title.native: 虐げられた青年が大精霊に寵愛されて幸せになった話
title.romaji: Shiitagerareta Seinen ga Dai Serie ni Chouai Sarete Shiawase ni Natta Hanashi

195311.description:
High-schooler Narumi Minorikawa becomes an orphan after losing his mother. One day, his grandfather whom he never knew comes to offer incense and shares he'd like Narumi to take over the company he is managing. However the company he's talking about ends up being a yakuza organization...?! Suddenly addressed as "Bocchan," the once lonely Narumi begins to gradually open his heart up to the kind wakagashira, Ioroi, who is in charge of his daily needs. In fact, as they spend every day close together, Narumi becomes obsessed with the "charm of an adult man" that he awakens to for the first time in his life. Every day, he strives to appeal to Ioroi, but...?!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195312.description:
In an alternate reality, the Republic of Korea is a constitutional monarchy ruled by the royal family of the Joseon Dynasty (1392-). One day, the shocking announcement is made that the Crown Prince has suddenly died, and the identity of the next in line to the throne is shrouded in mystery. The new Crown Prince is unmarried but expected to attend his coronation ceremony with his significant other, but instead of the beautiful entertainer and daughter of a powerful CEO with whom he was romantically linked, the prince again shocks the nation with a profession of love for another – but who can it be? A plucky, savvy, young reporter Leejin Choi vows to get to the bottom of the story finds that she is strangely connected to the prince.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: คำขอแต่งงานขององค์ชายรัชทายาท

195313.description:
Kotone, who possessed the power to hear other people's inner thoughts, lived with anger and suffering in a constrained world due to her ability. After meeting the pure-hearted and kind Yuka, Kotone began finding joy in her daily life. However, Yuka had a serious problem...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195314.description:
Seven years after leaving the Herbet Empire to escape her selfish mother, Rosena Estalot returns seeking treatment for her sick son, Illion. There, she reunites with Yerhan, the third prince of the empire and Illion's father. When Yerhan proposes marriage, Rosena, reluctant to reenter high society and confront her mother again, agrees on one condition: an eventual divorce. With Rosena so set on pushing him away, can Yerhan win her heart before their marriage runs its course?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 俺はヒロインになれません。破！
title.romaji: Ore wa Heroine ni Naremasen. Ha!

195317.description:
The powerful Duke Reynal von Fenicaesar is known as the empire’s hero and the Emperor’s right hand, but his greatest secret is that he was born with both male and female reproductive organs! Under the guise of a sabbatical, he attempts to fulfill his desire to conceive his own heir. However, this proves to be more difficult than expected as ordinary seed isn't enough to impregnate him. Reynal searches for a man with superior seed to father his child, but is the perfect partner closer than he realizes?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

195318.description:
Murai, who could no longer play in the upcoming soccer match due to an injury, was heading home earlier than usual on crutches when he encountered Oniyama from his class…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195319.description:
When his first love breaks his heart, college student Fusuke goes to a bar to drown his sorrows, where he meets a guy named Seri and drunkenly tumbles into bed with him. Now, Fusuke's no stranger to one-night stands, but it was always with girls before! Struggling to process everything the morning after, he bails out of the hotel room...only to find out later that Seri is his new stepbrother?! And what's worse, his dad's being transferred overseas and taking his new wife along, so now Fusuke has to live with Seri?! To Fusuke's dismay, Seri clearly has no plans of keeping his hands to himself, but despite all appearances also won't admit to having romantic intentions...and soon enough Fusuke is at his wit's end just trying to keep his head on straight!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

195320.description:
Sacher Blythe, desperate to live a long and peaceful life, fails to avoid the future demon king, Phelan Exa Drozen. But Phelan knows more than he should…he recognizes Sacher as an "outsider”--someone from another world who knows the future and wants to kill him. So Phelan proposes a truce and Sacher agrees, hopefully preventing him from becoming the demon king. But this agreement keeps Phelan closer than Sacher would like...and their reluctant friendship is quickly turning into something more.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 俺の友達が魔王になるかもしれません

title.english: I Think My Friend's Going to Become the Demon King
title.native: 내 친구가 마왕이 될 것 같다
title.romaji: Nae Chinguga Mawangi Doel Geon Gatda

title.english: Brotherhood Failed Successfully: Happily Ever After

195324.description:
As a young girl, Sasha Corsico was saved from the jaws of a monster by the cold Prince, Paris Vladimiro, who requested a binding promise in return. To survive the injuries she sustained, her family turned to sorcery that saved her life, but unfortunately transformed her into a vampire incapable of facing daylight. A decade later, Paris, cursed with poisonous blood, suffers with his title, as a stream of new brides die at the touch of his lips. He now collects on his promise with Sasha, requesting her to become his wife, as Princess Consort. She obliges, while the very sorcerer who made her what she is, warns her: "Be wary of humans with poisonous blood."

Adjusting to palace life, suffering Paris's family, Sasha is out of her element, having to hide her physical condition. However, she can't resist her attraction to Paris, who suffers from the scars of a dark past, but slowly opens up to Sasha. As love and care blossoms, will this couple find a way to overcome all of their troubles?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: L'amour peut-il s'épanouir dans un cœur empoisonné ?

title.english: Can Love Blossom in a Poisoned Heart?
title.native: 伯爵令嬢は孤独な王子を守りたい
title.romaji: Hakushaku Reijou wa Kodokuna Ouji wo Mamoritai

195325.description:
Prepare for cuteness overload with Su Mianmian, a three-and-a-half-year-old metaphysics wonder! Cradling her milk bottle, she's a fortune-telling sensation, adored by the nation's wealthiest family. Whether she's exposing scandals live on air, banishing evil, or revealing hidden fates, she's a force to be reckoned with. Villains beware: one flick of her wrist and a well-placed talisman will put you in your place! This pint-sized powerhouse, with a thousand years of cultivation, dishes out epic comebacks and spreads joy. The internet is obsessed, demanding new chapters: "The ultimate adorable badass? Sign me up!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Adorable Toddler Fortune Teller Everyone Adores

title.english: This Toddler Is A Fortune Teller
title.native: 姑奶奶三岁半，捧奶瓶算命全网宠
title.romaji: Gunainai San Sui Ban, Peng Naiping Suanming Quanwang Chong

195326.description:
Ysabel and a stranger named Xavier make a deal to get married as a means to survive a scandal. She thinks he's a rich, handicapped man who's still stuck on his crush who has passed away. Turns out he's not disabled and is madly in love with her.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Can't Escape From My Contract Husband's Doting Love

195327.description:
When Anomaly Zones descend across the globe, terror becomes the new normal. Twisted anomalies stalk the streets, and only the Exorcists, humans who dare to fight back, stand between survival and annihilation. But to truly end the madness, they must conquer the core world behind each Zone… and most never return. As humanity teeters on the edge, Chu Sheng awakens a game-breaking Custom Cheat-Shop System. Every time he enters a new Zone, he chooses a powerful ability, tailored to dominate the horrors within. While other Exorcists struggle just to survive, the monsters kneel before him. This is the story of a man who turns Anomaly Zones into his personal playground.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Global Horror: I Activated a Cheat Custom Mall

title.english: Global Horror: My Cheat System Shop
title.native: 全球惊悚：我开启外挂自选商城
title.romaji: Quanqiu Jingsong: Wo Kaiqi Waigua Zixuan Shangcheng

195328.description:
Claire, a young girl who grew up in a greenhouse, finds an injured bat. Unexpectedly, the bat, who looks like an angel, turns out to be a vampire who has lived for over a thousand years.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wenshi Li De Ke Lai Er

195329.description:
The world's number one ranked player in the AOS game League of Infinity and known as the devil of the battlefield, Choi Kang-in. However, Choi Kang-in, who had been in a slump due to a car accident and was abandoned by everyone, was approached by the man in the golden mask and made a proposition. "If you go back, can you become the world champion?" Choi Kang-in, who returned to the past, becomes the maestro who commands the battlefield between Earth and another world's planet and shows off his best play ever.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 現代コミック　楳図かずお集

195332.description:
The Beautiful Yet Cruel Witch Trial Begins!!

Ema, a high school girl, finds herself imprisoned in a jail. When the warden’s voice echoes through the prison, the curtain rises on a cruel game.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
195332.hashtag: #まのさば #魔法少女ノ魔女裁判

195334.description:
Everyone's talking about how troublemaker Demian Haxen's suddenly become a devoted son and brother. What they don't realize is that he's returned to the past after spending decades as the brainwashed death knight of Dorgo, the archlich who murdered Demian's family. Given a second chance at life, Demian's out to power up and protect his family to defeat Dorgo when he comes to conquer the world. But will Demian alone be enough to prevent the apocalypse? Or will his failure mean death for them all?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Return of the Apocalypse-Class Death Knight

195335.description:
Beppu Kei is a manga artist who is busy with work. Yui Aramoto, a craft beer connoisseur, invites her out for drinks. Delicious beer is the bond between women and friendship!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: 今日もビールでがんばらない～ユイとケイのカンパイリセット～
title.romaji: Kyou mo Beer de Ganbaranai: Yui to Kei no Kanpai Reset

195336.description:
One day, Hana, a farmer's daughter, receives a visit at her home from Homare, a young soldier in uniform. Homare then tells her that he came because he was informed today was to be his wedding ceremony..

(Source: emaqi)

title.english: The Soldier Groom and the Daikon Bride
title.native: 軍人婿さんと大根嫁さん

195337.description:
GV actor Ho-Jun visits a quiet rural village for filming. Due to the manager's mistake about the date of his stay, he ends up staying at the house of Sang-Geun, a resident of the village. Sang-Geun, an innocent country boy, begins to feel more and more curious about Ho-Jun, who lives in a completely different world from his own...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195338.description:
Her heart and her gaze will never mingle...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2024-02

195339.description:
In a desperate moment when he falls off a cliff, chased by suspicious people, Damian is caught in a dazzling light and falls to country K. As soon as he regains consciousness, Damian saves Yedam, who was in danger after being caught by a stalker, and somehow ends up living with Yedam...

The unpredictable, uncommunicative life of two people living together, and romance! A prince from another world lives in our house~!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

195340.description:
For as long as he can remember, Ha Na-Deul has been tangled up with Ju Seok in everything he does. Tests, competitions, group projects, student rankings, you name it. And every single time, Na-Deul loses first place to him by just a hair. All Na-Deul wants is freedom, counting down the days until high school graduation so he can finally escape his infuriating rival. But fate has other plans. As a fortune teller once warned, “He is someone who will stick to you even in death.” Sure enough, the two end up at the same university. One night, while Na-Deul is working a part time shift at a convenience store, Ju Seok shows up looking teary eyed and suddenly confesses. From that day on, Ju Seok launches an all out, shameless love offensive. And the more Na-Deul tries to run, the more the two become hopelessly intertwined.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Don't Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge

title.english: Do Not Throw Stones at the Stone Bridge

195341.description:
I was reborn... as a background character in a romance game?! And my fiancé is a hot duke?!

Reincarnated as 'Leticia', a background character in a game, I found out that my twin sister, who has a horrible personality, pawned her fiancé, Lionel, off on me. When I first met Lionel, he was just as chubby as I'd heard... But I soon realized he was a diamond in the rough and decided to make him shine! But that's when I discovered that my newly hot fiancé is acting like he's head over heels for me...!

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: Although I Am a Mob Character, I'm Being Doted on by an Overprotective Duke
Mon beau duc n'est pas qu'un simple figurant !
明明是配角卻被過度保護的公爵深深溺愛？

title.english: How is This Hot Duke Just a Background Character?!
title.native: モブなのに過保護な公爵に溺愛されています
title.romaji: Mob Nanoni Kahogo na Koushaku ni Dekiai Sareteimasu

195342.description:
Amelia was born a princess, but has never been treated as one for her entire life. After her mother’s tragic death, she spends her days being abused by her half-siblings. The only time she is treated as a princess is for a political marriage to Noam, the emperor of Saulverka. Freed from her family’s clutches, Amelia is ready to put her past behind her... until she learns about the truth behind her mother’s death. With fury and a mysterious magic simmering in her blood, Amelia begins her journey to achieve revenge against her half-siblings.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Editor note: This comic contains depictions of domestic violence, non-consensual sexual acts, and incest.

title.native: 政略婚皇后は復讐の毒に咲く

195343.description:
Keitha is an ideal woman: adored for her beauty, obedient to her father, and faithful to her fiance. However, when she sees her fiance wooing another woman, she realizes that her thoughts and desires are disrespected by the people around her. As she struggles to end her engagement, unexpected aid comes in the form of Seyard, a kind and thoughtful man who listens to her with respect. When Seyard offers her a contract marriage as an escape route, Keitha is delighted to take his hand. However, Seyard might not be the man she thinks he is…

(Source: Tappytoon)

195344.description:
Giselle Florette wakes up in a grovel romance where the male leads and villains alike torment her until her ultimate death. To avoid meeting the same ending, Giselle decides to act out and show she's not one to be messed with. Little did she know, this would catch the eye of Duke Vientin Kallinos, the infamous "Bloody Mastermind," who proposes a contractual marriage. With her newfound audacity and unexpected supporter, will Giselle fend off those who wronged her and rewrite her tragic fate?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Female Protagonist of This Regretful Story Is Mentally Strong
Unshakable Female Lead in Regret Genre
The Unbreakable Mind of the Regret-Genre Heroine

195345.description:
Raised as the perfect assassin for her captor's revenge, Ayla finally learns the truth of her kidnapping as she takes her dying breath. When she wakes up again years in the past, she vows then and there to turn his own plan for vengeance against him. But as she begins to unravel his plot, she discovers that she was just a small pawn in an even greater scheme. With so much at stake, will Ayla succeed in her revenge? Or will she be dragged further into something she never wanted to be a part of?

(Source: Tapas)

195346.description:
Mint Limnades has clawed her way to the top of Niflheim Prison––a brutal, lawless jungle where only the strongest survive. Now the undisputed boss of the block, she’s offered freedom by the warden in exchange for one last job: turn the handsome, wide-eyed newcomer, Helios, into the next leader. The catch? She has to go undercover in a men’s prison. Will this kingmaker succeed in shaping her lost lamb into a boss, or are they both doomed to be crushed by the savagery of prison hierarchy?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became a Dead Character in a Prison for Wastes
I Became a Leader in a Wretched Prison

195347.description:
Desperate for quick cash, Wu-jeong Cheon takes a high-paying temporary gig aboard a luxury cruise ship. When high-profile passenger Sa Gong-Jun offers to hire him on the spot for a personal job, Wu-Jeong thinks his financial troubles are solved. But a fatal misunderstanding reveals Gong-Jun’s true intention: he wasn’t looking for a translator, but complete, humiliating physical submission. Trapped at sea with a ruthless man who demands his total surrender, Wu-Jeong’s life quickly veers into uncharted waters. As coercion blurs the line between resentment and desire, he finds himself ensnared in a dangerous bittersweet addiction.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195348.description:
Workaholic Tae-Sung Kim quits his corporate job to drive a taxi. After helping his first passenger catch her cheating husband, he turns his cab into a makeshift detective agency. That's when gangster Jin-U Hwang gets in, seeking help to find his unfaithful missing boyfriend.

(Source: Manta)

195349.description:
“Unlike a mean person, a gentleman does not conform to his innate nature. Are you a gentleman or a mean person?”

Wu Yi-Chae, who has been secretly in love with the emperor for a long time, is about to marry him and spends his wedding night in a sweet dream. However, the indifferent emperor seems completely uninterested in sex. Furthermore, he lectures him on the ways of a gentleman on their wedding night, so Wu Yi-Chae thinks he is merging with a Confucius who has jumped out of the grave. The emperor is always busy escaping both physically and mentally. Will Wu Yi-Chae be able to win his love?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

195351.description:
“It’s not the CEO’s child.”

Noh Hye-Ji, a dirt spoon who is bitter about being homeless. But I’m a guide spoon! And I’m a S-class contact guide. I’ve been working as the dedicated guide and secretary for Han Kang-Hyun, the strongest S-class esper in existence, and I’ve been saving money for 6 years. Ta-da, I’m pregnant!

[If A neglects contraception and becomes pregnant with B’s child, this contract will be terminated as soon as B finds out.]

[B can claim damages from A for violating this clause.]

So that means the CEO just needs to not know?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

195352.description:
Sian Lee is fated to die in May, the same month her family was massacred. As the curse draws near, a dangerous man named Gon Tae offers to save her. "Say it," he whispers. "Tell me you want to live." In his obsession, all he asks in return is a promise to share life and death with him.

(Source: Manta)

195353.description:
Kim Jun-Bae, a perennial police exam candidate from Yongdu-dong who is a corpse if you take away his sense of justice.

(Source: Toomics, translated)

195354.description:
Xie Jincheng had been a selfless and kind person his whole life, but in the end, he was betrayed by his friends and family and met a tragic end. After being reborn, Xie Jincheng declared: “As long as my heart, liver, spleen, and lungs are all rotten, no one can bully me anymore!”

Yun Rong had waited for a hundred years, finally seeing Xie Jincheng return. However, in this life, Xie Jincheng no longer regarded him as his beloved.

195355.description:
Lee-Hyeon, an intern, drops by the convenience store on his way home from work and there's something different about the part-timer.

"She's not wearing anything right now, right?"

I'm so confused...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

195356.description:
Song Ye-eun is a bright and cheerful junior associate on the legal team at LX Pharmaceuticals, hiding a secret that has kept her from ever having a real relationship. When her colleague, the charming company lawyer Jeong Jaemin, accidentally discovers her most private insecurity, Ye-eun braces herself for humiliation.

But instead of mocking her, Jaemin, who has always seemed like the perfect gentleman, makes an unexpected offer to help “fix” it. What starts as an awkward, impulsive promise quickly turns into something neither of them can control. Beneath Jaemin’s polite smile is a possessive, determined man who’s willing to tear down every wall Ye-eun puts up to win her heart and claim her completely.

This sizzling office romance follows two people as lust becomes love, secrets turn into confessions, and a woman learns to trust a man’s gentle hands and unwavering devotion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195357.description:
"Even if it's a love that will never come true."

Inukai Touma works at the bar "Hatsu Uguisu". The person he is in love with is the older cook, Yanagi Yukiharu. However, Yanagi has always had someone in his heart. Wanting Yanagi to notice him, Inukai makes a move on a drunk Yanagi. He knew he could never replace the "person" he loves...

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shots “Ningen no Oisha-san (ニンゲンのお医者さん)” and “Aka ni Majiwatte Akaku Naru (朱に交わって赤くなる),” and one extra chapter.

195359.description:
After her sister turns up dead as the latest bride of a monstrous, exiled prince, Louanne is assigned to take her place and hopes to uncover the truth. The prince initially refuses her, but with her magical powers, she begins to heal his pain each night while concealing her own. Meanwhile, her evil uncle, who took advantage of her ability in order to run a medical scheme at home, begins to crumble. Has Louanne truly escaped her cursed family, or is she stepping into something darker at Sable Manor?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195363.description:
At age three, Tafelina Lowell Lera Duval was disowned by her birth parents, but was that actually a blessing in disguise? Raised in a remote region of Ozeria by the kind earl of Peylon, she was allowed to hunt in a forest full of monsters, invent magic tools based on memories of her previous life, and let her extraordinary magical talents flourish. But that all begins to change with the approach of her thirteenth birthday. As the child of a noble, she’s obligated to attend an academy meant to raise and educate the next generation of nobles. That means moving to the royal capital, a sprawling city quite unlike her beloved home. Lera soon feels like a fish out of water, and things only get worse with kidnappings, the appearance of her half sister, and more. But Lera’s not one to be disheartened easily and that isn’t about to change!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

A smarter man would have reformed his ways after being sent to juvie, but not Dennis. He's long since been too infatuated with the thrill of committing crimes and enacting violence. And when Dennis' uncle approaches him with another odd job, they're both shocked to learn that the payout may just leave them filthy rich. Their journey to dig up the treasures of the Crescent Coast begins!

(Source: Tapas)

195367.description:
Hart Bolton, the legendary first duke of House Bolton, has haunted his estate for over a century as a ghost. For the last five years, he's watched over Dolly Lopez, the head housemaid. When Hart wishes they could be together forever, fate grants his desire unexpectedly. After the current duke is poisoned at a ball, Hart awakens in his body. Now possessing the same face but a different soul, Hart must navigate this second chance at life while hiding his true identity from the woman he loves, who assumes his sudden interest is merely a passing whim.

(Source: Tappytoon)

195368.description:
Tae-U and Ji-Eun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Ji-Eun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Tae-U’s feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place. When Ji-Eun develops a crush on a handsome classmate, things start to get even more complicated between the two of them as Tae-U begins to try to beat out his new competitor and take his longtime friendship with Ji-Eun to the next level.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

195369.description:
On his 20th birthday, Li Xianyu inherits his father's legacy: a house, some cash, and a magical pearl. Thinking it might grant him powers, he swallows it whole. Instead of becoming a god, he gives birth to his great-grandmother.

Second-year high school student Otonashi Seiya holds himself back in his studies, but he is constantly reminded of his father's expectations. Akane (29), who has devoted her life to work and hobbies, hit it off with Izumi (27), a beauty salon employee, at a matchmaking party. They became friends and started attending matchmaking events together. Izumi seemed like a sociable and lovely person... but her true form is an ultra predatory “dangerous woman," greedily sharpening her claws in search of other people's boyfriends to be her prey! She looked down on Akane's partner, Daiki, saying he's unattractive with a low income... but when she finds out that he is actually a high-spec man, her attitude changes drastically. Genjirou Momoyama is a poor and unpopular omega, and suppressants don't work on him. Every time his heat comes, he has to go to an omega shelter, and it's tough. Genjirou, tempted by the reward, agrees to be Sakurada's subject, but starts getting tired of Sakurada's research and constant monitoring...! After his mother's death, Hikaru has a change of heart, and stops being delinquent. He starts looking for a decent job, but he never passes the final interviews and keeps failing. A sudden recruiting email he receives is like pennies from heaven, so he goes to the interview. There, a handsome man, Louis, appears and Hikaru is transferred to another world. Louis reveals his true appearance as a huge dragon and informs Hikaru that they are in the kingdom of miracles. Now the dragon's mark appears on Hikaru's belly, and he is told that he has been chosen as a bride of the Dragon King!

(Source: Takeshobo)

Teng, originally a beautiful flower god, thoroughly became malicious in this world. The heroine who died in a car accident, her body is occupied by another girl, all this is a trap for Teng? In a world of hunters, monsters, and dungeons, Ina is just an ordinary Korean woman--and she wouldn’t have it any other way. Ina was a spiritualist in her previous life, but now she can finally enjoy a peaceful world... or so she thought. One day, after touching a mysterious egg found in a dungeon, Ina reawakens her S-rank spiritualist ability! With her new spirit companions, a couple of troublemakers named Iz and Rika, will Ina ever fulfill her dream of living a quiet life?

Arnold and Ah Qiu are down-on-their-luck freelance couriers, barely getting by in their rickety spaceship. Soul is dropped into a dimension where everyone's screaming about a status window he can't see. On top of that, his pet rat, who also got dropped in with him, turns out to be a beastman and a powerful awakener... And in love with him?! 195396.description:
Devastated by his lover Henry's sudden death, Victor gets drunk and steals his coffin from his grave. The last thing he remembers is bringing it back to his lab before blacking out. But when Victor wakes up, he's confronted by three men who claim that he revived them from the dead using Henry's head, heart, and crown jewels! Although none of them are Henry, all of them are drawn to Victor in different ways... Can Victor's three new lovers fill the hole in his life that Henry left behind?

(Source: Tappytoon)

195397.description:
Yi-Hyun, beloved daughter of a wealthy family, has loved A-list actor Seo-An for years. When an arranged marriage lands her with him, she can't believe her luck! However, Seo-An insists on a temporary marriage and to divorce later. As secrets unravel, will their union stay "temporary"?

(Source: Manta)

195398.description:
Burned-out from his job, Paul rents a remote cabin, Hide Mansion, to get away from everyone and everything. However, his plan to numb out is derailed when he finds a strange, albeit cute, intruder raiding his fridge. But Gerard’s petite frame belies his supernatural strength and thirst for blood. Paul hardly believes this doe-eyed boy is a vampire until the fangs are in his neck and a warm rush rouses his senses. Can the two misfits learn to live full lives, or will they drink each other dry?

(Source: Tapas)

195399.description:
Although Japan was once called a developed country, its economy continued to stagnate after the war, and before they knew it, the country had become an "economic slave" to other countries. One day, the Prime Minister felt a sense of crisis about the situation and introduced the "Abandoned Citizens Relief Law." It contained shocking content, including the abolition of all social welfare, including public assistance, elderly pensions, and medical insurance. Faced with a policy that was sure to provoke opposition, the government presented a relief plan... a plan to select "productive citizens" through a game...

195400.description:
Strange things have been happening to Lee Yuan lately. Fainting spells, waking up with strangers in his bed, lost memories…for someone who wants to live an uneventful life, he sure has been busy lately. That’s when his friend Do-Yoon makes a confession: though he may look normal, Do-Yoon is in fact a reaper sent to earth to retrieve a ghost who refuses to move on. And just who should that ghost be possessing? You guessed it! The only way to send a spirit up to the afterlife is to satisfy its needs, and Do-Yoon is determined to suck the spirit right out of Yuan in more way than one…

Long ago, humans evolved into beasts and then into something else.
