195468.description:
The "Angels" are beautiful messengers of God, with pearl-colored hair and eyes. Those who receive the protection of an angel are called "Saints," and have the power to heal people. Despite being born into a prestigious family that has produced many saints, Niella does not have holy powers, and as a result, her family calls her "useless" and hates her for even being alive. But no matter how hellish her days, Niella continues to offer up devout prayers to God. One day, her parents, wanting Niella to give birth to a saint, decided on a husband for her. She thought that no one would need her, despised as useless... this is the story of a fateful love between a devout girl and an angel.

(Source: Comic Etoile, translated)

title.native: 囚われ聖女の祈りは届く～役立たずな私でも、麗しの天使様に愛されていいですか？～
title.romaji: Toraware Seijo no Inori wa Todoku: Yakutatazuna Watashi demo, Uruwashi no Tenshi-sama ni Aisa rete Ii desu ka?

195469.description:
A collection of early Hanako Yamada one-shots.

1. Kami no Warufuzake (神の悪フザケ)
2. Hanako no Joshi Kousei Nikki (花子の女子高生日記)
3. Kodomo Tengoku (こども天国)
4. Natural Kid (ナチュラルキッド)
5. Baka no Jidai (バカの時代)
6. Gongitsune (ごんぎつね)

195470.description:
"Ah, how pure. After all, you are the only one for me..."
Unemployed and with no relatives or boyfriend, Ichika is all alone in the world. One day, she suddenly finds herself marrying her childhood friend Ryo, the heir to one of Japan's leading companies. When she sees him again for the first time in years, it seems he had some something happen in his past. Touched by Ichika's honest kindness, Ryo begins to open up to her, but his love for her gradually becomes abnormal... the story of an obsessive, doting younger man and a cheerful, innocent woman in her thirties; a complicated married life!

(Source: Ride-On, translated)

title.native: 年下御曹司の執着婚～訳ありエリートの危険な溺愛～
title.romaji: Toshishita Onzoushi no Shuuchaku Kon: Wakeari Elite no Kiken na Dekiai

195471.description:
Harukawa-san's troublesome classmate, Fukimaki-kun, discovers that she's not human. In exchange for keeping this fact a secret, Fujimaki-kun presents a certain "request"!?

(Source: Shounen Jump+)

title.native: かいじゅうのつかいかた
ドルおじ ＃ドールに沼ったおじさんの話
title.romaji: Doll Oji #Doll ni Hamatta Oji-san no Hanashi

195473.description:
Aya Tsuchida is a woman in her 30s who has never worn makeup and distrusts other people. Her colleagues at work and passerby give her strange looks, which makes her feel even more self-loathing. Then, a man who looks like a prince from a foreign land appears...!? "I'll turn you from a mole into a butterfly. I'll change your life dramatically!" The man turns out to be a famous, world-renowned makeup artist...!? And from there, Aya's life changes...

(Source: Funguild, translated)

title.native: 異国のプリンスは地味子を愛でる。
title.romaji: Ikoku no Prince wa Jimiko wo Mederu.

195474.description:
Matsuda Genki, who wants to be a full-time househusband, is trying his best to find a wife, but to no avail. Then, at a matchmaking party, he meets a woman named Ryo who catches his eye. Genki is attracted to Ryo and, with the help of alcohol, proposes to her! However, Genki is weak to alcohol and passes out. When he wakes up, he is in Ryo's parents' house. Ignoring Genki's confusion, Ryo introduces Genki to his relatives as his fiancé and goes on to declare, "I want him to be the next head brewer at Ayuhara Sake Brewery!"

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

195475.description:
Yoishi, the bar owner, feels sorry for the poor food that adventurers eat. One day, he begins to search for a way to cook the bitter and inedible "stone walnuts" that can be found in the labyrinth of the city for a group of rookie adventurers...? A chef and a variety of labyrinth ingredients dramatically change the humble food situation in another world in this thrilling tale of a successful bar!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195477.description:
Today, as always, Yasuda was dealing with her friend Saya's chuunibyou delusions, when suddenly a magic circle is activated and the two are transported to the demon realm!
What's worse, Saya is welcomed by the demons and chooses to become the Demon Lord without hesitation—
In order to bring her friend back, Yasuda barges unarmed into the Demon Lord's Castle, however...

Friendship is what's really important, right?
The unarmed rescue battle comedy begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195479.description:
28 year old otaku Suzuki Tsukako visits a marriage consulting office, but the counselor there is a shinigami who forces a contract on her and tells her that she can't get married in a year she'll die.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

195480.description:
Mayu is a girl who was chosen by her idol, the magical girl Hisame-senpai, to be her successor. The stronger a girl's sense of shame, the stronger she becomes. But after a battle with Noktan, a resident of the demon world, Hisame-senpai lost all sense of shame and became comfortable appearing in public dressed almost naked. Having been chosen as her successor, Mayu transforms her shame, which had her on the verge of death from embarrassment, into power and challenges the battle.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Magical Girls Become Stronger Through Shame

title.native: 魔法少女は羞恥心で強くなる
title.romaji: Mahou Shoujo wa Shuuchishin de Tsuyokunaru

195482.description: After committing suicide with his friends, a man finds himself on a paradisiacal island…

195483.description:
A desirable man with wealth, ability, devilish charm, and a shining appearance called a masterpiece painstakingly created by God, the successor of Mayoon Group, Ma Sung-Hoon. However, he had a fatal weakness that women detest. Kang Deok-Sim, a woman who was sent to put to rest the rumors surrounding Sung-Hoon that his lower body was bad, that he was a eunuch, and that he was gay. Starting today, she must be reborn as a picky and boring middle-aged female secretary and survive by his side. For 1 billion and to see his handsome face!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
synonyms: 秘書の私とイケメン会長

195484.description:
The main character, Tobiya, is approached by a young girl at a public swimming pool.... The subtleties of a man's heart stirred by an innocent girl are portrayed with fresh talent in this 34 page one-shot!

(Source: Comic Action, translated)

195485.description:
Joseon's finest perfumer.

Meet Arisol, the first female perfumer and aromatherapist of the Joseon Dynasty. Under the reign of King Seongjong, she cultivates her own plants and manages the perfumery of the royal court. Will she find love and success as she navigates her role as the scent master?

(Source: Manta)

195487.description:
The creaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, a goblin who hates humans, and Lee-Ho, who loves humans, begins.

Su-Hwa, a brush goblin who lost her family and power due to human betrayal. When she meets the foolish grand prince Lee-Ho by chance, she finds that her strength has been restored and decides to grant his wish to fully restore her strength. The wish of the foolish young man Lee Ho, who laughs and calls himself the neighborhood drummer, is to reveal the truth about his mother's death. The shaky cooperation between Su-Hwa, who hates humans, and Lee Ho, who loves humans, begins, but as they spend more time together, memories of her past life begin to come to Su-Hwa's mind little by little. Those are also painful and painful memories related to Lee-Ho...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

195488.description:
Human Drama about a man who meets a cute girl on a dating app and quickly they fall for each other. However the girl lies about her job in her profile, saying she's in the fashion industry when she is in fact working as a prostitute. Eventually she reveals the truth to him, asking him: "Even if I date you, I won't quit my job. Can you still be with me?"

He decides to stay with her but this decision is the start of soul-eating inner turmoil of dealing with the knowledge that his beloved girlfriend is giving her body to other men.

title.romaji: Boku no Kanojo wa Haru wo Uru

195489.description:
Welcome to Hoseon: The land of myths and spirits, where monsters take human form and exorcists come with assault rifles! For wandering spirit hunter Gal Park, sniffing out and dispatching disgruntled monsters and spirits is all part of the job – no matter if they prey on the wicked or the innocent alike. But everything becomes a little more complicated when he crosses paths with his former comrades at the Bureau of Exorcists. Not to mention, there’s something afoot in the Dragon King’s Underwater Palace, and a mysterious red-haired girl who can see right through spirits in disguise…

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: A hero with a Minus charm value is popular with beautiful monster girls

title.native: 魅力値マイナスの勇者が美少女モンスターにはモテモテだった件
title.romaji: Miryokuchi Minus no Yuusha ga Bishoujo Monster ni wa Motemote Datta Ken

title.native: 勇者が召喚できません!
八男って、それはないでしょう! みそっかす
title.romaji: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou! Misokkasu

title.native: 八男って、それはないでしょう! みそっかす
title.romaji: Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou! Misokkasu

title.native: ボクは光の国の転生皇子さま!～溺愛する家族と精霊の加護と共に、ボクの天然チートでお助けします!～,
title.romaji: Boku wa Hikari no Kuni no Tensei Ouji-sama! Dekiai suru Kazoku to Seirei no Kago to Tomoni Boku no Tennen Cheat de Otasuke Shimasu!

195497.description:
She is a forensic expert who died in vain and time-traveled back a hundred years ago, while he is an ambitious director of the Department of Military and Police. A shocking massacre rocked the city, leading to a twenty-year-old world-shaking mystery. Witness how she handles the vicious fights within the family, and how, together with the handsome director, they crack the puzzling crimes. Together, they are invincible!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Young Marshal Is Jealous Every Day 2: Young Marshal Is the Concentrated Vinegar
The Young Marshal Is Jealous Every Day 2: Young Master Is the Elite in Jealousy
転生少女とヤキモチ少将の謎解き事件簿

title.native: 少帅每天都在吃醋2:少帅是醋精
title.romaji: Shaoshuai Meitian Dou Zai Chicu 2: Shaoshuai Shi Cu Jing

195498.description:
Lucian arrives in a world overrun with monsters as a Sorcerer. It's common knowledge that Sorcerers have short lifespans, because forbidden magic feeds on life force. But the truth is, Lucian can't die and his organs can regenerate, but nobody knows that. When he casts hundreds of forbidden spells at once, everyone is completely blown away!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I ! I’m the Strongest Forbidden Spellcaster in History

title.english: I Became the Strongest Forbidden Mage
title.romaji: Wo! Shishang Zui Qiang Jin Zhou Shi

195499.description:
"I built your body just the way I like it."

A seemingly innocent offer from a coworker to help Itsuwa get in shape turns devious. All he wanted was a fit, muscular body to impress the ladies with, but his trainer has other plans. Tonight's dinner special is…him?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: むしゃぶりつきたい、ごちそうくん

195500.description:
"Show me that cute face of yours more often."

A bachelor castle master and a courageous, skillful ninja come together in this sweet master and servant love story!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: A Kiss for You, My Shinobi
title.native: しのぶる恋にくちづけを

195501.description:
Shia, the palace gardener, is a foreigner hated in the Shen Empire. He’s put in charge of First Prince Yilin’s garden — a prince who’s rumored to dislike people — and ends up unexpectedly meeting the man who once saved his life. Yilin was the one who rescued young Shia when he drifted into this country, the person Shia had always wanted to see again.

Though once expected to be the “Blesser,” Yilin now lives in seclusion. Drawn to his quiet, hard-to-understand kindness, Shia pledges his loyalty to him. One day, however, Yilin accidentally tastes Shia’s blood—and for some reason, it sends him into heat. He confesses that he is, in fact, a cursed “Tempter”, and to keep it a secret, he orders Shia to take him…

(Source: Shinkosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Itsuwari Omega to Hakoniwa no Himegoto
Fake Omega and the Secret of the Miniature Garden

title.native: 偽りΩと箱庭のひめごと
title.romaji: Itsuwari Ω to Hakoniwa no Himegoto

195502.description: Note: Includes the one shot "Gohoubi Kudasai!! (ごほうびください!!)" and one extra chapter.

title.native: 俺たちβ（フツー）だったのに！！
ブラザー・イン・ピンクチェリー

195504.description:
Ryoutarou and Keisuke, a lovey-dovey college couple, are finally having their memorable first night together. The exciting mood quickly changes when Keisuke suddenly starts to play hard SM porn videos to Ryoutarou and reveals “I'm into this”! Shocked at first, Ryoutarou decides to accept it "For the sake of my dear, Kei-chan!" And so begins the start of their SM play days: bondage, wax play, spanking, and more! For the sake of his beloved, Ryoutarou will become an SM master!

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
195504.hashtag: #スパイシー・バニラ・エッセンス

title.native: スパイシー バニラ エッセンス

195505.description:
Just when Hayeon thought her luck couldn't get worse, a freak accident lands her smack in the middle of the trashy romance novel she wrote back in high school. But this isn't some fun fantasy—it's a nightmare. From the calculating psychopath Sunwoo to the obsessive, love-starved Yihan and the terrifying stalker Chanseung, every one of these male leads is a walking disaster. Is this second chance the miracle Hayeon’s been waiting for, or will she regret ever writing this chaos into existence?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Am in the Same Class as the Crazy Male Leads

title.english: Stuck in Class With the Crazy Male Leads

195506.description:
After the Night of Awakening, when the system appeared, everyone had mana in the world.
However, Soo-Jung, who was barely making ends meet as a porter in a dungeon without mana, meets a child who claims to be a hero from another world.
The mysterious and powerful power that the hero possesses. The first heart-pounding skill in her life that emerged after meeting the hero.
Will Soo-Jung be able to achieve her desired goal with the eccentric hero who only remembers the mission to save the Earth?
synonyms: The Reason Why the Hero of Another World Saves the Earth

195507.description:
"Celebrity has-been Ji Tangtang robbed Xia Zhou of his manhood! How is the award-winning actor going to live it down?" That's a huge piece of breaking news that has shaken the entertainment industry! No, no, that's a rumor! Ji Tangtang, a washed-up celebrity whose name hasn't been on the public’s lips for years, goes viral after accidentally knocking Xia Zhou down...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: I Allow You to be with Me

195508.description:
Yara suddenly found herself transmigrated into a novel she has read, only to become the personal maid of the story's yandere antagonist.

From that moment on, Giulio, who believed he was unworthy of love, found the only light in his life—Yara.

As an adult, he slowly approached Yara. "Yara, red roses and chains go perfectly together. Let's stay here forever, okay?"

Wait a minute... This kid wasn’t like this before! Give me back that adorable, tsundere boy!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chengwei Bing Jiao Bojue De Nüpu

195509.description:
Luo Hao was betrayed by superpowered beings during the chaos of the monster-infested apocalypse. As he lay dying, filled with regret, he miraculously awoke—back to the day before the end of the world began. This time, however, he has a weapon: a limitless Evolution System capable of making him stronger without end. Armed with foresight and ruthless resolve, Luo Hao swears he will take revenge on those who wronged him, and build an unbreakable fortress amid the ashes of civilization.

But the world isn’t the same as before—superpowered beings awaken earlier than expected. A shadowy force lurks behind the apocalypse. The Evolution System itself seems to be pushing Luo Hao into something darker… and irreversible. As power twists his mind and fate spirals out of control, can Luo Hao truly build his empire in the ruins, or will he become the very monster he once feared?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Apocalypse Descends, I Reincarnated as a Tyrant
Apocalypse Reset: Rise of the Tyrant

title.native: 末世降临，我重生成暴君
title.romaji: Moshi Jianglin, Wo Chong Shengcheng Baojun

195510.description:
Once the First War God of the Netherworld, he reincarnated as an ordinary High School Student. But as the gears of Fate turn, when the Heavenly Dao collapses and evil descends upon the world, he must wear his armor once more. Under the guidance of the aloof Goddess Black Impermanence, he will fight the Five Directional Ghost Emperors and battle the Ten Yama Kings. The King Returns to conquer the Three Realms, dominate The World, reshape the Cycle of Reincarnation—Only I Am Supreme!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

195511.description:
Finally, the moment she's been waiting for - her engagement annulment!

At her graduation ceremony, villainess Sylvia is hit with the classic line from the crown prince: "I hereby annul our engagement!" To which Sylvia replies with a dazzling smile and an enthusiastic "Gladly!"

Falsely accused of bullying her lover, Sylvia proves her innocence with a flawless alibi. She couldn't have bullied anyone while she was picking radishes in a dungeon! Armed with a hefty settlement for her troubles and her S-Rank adventurer's license, Sylvia retires to a quiet farm to finally live out her dream of taking it easy.

But just as everything starts to go to plan, her ex-fiancé's younger brother, the second prince, shows up at her door suspecting treason and moves in with her, upending her easygoing life!

A delightfully chaotic, sometimes wholesome, romantic adventure awaits!

(Source: Magazine House, translated)
195511.hashtag: #悪役令嬢はスローライフをエンジョイしたい

title.english: This Villainess Just Wants to Take It Easy!I finally broke off the engagement, but now the second prince is totally stalking me!
title.native: 悪役令嬢はスローライフをエンジョイしたい！～やっと婚約破棄されたのに、第二王子がめっちゃストーカーしてくるんですけど…～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Slow Life wo Enjoy Shitai!: Yatto Konyaku Haki sareta noni, Daini Ouji ga Meccha Stalker Shitekurun desu kedo…

195512.description:
After collapsing from overwork, Hinata can only retain memories for a minute. Her younger sister Shizuru struggles alone to support her, but the unimaginable hardship takes its toll both mentally and physically. As she approaches her limit, even the sisters' bond begins to waver...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195513.description:
The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195514.description:
With her weird talents and weirder personality, idol trainee Yoon Hyesung can't help but catch everyone's eye, even though that's far from what she wants. She's actually a fangirl from a different future with one goal in mind—help Na Yeonwoo debut as an idol! Now as Yeonwoo's friend, Hyesung is determined to get Yeonwoo the top spot on an idol survival program with the help of an oddly supportive game system. Can Hyesung help Yeonwoo debut, even if it means she will too?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Tried to Debut My Kid, But Ended Up Debuting Myself

title.native: 내 새끼 데뷔시키려다 내가 데뷔하게 생김
title.romaji: Nae Saekki Debwisikiryeoda Naega Debwihage Saenggim

synonyms: he Science Notes by Delta and Gamma

title.native: デルタとガンマの理学部ノート
title.romaji: Delta to Gamma no Rigakubu Note

title.native: 好きだった子をメイドにしたら、俺の部屋でこっそりナニかしている
title.romaji: Sukidatta Ko wo Maid ni Shitara, Ore no Heya de Kossori Nanika Shiteiru

title.native: 俺がシフトの時だけバイト先の喫茶店に来る、クラスの美少女モデル様
title.romaji: Ore ga Shift no Toki dake Baito Saki no Kissaten ni Kuru, Class no Bishoujo Model-sama

title.native: とある男子高校生のラブコメ観察日記
title.romaji: Toaru Danshi Koukousei no Lovecome Kansatsu Nikki

title.native: あの日の恋(x3)が終わってくれない! 想い出の美少女たちと再会したら、恋のレースが始まりました
title.romaji: Ano Hi no Koi (x3) ga Owatte Kurenai: Omoide no Bishoujotachi to Saikai Shitara, Koi no Race ga Hajimarimashita

title.native: 高校時代に好きだった元同級生のS級美女が隣に引っ越してきた。義娘とともに。
title.romaji: Koukoujidai ni Sukidatta Moto Doukyuusei no S-kyuu Bijo ga Tonari ni Hikkoshite Kita. Gijou to Tomoni.

title.native: 負けを認めたら、もっと触らせてあげるけど？　ざーこ
title.romaji: Make wo Mitometara, Motto Sawarasete Agerukedo? Zaako

195527.description: To help save her family's failing business, Sawako agrees to undergo a Shinto rite in which she will be symbolically married to the god of her family's shrine, a deity responsible for good harvests and business success. However as soon as the ceremony is complete the god appears in person to claim her as his bride--and as far as he is concerned there is nothing "symbolic" about it!

title.native: 政略結婚前提!? 蜜愛の儀式
title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon Zentei!? Mitsuai no Gishiki

195528.description:
A dull, unreliable middle-aged salaryman, Tamaki Kuroudo, is treated as a hopeless old man by everyone. Teased about his pot belly, treated coldly by his daughter at home, and when he happens to glance at his wife’s phone, he sees suspicious call logs with one of her coworkers. As he spends his pathetic days, his capable subordinate Ayase Mizuki invites him to the equipment room. While helping her move some equipment, he accidentally touches her breast and she records that very moment on video. After work, he’s blackmailed with the video and taken to, of all places, a sports gym? The price of sexual harassment is body transformation? A secret muscle-training comedy he hides from his wife!

(Source: MangaUpdates)

195529.description:
I accidentally got possessed while working overtime! And it was in a game that was scheduled to be scrapped after being deemed harmful by the review committee. Now, in order to return home, I had to raise my ‘ability’ and become a hero. But the method to raise that ability was…

“Ability can be obtained every time you seduce a man with a ‘strategy card’. To be exact, it’s based on semen absorption.”

She had discovered a new aptitude. One that she couldn’t find anywhere, at school or work. Its name was semen absorption.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Hero Saves Herself with Her Body

195530.description:
Jo Ji-Won is just your average college kid—well, except for the part where he scams people by pretending to be a shaman. Thanks to his silver tongue and some lucky guesses, he gains a reputation as a spiritual powerhouse. Unfortunately, word gets around… all the way to Jeong Tae-Oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-Oh shows up demanding help, Ji-Won pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught.

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Ji-Won blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to… sleep together!"

He’s sure a tough guy like Tae-Oh would bolt at the thought. Instead, Tae-Oh just shrugs.

"You should’ve said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: บ่วงรักข้ามภพ

195531.description:
"Anyone but this man — absolutely not! So why is he so needlessly beautiful and kind?"

Yoon-Ji suddenly finds herself inside the world of a novel she was writing.The pen name [Marie], which only she knew, is now the name everyone calls her. Now living as a beautiful young woman, she dreams of experiencing a sweet romance, but of all people, she ends up entangled with the second prince Henrique, a man destined for ruin!

"Have I piqued your interest or something?"

Where did it all go wrong?

A full-fledged survival romance in another world begins!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: The Reason for Avoiding Him, the Perfect One
完璧な彼を避ける理由

195532.description:
Was the world we wanted really wrong?
A moment of eternity we escaped to between childhood and adulthood...a fantastical world shaken by "growing up."
These short stories depicting the turmoil of the adolescent mind are a key, opening the hearts of anyone who is or was once an adolescent.

(Source: Leed-sha, translated)

title.native: 不老不死にならなくちゃ

195533.description:
Lin Ran, a man with a more beautiful face than women’s, is so timid that even cockroaches can scare him into scream, and his physical strength is also close to zero; meanwhile when he meets the heroic campus girl bully, will it be the journey of a girl bully master and a pretty boy apprentice, or the official opening of a school pretty boy's courtship diary?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Weak Pretty School Boy's Love Story
title.romaji: Ruo Qi Xiaocao Zhui Ai Ji

195534.description:
After twenty years of secluded cultivation deep in the mountains, Liu Yu, a master of unrivaled Daoist arts, is finally ordered to descend into the mortal world. He never expected that the moment he set foot in the city, he’d stumble upon a haunted mansion and a wealthy heiress plagued by malevolent energy. Soon, both the criminal underworld and the righteous path are fighting to call him “big brother,” while powerful tycoons compete to gift him luxury cars and mansions, begging him to change their fates with his mystical formations. Even the most elite and untouchable families are forced to respectfully address him as “Heavenly Master.” With Daoist magic protecting him, Liu Yu banishes evil and slays demons, shaking the underworld and the heavens alike. Watch how he suppresses all manner of monsters and spirits in the city—and dominates the world of yin and yang!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Fellow Daoist, Make Way: I Am Here to Slay Ghosts and Gods in the City

title.native: 道友让让：俺来都市斩鬼神
title.romaji: Dao You Rang: An Lai Dushi Zhan Guishen

195535.description:
After an ordinary adventurer, Zion, was betrayed and eaten by a monster, his final regret was being "no better than a cockroach." The Cockroach God took his lament seriously! Now, Zion is reincarnated—as a tiny, six-legged roach in a world full of terrifying monsters and superpowers. Stripped of his strength, this former human must use his new, disgustingly resilient body to scratch, skitter, and survive against impossible odds. His action-packed quest for revenge starts small, but his rage is immense!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Buffed by Bugs: The End of the World
title.romaji: Mori Gouhuo: Zhanglang Gei Wo Die Buff

195536.description:
After an unfortunate encounter with a cargo truck, Chen Ke transmigrates into a cultivation world—only to wake up in a dungeon, captured as a "birthday sacrifice" for a man-eating demon. Just as despair sets in, his [Multiverse Lottery System] activates with a catch:

The more he shocks others, the more prizes he draws! Now, while fellow prisoners tremble before the guards, Chen Ke does the unthinkable—he slaps a demon sentry and demands better prison food. As jaws drop, his system pings:

» [Shock Value +50!]
» [Reward: "Indestructible Crocs™"]
» [Next Prize: "AK-47 of Qi Refining"]

Armed with increasingly ridiculous artifacts, this madman pioneers…

The Path of Techno-Cultivation!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Infinite Extraction: Starting With the Nuclearization of the Immortal World
Infinite Extraction: Starting by Nuking the Cultivation World
It All Starts With Nuking the Cultivation World

title.english: Cheat Summoner: Wipe Out Gods with a Starter Pack
title.native: 无限抽取：开局核平修仙世界
title.romaji: Wuxian Chouqu: Kaiju He Ping Xiu Xian Shijie

195537.description:
Li Tianyuan, Lord of the Celestial Severance Hall, walks the path of a Grand Player—one who manipulates the chessboard of destiny itself.

Branded a tyrant by foes and a madman by allies, he willingly shoulders the hatred of all eras to lead his followers in rebellion against heaven’s decree. Their vision? A world where no soul kneels to another.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Immortals Are Slaves, Gods Are Servants, and the Emperor Is the Watchdog

title.english: Immortals as Slaves, Gods as Servants: The Emperor is My Guard Dog
title.native: 仙为奴神为仆，大帝看门狗
title.romaji: Xian Wei Nu Shen Wei Pu, Dadi Kan Men Gou

195538.description:
Eun-Kyum, a short-eared rabbit, takes care of his two younger siblings and makes a living by growing carrots. Then one day, his younger siblings pick up a cat. However, upon closer inspection, he discovers that it is not a cat, but a baby tiger?! He tries to send the tiger back, but his siblings keep nagging him, so he ends up living with the tiger. However, when his siblings leave the house, the baby tiger transforms into a human! What's more, it is not a baby, but an adult tiger... Eun-Kyum, who is helpless against this tiger that attacks him every night, demanding that he give birth to a baby tiger, tries to chase Ji-Hyuk away every day. However, unlike his fellow rabbits who usually left Eun-Kyum alone because of his short ears, Ji-Hyuk begins to show a small rift in his heart as he pours all his affection into him. And it seems that Ji-Hyuk has a hidden past of his own...

A romance between Eun-Kyum the rabbit who tries to chase away Ji-Hyuk the tiger and the tiger who is obsessed with the rabbit!

Who will be the winner between the two?

(Source: OrangeD, translated)
synonyms: Rabbit Story: No Love Zone Side Story

195540.description:
Kazuho and Tokio have been best friends since elementary school. As the years went on, Kazuho realized his feelings for Tokio were more than just friends, and he began pulling away from Tokio, desperate to keep his feelings a secret. While once close enough to give each other piggyback rides, the two boys, now high school students, pass each other in the hallway as the distance grows between them. But when Kazuho can’t keep his feelings hidden from Tokio any longer, will the two friends only continue to drift apart, or will it be the start to them experiencing the feelings of first love together?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
195540.hashtag: #俺が好きって言ったらどうする

title.english: What If I Said, "I Love You"?
title.native: 俺が好きって言ったらどうする？
title.romaji: Ore ga Suki tte Ittara Dou Suru?

195541.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Printemps Shuppan for serialization.

195543.description:
This is a fantasy romantic comedy that begins when the tomboyish princess of the weak country of Barcos, Leilia, is proposed to by the crown prince of the neighboring country, Joan. However, the prince has a crush on someone else, and imposes a number of rude conditions on Leilia, who is to marry him in an arranged marriage, such as "not appearing in public" and "not talking or having contact with him." Leilia is angry at the arrogant Prince Joan and tries to change his character, but due to an unexpected turn of events, the distance between the two of them suddenly closes.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: こじらせ王太子と約束の姫君
title.romaji: Kojirase Outaishi to Yakusoku no Himegimi

195544.description:
Born an omega, Ha Ian lives a quiet life focused on modest goals and day-to-day survival. But his peace shatters when he reunites with Jeong Hyeon, a man tied to the sins of his past. Hyeon demands that Ian work as his secretary to repay an enormous debt, binding him once more to a fate he thought he had escaped. As the weight of guilt and old wounds resurfaces, Ian must face the question: can true atonement ever be found in the shadow of his past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

195545.description:
There is a land where elves and wizards roam, where warriors and demon kings clash for the fate of the world—and the name of this fantastical land is none other than… Seoul, South Korea?! Sent by magic from his fantasy world to modern Seoul along with his party of colorful heroes, will former warrior and very ordinary student Hui-Won be able to gather his party and save it from the “evils” of the Demon King?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195546.description:
"For the deceased (guests), we provide the ultimate happiness—."

Edward, a poor boy, stumbled upon "DEATH STUDIO," a theme park for the dead…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ようこそデスタジオへ

195547.description:
Princess Alexandra of Elazar, raised in the quiet peace of a convent, becomes a political bride to Prince Aurelio of El Pagne. Her enigmatic husband, rumored to be indifferent to women, offers her only a cordial partnership and never love. Alone in a hostile palace as an unwanted consort, Alexandra struggles to find her place while Aurelio keeps his distance. Yet as she begins to bloom despite the thorns around her, a question lingers. Can their marriage of convenience turn into something neither of them expected?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Ten Leaf Flower of Mount Kairos
The Dekafilo of the Mount Kairos
愛亡き結婚でも偽りの愛を誓います

title.english: Dynastic Marriage: The Fallen and The Crowned
title.romaji: Kai Luo Si Shan De Shi Xie Hua

195548.description:
I crossed over, my gold finger became Plants vs Zombies and I’m the zombie…

“Sunflowers produce one grain of sunlight a day and they also contain the qi of the entire body during the Qi Refining Period? With 54 squares planted, isn’t this…”

“A pea from the Pea Shooter is comparable to a full strength blow from someone from the Qi Refining Stage?”

“Oh my god, is this a Squash? A Great Foundation building master was killed in one sitting!”

“This Nascent Soul Elder, this spirit plant I offered is called the Doom-Shroom…”

“Eh? How come these two plants can be hybridized…”

“Zombie illustrated book? Open it.”

“The zombie body can be upgraded and different zombies can be replaced as the main body…quickly bring me the Dacheng Holy Body covered with green hair!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: Starting as a Small Zombie, I Cultivate to Immortality by Growing Plants

title.native: 开局一具小僵尸，修仙全靠种植物
title.romaji: Kaiju Yi Ju Xiao Jiangshi, Xiu Xian Quan Kao Zhong Zhiwu

195549.description:
Jiang Wang was betrayed by his sworn brother Fang Pengju, who stole the Daoist Academy's reward of a Meridian Opening pill that he had earned with his blood and sweat. On the verge of death, he inherited the relics of Zuo Guanglie, the genius of the Chu Dynasty, opened his meridians and embarked on the path of cultivation. He was confused and hesitant, but he always held on to the light in his heart, which was a pure heart that remained true to its original intention.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: ウマ娘 シンデレラグレイ 外伝 "盤外"

195551.description:
Yuri business is when two female idols act like they're a couple as a form of fan service. Mai and Marika are lovey-dovey on stage but their real personalities clash behind the scenes. How long can their yuri business last?

Note: Released at Comiket 105.
synonyms: I'm in the Yuri Business. How May I Assist You?
It's the Yuri Biz, What of It?

title.native: 百合営業ですが、なにか
title.romaji: Yuri Eigyou desu ga, Nani ka

195552.description:
Constantly slapping faces is constantly satisfying. Holding trillions in resources, slapping the faces of terrible women, conquering goddesses, Chen Yu is bound to the Scumbag System, sweeping away all powerful enemies in the apocalypse, and subduing countless otaku goddesses!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Starting With Trillions of Supplies, The Goddess Regretted It
The Goddess Felt Regretful When I Started With Trillions of Supplies

title.native: 开局万亿物资，女神后悔了
title.romaji: Kaiju Wanyi Wu Zi, Nushen Houhui Liao

195553.description:
From bottom-tier trash to unstoppable menace. Heath Lin transmigrates to another world and gets stuck with the most despised class: Summoner. Everyone laughs—until he awakens Demonic Sacrifice, a forbidden skill that rockets him straight to SSS-rank.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Devil Summoner, I Am the Abyss Lord

title.english: Demon Summoner: I Am the Abyss

195555.description:
YouTuber agency manager Nogawa Tsutomu and his younger brother Hisei witness a mysterious light while visiting the World Heritage site of Hara Castle Ruins for work. The light appears to be Amakusa Shirou, the "son of God" from the Edo period who is said to have led the largest uprising in Japanese history at just 16 years old. Tsutomu sees potential in Amakusa Shirou as an influencer due to his beautiful looks and charisma, but Amakusa Shirou has a much more arrogant personality than he could have ever imagined...!?

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

195556.description:
That day, I lost my sister. A story of revenge against a rapist and murderer by a high school girl who burns with hatred.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Originally published at COMITIA 126, it later won the Top Award at Young Magazine's 462nd Monthly Awards.

title.native: さくらの森の満開の下
title.romaji: Sakura no Mori no Mankai no Shita

195557.description:
The story is set in the mid-Edo period. Obun, the only daughter of a bookstore owner, is known for her drawing skills that rival those of adults, and is nicknamed "Kakimushi". Obun has a cheerful personality and loves the literary genre of "Kibyoshin," which combines pictures and stories, but she has been feeling lonely since being separated from her mother, who was once a prostitute. One day, after an incident that occurred at a bookstore, she sets foot in the Yoshiwara red-light district alone in search of her mother --!?

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)

195558.description:
Yeo Eui-Yeon, once a respected figure within his martial sect, vanished without a trace after betraying his order—murdering his own master and fellow disciples in cold blood. Do Hae-Gun, one of the sect's most promising young warriors, was raised like a son by Master Eui-Yeon. But after being suddenly abandoned as a child, Hae-Gun grew up with a deep scar—feeling discarded, betrayed, and driven by resentment. Years later, under orders to track down the fugitive Eui-Yeon, Hae-Gun sets out on a mission fueled by a twisted blend of loyalty and vengeance. But on his journey, he crosses paths with a mysterious man—someone who looks uncannily like his former master, yet behaves in completely different, disarming ways. Is this truly Eui-Yeon reborn? Or a stranger caught in the shadow of another man's sins?

In a world of blades and betrayal, what will Hae-Gun do when the line between past and present begins to blur?

(Source: Lezhin US)

195559.description:
"Spochan!" is a story about girls who play Sports Chanbara, or Spochan for short, a sport in which people fight using airsoft swords. Momo, a girl who quit Spochan in junior high school after never winning a match, meets Amelia, an American girl who dreams of becoming a Spochan player, in high school. Unable to refuse Amelia's invitation, Momo goes to watch the Spochan club, where her talent is discovered by Asahina Rei, a senior who is also a famous and skilled player in tournaments, and the story depicts her facing Spochan once again.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195560.description: Manga adaptation of "The Maracot Deep" by Arthur Conan Doyle.

195562.description: Note: Never collected in a tankoubon.

195563.description: Note: This work has never been collected in a tankoubon.

195564.description:
Song Jun, who is alienated from his perfect family, buys lottery tickets every day to become independent from his family. Song Jun wins a 500 million won instant lottery ticket as he wished, and he gladly tells his perfect family about the win. However, the family is risking their lives for a seemingly worthless 500 million won lottery ticket, and Song Jun is trying to get his lottery ticket back.

The bloody feast of time-limited lottery tickets begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195565.description:
At the age of 13, Luanna's parents were murdered, and this shocking event awakened her magical powers. Three years have passed since Luanna, known as the most powerful witch in the country, met an ordinary man named Kurs. Despite facing her wrath every day, Kurs falls head over heels for the passionate Luanna and devotes himself to household chores with great care. However, one day, Luanna prepares to give up this blissful everyday life. She does so in order to pursue her ideals. Furthermore, little does she know that her husband, Kurs, also harbors a secret he cannot tell her. Can Luanna, burdened with her husband's boundless love, achieve her long-awaited dreams?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: A Mais Poderosa Bruxa e Seu Marido

title.romaji: Saikyou no Majo to Sono Otto

195568.description:
Baek Ma-Ri is an outcast at school and a rich girl at home. I, an outcast, made the first-ranked handsome man my butler...?! No. 1 in school, and at home, Ma-Ri's lowly butler. I have to somehow make the bullied girl the queen of the school!! A romance between boys and girls who are opposites.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

synonyms: The Rice Cake You Make, the Rice Cake You Eat

195570.description: Like a black box, hiding secrets deep inside

195572.description:
2012, the silence we left behind. A story of enlisting together with a friend of 8 years.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195574.description:
Do-Hoon was sent to his relative's house by his grandmother when he was young and grew up alone. One day, he hears news of his grandmother suffering from dementia and goes to his grandmother's house in the countryside. Do-Hoon, who was defrauded by a friend and was in poor financial condition, becomes greedy when he hears that his grandmother's house is a development zone, but it is in vain when he discovers his father had been locked up in the basement for 30 years. Do-Hoon wants to look good to his father and inherit his grandmother's house. However, his father, Yeong-Chun, starts to harm Do-Hoon's family instead.

Why was his father locked up by his grandmother for 30 years? What happened in this village 30 years ago? The terrible incidents shrouded in mystery, the truth of the tragedy that is gradually being revealed, and the resentment and revenge of the people involved in those events. Will his father, Yeong-Chun, be able to let go of his grudge? Will Do-Hoon's family be able to escape the crisis they accidentally got caught up in?

(Source: Naver, translated)

195575.description:
One day, a suspected patient with the Ars24 variant that was brought to Korea University Hospital escaped. Professor Jung Yu-Hyeon of the Department of Infectious Diseases, who felt responsible for losing the patient he was in charge of, decided to jump into the search for the patient and headed to Surak Village in Hwaseong City, where the patient was last seen. And they encountered something at the entrance to the village..., a man with a height of 2m, a body much larger than that of an average adult male, a corpse of an animal in his hand, clothes stained with blood and torn, and a face that was hard to identify as old. The search team was momentarily overwhelmed by the man's appearance. And Jung Yu-Hyeon discovered that there was a connection between the man's strange appearance and the unusual symptoms that the patient who escaped had shown at the hospital...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195576.description:
A story about people living in a world where youth comes twice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195577.description:
A relatable story that unfolds as Kim Du-Chi enters a sports university. The characters that appear as Kim Du-Chi's classmates and seniors are said to be real people. The fun story of The King of Sports is to guess who they are. We ask for your great anticipation.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195578.description:
One day, everything he knew disappeared! A sudden incident occurred to an ordinary high school student who dreamed of becoming the best baker.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195579.description:
Fashion King Woo Ki-Myung is back! Enjoyable college life?! Really?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

195580.description:
The real story of Kian84 and the King of Bonds Park Tae-Jun.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195581.description:
On the day a giant comet struck the Earth, all of humanity's wishes came true. In a world that had become a disaster, those who had gained abilities through wishes chose to become heroes who would fight against the extinction of humanity.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Endangering Types of Crisis for Mankind

195582.description:
The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Male Lead Is Obsessed With My Health

title.native: ありすちゃんのお願いごと
近所のギャル姉はえっちになるとよわよわ

195587.description:
Kurenai is the cutest girl in the world! But... One day, she reunites with her childhood friend and finds out that she has become a cute cross-dressing boy!?

(Source: Ciao, translated)

1-3. Senpai wa Ookii no ga Osuki (せんぱいはおおきいのがお好き)
4-5. Ribon to Doku (りぼんと毒)

title.romaji: Usotsuki Wolf wa Inma to Odoru

195594.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 61

195595.description:
The new transfer student is a super handsome vampire!?

I'm Hinata Miu, a first year middle school student. Kirishima-kun, the new transfer student, is very handsome, and far from ordinary. When I cut my finger, he licks the blood off, and he teleports at incredible speed. Could he really be a vampire? I'm intrigued by the mysterious Kirishima-kun, but he has two incredibly scary, handsome older brothers...!? What's more, the three vampire brothers don't get along at all.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 霧島くんは普通じゃない

195597.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 61

195598.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 61

title.romaji: Tonari no Hitozuma wa Saikyou Motoyan

title.native: 淫乱猫は夜に啼く 自慰&夜這い編
title.romaji: Inran Neko Wa Yoru Ni Naku: Jii & Yobai Hen

195603.description:
Survive to make sure your love is reciprocated! An unprecedented survival romance.

Mei Mashima (aka Majime), a third year middle school student, has had a crush on a boy for a long time. She decides to use the school festival superstition to confess her feelings. It should have been a typical love story, but on the night of the school festival preparations, a mysterious virus causes the school to become filled with "love zombies", beasts who have lost their sanity...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

195605.description:
20 years have passed since the previous story... Natsume suddenly develops the Love Zombie Virus, a demonic disease that makes you lose your reason that was thought to have disappeared. Ito is always fighting with Natsume, and for some reason her body is immune to the virus. In an emergency, Ito is the only one who can stop Natsume...! They start living together, not knowing when they might be attacked.

The main characters from the previous story also make an appearance one after another!! A one-of-a-kind virus romantic mystery!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

195606.description: The second season of Into the Horizon

title.native: お狐ギャルと家庭教師

195608.description:
Lohiriel is the second daughter of House Casyan, a family infamous for its virulent poisons, and she has only one year left to live. That is, unless she can procure a rare plant that's exclusively grown in the imperial gardens... To access it, she strikes a daring deal with the crown prince: If he enters a one-year contract marriage with her, she'll provide him with a treatment for the ailing emperor. That means Lohiriel's medical expertise will prove useful for more people than she thought!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Time-Limited Villainess Who Makes Medicine

title.native: グライフトゥルム戦記～微笑みの軍師マティアスの救国戦略～
title.romaji: Greifturm Senki: Hohoemi no Gunshi Matthias no Kyuukoku Senryaku
