貴重な治癒師は期待しない
title.romaji: Kichou na Chiyu Shi wa Kitai Shinai

195614.description: Note: Originally published in LaLa 2010 July issue.

title.native: 孤独の魔女と独りの少女
title.romaji: Kodoku no Majo to Hitori no Shoujo

title.native: 天才美少女三姉妹は居候にだけちょろ可愛い。
title.romaji: Tensai Bishoujo Sanshimai wa Isourou ni Dake Choro Kawaii.

195617.description:
After losing his job when a new alpha joins the office, Yamato is feeling hopeless. The world isn't kind to omegas like him... Just when he's nodding off on a park bench, a man passing by, assuming all omegas are desperate for money, asks his price. Too burnt out to resist the stranger's advances, Yamato is luckily saved by an alpha wolf named Jin. Not only that, Jin is kind enough to invite him, an omega, into his home...!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Yasashii Kemono wa Ore wo Kamanai
Yasashii Alpha wa Ore wo Kamanai

title.english: The Benevolent Beast Won't Bite Me
title.native: 優しいケモノ(α)は俺を噛まない
title.romaji: Yasashii Kemono (α) wa Ore wo Kamanai

195618.description:
In another world, King Shihark, a man of superhuman charisma, is the ruler of the Kingdom of Bottomore from which "no man returns." After a life of decadence, being waited on hand and foot (and more) by his male subjects, his overindulgence proves fatal... and he is reincarnated into the modern world! Upon entering a nearby convenience store, Shihark has a fateful encounter with a store worker named Nokuta...
Can Shihark possibly find true love!? Thus unfolds a one-of-a-kind BL romance about otherworldly reincarnation!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Carnal Incarnation -Reincarnated Into Another World To **** You-
title.native: DAKUTEN 〜お前を抱くために異世界転生してきた〜
title.romaji: DAKUTEN: Omae wo Daku Tame ni Isekai Tensei Shite Kita

195619.description:
Natsuhiko is a mature, down-to-earth college student who’s secretly gay and has had a crush on his best friend Yuusuke since high school. Yuusuke sometimes gets a girlfriend, but the relationships never last, and he mostly hangs out with his guy friends. Being just a friend felt pretty comfortable for Natsuhiko, but now things are starting to change?!

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

195620.description:
Freesia, a duchess, is a troublemaker who often engages in friendly competitions with her classmates at the magic school in the Kingdom of Fornog, however, one day, when an incident occurs at one of those battles, she is magically transported to a different place. She is transported to... modern-day Japan...?

(Comiplex, translated and edited)

195621.description: An adaptation of the anime by the same name, serialized after the end of Olympus no Pollon.

title.native: おちゃめ神物語 コロコロポロン

195622.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 57, was then licensed by Takeshobo for digital release.
synonyms: ハッピー・オブ・ジ・エンド 番外編 millefeuille
Happy of the End: Bangai-hen - millefeuille

195623.description:
After surviving a brutal childhood tragedy and awakening from a mysterious coma, Shinyeok Lee returns with the mind of a genius profiler and fifteen years’ worth of knowledge that no one can explain. Now, he reads the lies of the living and uncovers the truths of the dead, solving crimes no one else can. But every case brings him closer to the murderer who destroyed his family. Can Shinhyeok expose the ultimate villain, or will the darkness he studies consume him first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195625.description:
Three years after leaving home, Yunjae gets a call from his sister. “Father’s gone….” He feels no tears, no sorrow, because the man was never truly his father. Returning to his hometown under the heavy heat of summer, Yunjae finds his sister unchanged: fragile, beautiful, and heartbreakingly familiar. He knows what he feels must stay hidden, that some things are never meant to be spoken aloud. But the closer they grow, the harder it becomes to bury his forbidden longing, and the past they’ve both tried to forget begins to bloom again beneath the sunflowers.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195626.description:
Donghyuk's been missing his late wife terribly ever since she passed. But someone who looks just like her seems willing to take her place.

(Source: Toomics)

195627.description:
A newly emerging religion with a mysterious purpose, Ilgakgyo, and its educational facility called Lumbini. The children of Lumbini refer to it as paradise. In this unbelievable paradise where strange events unfold, and the shocking occult thriller experienced by the protagonist Yeong-Do, who finds himself there.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195629.description: Nonona-chan's friend, Nunone-chan, is a slightly unusual girl. She uses pig meat and organs, which she always carries around with her, to express her pure love for Nonona-chan. Nonona-chan likes Nunone-chan, but doesn't like pig meat and organs. One day, Nonona-chan avoided her at school, and...

title.native: ブタさん大好きぬのねちゃん
あやかし古書庫と少女の魅宝
title.romaji: Ayakashi Koshoko to Shoujo no Takara

195631.description:
From Oboro Ninshou (おぼろ忍抄):
1. Kaze to Yuku Bushi (風とゆく武士)
2. Senka no Hate (戦火の果て)
3. Okite (掟)
4. Kunoichitsuka (くの一塚)

From Koken no Ookami (孤剣の狼より):
5. Katakiuchi (敵討)
6. Kamaoni (鎌鬼)

From Doninki (土忍記より):
7. Mizu wo Yogosumono (水を汚す者)
8. Ubasute (姥捨て)
9. Michi wo Kiwamerumono (道を極める者)

title.native: 現代コミック  小島剛夕集

195632.description:
After being attacked by monsters, a countryside girl meets an all-too-sudden death, only to wake up and find herself as the villainess of the storybook she loved so much! Originally doomed to live as the main heroine's enemy and die at the hand of the Demon Lord, she suddenly finds the Demon Lord proposing to her, unlocking an uncharted story route...?! With her story knowledge and incredible powers, this villainess is ready to dodge her bad ending and make a legendary comeback in this fantasy tale!

(Source: Manga UP!, Global)

title.english: How a Country Girl Reincarnated as a Villainess Tries to Avoid a Bad Ending ~I Don’t Want to Die So I Need to Become Stronger than the Final Boss~
title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生した田舎娘がバッドエンド回避に挑む話 ~死にたくないのでラスボスより強くなってみた~
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita Inaka Musume ga Bad End Kaihi ni Idomu Hanashi: Shinitakunai node Last Boss Yori Tsuyoku Nattemita

195633.description:
Rio Nishizonji, who attends Meiou High School, a prestigious boys' school where the heirs of wealthy families gather, is revered like a prince for his outstanding family background, talent, and looks. He is on bad terms with Kazuyoshi Nijou, also from the most prestigious of families, the Nijou family, and Rio sees him as a rival. With his future decided, Rio only has two more years of freedom. But he has a wish that he wants to fulfill before he graduates...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195635.description:
Mahiro, a university student, wants to give her working boyfriend some homemade food. At that time, Yoshishi, a high school boy living next door, teaches her how to cook! Yoshishi may seem cool at first glance, but he's actually a good cook and a kind person, which soothes Mahiro...

A soothing love story begins with a younger boy who speaks in a Kyushu dialect!

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title.native: 吉志くんとおいしいごはん

195637.description:
Told in an omnibus format, this is a collection of love stories with the theme of guys who are always the center of attention in class.

(Source: Natalie, translated and edited)

195638.description:
Rui, who has zero immunity to boys, meets Okita-senpai, who is well-known for flirting at school…?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

195639.description:
After being abandoned in the mountains, Enoa's decision to camp and take it easy launches him into an adventure he never would've expected! After befriending a holy beast and becoming unfathomably strong, he learns that the aristocrats who exiled him are plotting his destruction. At least he's popular with the ladies now! Prepare for a thrilling new harem and gourmet fantasy!

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: Isekai Gourmet de Nariagari Musou: Yama ni Tsuihou sareta node, Nonbiri Camp wo Tanoshinde itara Itsunomanika Tsuyoku natte ite, Oukou Kizoku ya Jitsuryokusha-tachi ga Ore wo Houtte oite kuremasen. Ippou, Ore wo Tsuihou shita Kizoku-tachi wa Hametsu ga Hajimaru
異世界グルメで成り上がり無双～山に追放されたので、のんびりキャンプを楽しんでいたらいつの間にか強くなっていて、王侯貴族や実力者たちが俺を放っておいてくれません。一方、俺を追放した貴族たちは破滅が始まる～

title.native: 異世界グルメで成り上がり無双

195640.description:
No backstabbing by an ex-girlfriend, no betrayal by teammates, no dying in the mouth of a monster to restart another life. Right from the start, you already have traps activated.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)
synonyms: One Foot on the Accelerator to Create the End of the World

title.romaji: Yi Jiao Youmen Chuang Fei Mori

195641.description:
Juri and Hana have been best friends since university. Lately, it feels like their relationship is slightly off...!?

(Source: Mystery Bonita, translated)

195642.description:
Toono Hana (34) was just a temp worker whose contract had just expired, leaving her unemployed and feeling down. But in a sudden turn of events, she finds herself summoned to a parallel world—a realm where humanity has the power to change the seasons! Waiting for her there is a prestigious role: the “Spring Princess.” However, this isn’t just a royal title; it’s a job requirement, and she’ll need to recruit her own knight as well… In a fantastic world without family or friends, Hana must persevere as the Spring Princess to find her way home!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: I’m Now the Princess of Spring in Another World
title.native: 四季姫、始めました～召喚された世界で春を司るお仕事します～
title.romaji: Shiki Hime, Hajimemashita: Shoukan Sareta Sekai de Haru wo Tsukasadoru Oshigoto Shimasu

195644.description:
Millions in debt, high schooler Taira's only path to redemption is in the world of underground ping pong! "Gimme a flat table, a ball, and a racket, and I'll show you some ping pong!" A shining table and a burning ball. Nobody will keep their sanity when this crazy ping pong battle begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195645.description:
Faye Leonheart is a seventeen-year-old sword-fighting prodigy and the heir apparent to the mightiest warrior clan. After three long years, she finally returns from her sword-training pilgrimage…with a magical machine gun in hand?! Promptly disowned by her family with nothing but her beloved firearm for company, this trigger-happy young lady commits herself to studying ancient technology called overgear. After all, who has time for regrets when freedom calls? The world is full of archaic ruins, and Faye is ready to explore them, full-metal style!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: だって、私はフリーダム！ 魔工士フェイ、古代文明に挑みます
title.romaji: Datte, Watashi wa Freedom! Makou-shi Fey, Kodai Bunmei ni Idomimasu

195646.description:
COME ONE, COME ALL, TO THE MOST POPULAR DUNGEON AROUND!

So there I am on my death bed when a literal devil comes to make a deal with me. I get a second shot at life, and in exchange, I'm on the hook for designing the most enticing dungeon her world has ever seen. Pretty sweet deal, if you ask me. Let's see, how do we get people to explore the dungeon? How about if we offer hot springs capable of rejuvenating skin, reversing the effects of aging, and granting you crazy strength? Whoops… Looks like our baths are too popular and are causing some geopolitical strife. Well, it's just another day in the life of a dungeon master!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Reincarnated, I’ll Make the Hot Spring Dungeon!

title.english: Dungeon Master: Creating a Hot Spring Dungeon
title.native: 異世界転生ダンジョンマスター　温泉ダンジョンを作る
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei Dungeon Master: Onsen Dungeon wo Tsukuru

title.native: クラスの美少女たちの素顔を、雇われた俺だけが知っている
title.romaji: Class no Bishoujo-tachi no Sugao wo, Yatowareta Ore Dake ga Shitteiru

title.native: 幼馴染のVTuber配信に出たら超神回で人生変わった
title.romaji: Osananajimi no VTuber Haishin ni Detara Choujin Kai de Jinsei Kawatta

195649.description:
Lin Fang awakens an SSS-level artifact mastery talent, granting him the power to turn anything into a divine weapon. Armed with an invincible holy sword, clad in god-tier armor, and riding a flashy motorcycle, all equipment granted by goddesses!

As terrifying beasts invade and threaten apocalypse, Lin Fang fights alongside his goddess companions. With love, he vows: “My ladies, let us ascend to the throne of power—together!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Divine Artifact Master: My Infinite Goddess Contracts
God-Class Defensive Item: My Infinite Contract Goddess
God-Rank Artifact: My Infinite Pact With the Goddess

title.native: 神级御物：我无限契约女神
title.romaji: Shen Ji Yu Wu: Wo Wuxian Qiyue Nüshen

195650.description:
On awakening in a desperate situation, Li Wenxuan, an ordinary college student, was pushed into the era of fantasy beast masters by fate. Starting from the lowest level fantasy beast, he groped forward in revenge and protection, pursuing his own power and beliefs. This is a golden age where fantasy beasts and humans coexist, and Li Wenxuan is destined to embark on a unique path of rise.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Beastmaster: I Can See the Complete Encyclopedia of Evolution
Beast Taming: I Can See the Full Evolution Guide

title.native: 御兽：我能看见进化全图鉴
title.romaji: Yu Shou: Wo Neng Kanjian Jinhua Quan Tujian

title.native: 魔法律学校の麗人執事 ウェルカム・トゥー・マジックローアカデミー
title.romaji: Mahouritsu Gakkou no Reijin Shitsuji: Welcome to Magic Law Academy

195652.description:
The victim of an atrocious war, Shurielle grew up in a temple as an orphan. One day, she finds herself being adopted by Duchess Luke and is excited at the prospect of a prosperous new life. But soon she finds out her fate - i.e. to merely be a puppet that would help the Lune family expand their authority when she marries the Emperor. Not only that, she has to dress up as the Emperor's previous love, Charlotte, and win his second heart, the Elixia. Shurielle frantically does all she can to survive, but when Charlotte returns, the Emperor turns a cold shoulder to her. It was only when she faces her fifth rebirth that she realizes she would no longer succumb to such a past but forge a new life. But the mad, vicious Emperor seems unable to let go of her. Will Shurielle, once again, be a victim of the Dragon Emperor? Or will she take the hand of the strange man she meets in her new life?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.native: 私を愛さなくても結構です
title.romaji: Watashi wo Aisanakute mo Kekkou desu

title.native: スライムマスターちゃんのVRMMO

195654.description:
A humble slave girl marries in place of someone else to a prince of the enemy country with demon bloodline, embarking on a journey of struggle towards the pinnacle of power. Can the conspiracy hidden behind be uncovered? Will everything the girl pursues come true?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: お嬢様の身代わりで結婚させられました

title.english: The Poetry of Love and War

195655.description:
In a chaotic world where royal power has collapsed, a small child plays with dirt in a remote, frozen village. His name is Ars.

Gifted with extraordinary earth magic, Ars can freely alter soil and terrain-so he puts his ability to work improving farmland and restoring barren fields. What no one knows is that he carries memories from a past life obsessed with city-building games.

As he grows older, Ars sets his sights on escaping poverty. Using his own original magic, he begins constructing houses from scratch. He hatches rare magical beasts, clears the dense forest surrounding the village, and revolutionizes trade by building Roman-style roads. Massive defensive walls rise to protect against monsters, and a once-starving farming settlement slowly transforms into a thriving city. But rapid progress attracts unwanted attention.

Nobles who see his development as a threat move to crush his ambitions-and Ars is forced into conflict with the powers of the world. Starting with nothing but his magic and ingenuity, a single boy reshapes the land and sets out on an unstoppable path toward unifying the realm. The epic tale of a nation’s founding begins with one child and a handful of dirt.

(Source: Hanashi Media)
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer in a Different World, so I Decided to Make Bricks to Build a Castle
Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer: Building a Castle Brick by Brick

title.english: Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer in Another World: I’ll Use My Modern Knowledge to Build My Own Kingdom
title.native: 異世界の貧乏農家に転生したので、レンガを作って城を建てることにしました
title.romaji: Isekai no Binbou Nouka ni Tensei Shita node, Renga wo Tsukutte Shiro wo Tateru koto ni shimashita

195657.description:
Satoshi Aiba is a rookie police officer who works hard at his police department every day to keep the peace in his town! One day, a police officer wearing only his underwear is assigned to his department! His name is Mamoru Zenryoku. When Aiba asks him why he wears only his underwear, he tells him that he wants to become a police officer who is close to people, and that he wants to take everything off, hide nothing, and interact naked with the citizens! Will he solve various incidents that occur in the town wearing only his underwear?!

A thrilling police comedy featuring the crazy police officer wearing only his underwear and the rookie police officer, Aiba, is about to begin!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

195658.description:
Leonardo Nix once dreamed of becoming an alchemist. Instead, he’s in a maximum-security prison, languishing in guilt and self-disgust. After all, he admitted to breaking an unspeakable taboo—eating his comrades. Then, not long into his imprisonment, he is suddenly transformed into a hideous monstrosity. He flees the prison as guards sound the alarm, but nowhere is safe for such a terrible beast. And though he doesn’t want to hurt anyone, a dark hunger for human flesh stirs within him. When all hope seems lost, he crosses paths with Elena the witch, who offers to find a way to break his curse! Unfortunately, there’s a catch: As her familiar, he’ll still get blood on his hands…straying even farther from the path of redemption.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Witch's Conviction, The Beast's Redemption
title.native: 魔女の断罪、魔獣の贖罪
title.romaji: Majo no Danzai, Majuu no Shokuzai

195659.description:
In the blessed land of Trastasa, Na-in is the cherished companion of Amon, the great and omnipotent god. Though Amon treats him with apparent tenderness, his cruel and indifferent ways haunt Na-in's every moment. When a striking servant with rare pink features called Rhan Gwen arrives, Na-in expects to lose Amon's attention. Instead, he discovers something unsettling… Rhan Gwen shows no interest in Amon, only in Na-in himself. As this mysterious yet beautiful man offers the gentle understanding Na-in has always craved, he faces an impossible choice between familiar darkness and uncertain warmth.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Snake That Swallowed a Pomegranate

title.english: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate

195660.description:
Yeon-Woo, the son of a hero who protected the country, is the number one candidate for groom among the village girls because he excels in both scholarship and martial arts. His only worry is that his lower body cannot stand due to erectile dysfunction. In order to solve his worry, he hears a rumor about a rock that grants wishes and climbs up the mountain behind the village, where he finds a young man being raped by a monster. As he hurries to save him, Yeon-Woo notices something wrong with his own body first...!

"Why is it standing up all of a sudden?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 左遷錬金術師の辺境暮らし

195662.description:
After losing his wife, Yuichi Akamatsu struggled to maintain a relationship with his only daughter, Yuki. One night, he happens to witness Yuki wandering alone and when he decides to follow her..?! A father-daughter drama by an up-and-coming star!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

195663.description:
Kai, a tough-looking but kind-hearted young man, saves a girl from delinquents but gets caught in a car accident. When he wakes up, he finds himself in the mysterious “Shadow World,” a realm between life and death where people’s shadows take on powerful forms as Shadow Beasts. Learning he isn’t actually dead, Kai embarks on a journey with his shadow, a young girl, to find a way home. However, he soon becomes caught in the world’s power struggles, facing unexpected dangers along the way.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: My Otherworldly Reincarnation With a Overpowered Girl as My Companion
I Got Reincarnated but My Only Ally Is a Little Girl With Cheat Powers!?

title.native: 異世界転生、相棒はチート持ちの幼女なんですけど！？
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei, Aibou wa Cheat Mochi no Youjo Nandesu kedo!?

synonyms: Nakama wo Mamotte Shindara 20-nengo no Onaji Sekai ni Umarekawatta Ken…… demo Ore, Tensei Nikame nandakedo?
I Died Protecting My Comrades and Was Reborn Twenty Years Later in the Same World… But This Is My Second Reincarnation?

title.native: 仲間を守って死んだら二十年後の同じ世界に生まれ変わった件……でも俺、転生二回目なんだけど？
title.romaji: Nakama wo Mamotte Shindara Nijuunen-go no Onaji Sekai ni Umarekawatta Ken…… demo Ore, Tensei Nikame nandakedo?

195665.description:
I have a younger twin brother. His name is Sumiyuki.
He's so stylish, and kind, and cool, and can do whatever he puts his mind to. He's perfect.
I, on the other hand... have frail body... am clumsy... and can hardly even move.
My entire life I have depended on my brother for almost everything.

And... it fills me with guilt. That I am essentially robbing him of his precious time on this earth.
Ever since we were small, he has always done so much for me. Even now... he still does.

So, I thought that I should become independent.
To release my brother from his burden and let him live his life, but...

"Why... are you not depending on me?"

It would seem that my younger brother did not love me as his "older sister," and rather as a "woman."
A woman he has willfully and deliberately guided to become totally and utterly reliant upon him.

His perverse love drowns me... dragging me down into the deep dark swampy depths----

A manga version of the audio work of the same name.

(Source: BLIC-TL, translated)
synonyms: The Goldfish's Corpse Lies at the Bottom of the Swamp

title.romaji: Kingyo no Shigai wa Numa no Soko

title.native: ユメみるコイのはじめかた
別に俺たち付き合ってないし

195668.description:
Technology wins in all matters of romance and love. Let me teach you the ultimate technology to captivate women, "Love Engineering"! Watanabe, a 26-year-old patent attorney, is shocked when his beloved girlfriend Maiko cheats on him. He is depressed by the reality that nothing is going well and drowns himself in alcohol at a bar. Then, suddenly, Nagasawa, whom he met at work, appears and he witnesses him captivating a beautiful woman on their first meeting in an instant! Nagasawa tells Watanabe, who is chasing him, about the existence of the ultimate technology to be popular.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ぼくは愛を証明しようと思う。
title.romaji: Boku wa Ai wo Shoumei Shiyou to Omou.

195669.description: Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 57, was then licensed by Takeshobo for digital release.
synonyms: ハッピー・オブ・ジ・エンド 番外編 CANDY
Happy of the End: Bangai-hen - CANDY

195670.description:
"I have no one but you, so I'll forever be by your side."

His cute coworker is, to put it mildly, an obsessive dominatrix puppy?! After his subordinate Kotaro—who had taken a liking to a jaded, gay Tsukasa—lost his house and the two started living together, life was as full of peace and happiness as it was living with a puppy. However, the moment he suggests they stop living together, his cute coworker bears his fangs. "I won't forgive you for throwing me out. I'll fill every corner of you with my scent." Did human touch feel this good?! This obsession to over-pamper... His body is about to be tamed by the long-lost sense of pleasure...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Ten Extreme Laws of Love for My Beloved Master
title.native: 大大大好きなご主人サマへ、過激な愛の十戒を
title.romaji: Daidaidaisuki na Goshujin-sama e, Kageki na Ai no Jikkai wo

title.native: プロジェクト・ニル　灰に呑まれた世界の終わり、或いは少女を救う物語
title.romaji: Project Nil: Hai ni Nomareta Sekai no Owari, Arui wa Shoujo wo Sukuu Monogatari

195672.description: Contains extra stories published in the late 90s and early 2000s but only collected in 2004, including the long awaited chapters showing how the quintet first met and an extra interview with the original author, answering 30 questions
synonyms: Le Fou Fou Fou - Kimengumi - Les Spéciaux

title.native: 帰ってきたハイスクール！奇面組

195673.description:
"When I saw his ankle, it felt as if my mind went fuzzy"

Tsuyoshi meets Atsushi in gym class, and they quickly become friends. But as they grow closer, Tsuyoshi can't shake that weird feeling inside him. He begins to see Atsushi as more than just a friend. For Atsushi, too, their bond is special. But as something shifts, their friendship can't stay the same. This is a story of first love and friendship, filled with bittersweet nostalgia.

(Source: Star Fruit Books)

Note: Includes two chapters previously published in 1997 as a bonus and the revised version published in 2004 as the main story.

195674.description:
The story of Yun-Ji, an innocent new teacher at Charlene Prep Academy. She wanted nothing more than to be kind and respectable. But before she knew it, she became the object of their darkest desires, and now she craves it too.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

195676.description:
1. Dilos no Houkou (デロスの咆哮)
2. Golgo in Sandstorm (ゴルゴin砂嵐)
3. Samegari (鮫狩り)
4. Ketsumuke no Yado (尻むけの宿)

title.native: 現代コミック  さいとうたかを集

195677.description:
After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195678.description:
A boy who once proposed marriage to his kindergarten teacher Tsumugi-sensei, has grown up and returned to carry out his promise―!?
A super straightforward age-gap romantic comedy!

(Source: Comic Lux, translated)

title.native: 悠くん、その恋ちょっと待って!?

195679.description:
This is an essay manga in which Sousuke Toka, the author of Ranking of Kings, looks back on his past days of frustration and difficulties. In his 20s, he had tried to become a manga artist, but it didn't work out, and he was forced to get a regular job. More than a decade later, he made the momentous decision to take another shot at his dream. The story depicts his process of getting back into manga-drawing, filled with anxiety, setbacks, courage, and determination.

(Source: East Press, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 脱サラ41歳のマンガ家再挑戦　王様ランキングがバズるまで
title.romaji: Datsusara 41-sai no Mangaka Saichousen: Ousama Ranking ga Bazuru made

195681.description:
Makino can't shake the feeling that his junior coworker, Arikawa, doesn't really like him. Whenever their eyes meet, Arikawa quickly looks away, and when Makino tries to talk to him, all he gets back are stiff replies. Feeling down about this, Makino unexpectedly gets a chance to turn things around when he ends up taking care of Arikawa’s pet parrot, Lip! Makino thinks this is the perfect opportunity to finally get closer to Arikawa, but then Lip suddenly blurts out, "Makino-san, I like you—you're cute"...?

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: I want to break the pretty you. The cute aggression of a childhood friend.

title.native: 可愛いあなたを壊したい 幼馴染キュートアグレッション
title.romaji: Kawaii Anata wo Kowashitai: Osananajimi Cute Aggression

195683.description:
Toma is nicknamed the "Ice Queen," due to his cold demeanor and expressionless look. Lately, he's been thinking a lot about how touchy-feely his roommate and long-time friend Hinata has been with him... because he's in love with Hinata. Just as the two turn 20, they each receive a letter in the mail from the "Make Japan Happy Project," a nationwide program that uses A.I. to pair couples for marriage based on their compatibility. Toma assumes he will have to give up on loving Hinata once Hinata is paired with someone... but the matchmaking service ends up pairing the two together! This is a marriage story filled with mishaps between a clingy puppy-dog guy and his husband-to-be who is totally oblivious to how popular he is.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Arranged Marriage with a Childhood Friend

title.english: My Imperfect Marriage To My Childhood Friend

195684.description:
Crybaby Koharu can't help but be curious about Niwa-kun, who sits in front of her. Why do her feelings grow and overflow, turning her into tears? A story of love and tears!

(Source: Margaret, translated)

195685.description: Cesare Borgia, the most beautiful hero in the history of the Renaissance. The story depicts Cesare's first and last love, which oscillated like a flame for a moment between history.

title.native: カンツォニエーレ　チェーザレ番外編

195686.description:
Hyeon-Seung has gone his entire life without anyone realizing he’s a vampire - until Tae-Hee, his teammate for a group project, uncovers his secret. What’s worse, Tae-Hee is a hardcore vampire otaku, so try as he might to hide his identity, Hyeon-Seung’s identity has been laid bare. Tae-Hee promises to keep quiet, but only after bombarding Hyeon-Seung with endless questions and enthusiastic fanboying. Dazed and cornered, Hyun-Seong finally agrees to help fuel Tae-Hee’s obsession, forming a strange symbiotic relationship fueled by blood and fandom. But as the two grow closer, their relationship grows into something more…giving bloodlust a whole new meaning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195687.description:
After returning to school after his military service, Tae-Geon drinks at a welcome party and blacks out. The next day, he dreams of spending a night with his friend Kang-San… But this doesn’t seem to be a dream?! The moment Tae-Geon tries to revive his fragmented memories to check if it’s San, he notices San’s ear. But didn’t you originally not have earrings? As the situation gets more complicated, he runs into Kang-Dan, who looks just like his brother. As soon as they meet, Dan asks Tae-Geon to buy him a meal and Tae-Geon is led there where he hears a shocking story…

“Senior, you attacked me yesterday. Are you going to take responsibility for me?”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: Take Responsibility For My First Time

195688.description:
Seo Hyo-Min, an actor with a handsome face and outstanding acting skills, but who has been in obscurity for a long time. One day, he receives a business card from someone who is interested in him. The owner of the business card is Kang Soo-Heon, a third-generation chaebol known as a sponsor for new male actors. Hyo-Min was worried that he might be the sponsor of a perverted old man, but Soo-Heon appeared in front of him, and he was handsome. When Hyo-Min confessed(?) that he was a virgin, Soo-Heon became interested...

"Should I be affectionate at first or... should I be so affectionate that he loses his mind?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

195690.description:
“You must be the one to reign over the world!”

With those parting words, Jin Sanwol’s fate was sealed. At just 23 years old, he becomes the head of the Jongnam Sect, once a proud and powerful clan, now reduced to only eight remaining disciples and barely clinging to survival. Once a sect that dreamed of dominating the martial world, it is now a shadow of its former glory. Yet Sanwol cannot afford to grieve or hesitate. To honor his master’s dying wish, to keep the sect alive, and to carve a new path — Jin Sanwol must step into the ruthless world of martial arts, where only the strongest survive. The battle for supremacy begins anew, and he must stake everything to reclaim his sect’s former greatness… and conquer the martial world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Last Master of Jongnam Sect

195691.description:
After being reborn, all Litia wants is a quiet career training dragons. But when Duke Albarant’s temperamental dragon chooses her as its trainer, she's faced with an unexpected offer. She tries to refuse the persistent duke, but that's easier said than done when he never takes no for an answer. A dragon’s choice, a duke’s determination, and one very reluctant heroine—can Litia hold onto the peaceful life she's dreamed of, or will this second chance demand far more than she's ever bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Find Yourself Another Trainer, Your Grace

195693.description:
Neo, Solomon, Lucifer, Pandora, Jack the Ripper! The characters from the hugely popular smartphone game "Monster Strike," which has a total of over 62 million users worldwide, live together in Kinshicho, Tokyo...?! What kind of daily life will Neo and the others spend in this world, in this town? The gentle world slow-life comedy begins!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: モンスターストライク 下町ハローワールド

195694.description: The legendary delinquent (yankee) is back!! Fighting, love, and the occasional bug-catching!? A diamond yankee with 100% youthful purity!!

title.native: 京四郎 少年ヤクザ編

195695.description:
Let's get some fuckin' diiick!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-06

title.native: スリーピース・バインド

195696.description:
Every day, the muscular young man Kataoka dedicates himself to building his muscles. At his regular gym, there's one staff member he can't take his eyes off. Her name? Shiina. But what caught his attention wasn't her curves... it was her plump, round belly!?

(Source: Yanmanga, translated)
synonyms: Big Muki Muki & Small Muchi Muchi

title.native: 大きいムキムキ小さいむちむち

195698.description:
The story follows a love triangle involving Neri, a woman who dislikes being feminine; Kiri, a cross-dressing man; and Suou, an otherwise heterosexual man who finds Kiri attractive. The series was critically well received for its themes of questioning gender roles, and was selected as one of the recommended works at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2018.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

195699.description:
Tim Owelly always showed an interest in the occult, though nothing he's ever reported on as an occult blogger has convinced him the supernatural actually exists. But when strange and paranormal reactions to the horror movie star Johnathan McStars begin bubbling up online, Tim's curiosity gets the better of him and sends him down a disastrous road towards the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title.native: メスガキサンタの長舌フェラ抜き
title.romaji: Mesugaki Santa no Chouzetsu Fella Nuki

title.native: 恋に堕とせ！　ヴァルキリーちゃん

195702.description:
How the Strongest Tanker Bae Wang-Sik Protects the Earth.

Bae Wang-Sik, a tanker from the Hunter Nation of Korea who is not widely known to the outside world. Despite the request for naturalization from the United States by the Hunter Nation Director Kang Il-Seop due to his upright personality and his own personal goals, Bae Wang-Sik continues to operate in Korea. Bae Wang-Sik, who was kidnapped to the world beyond the gate, the 'Azelan Continent', 10 years ago and suffered terribly before returning alive, has the goal of protecting the entire Earth and bringing his friends who were kidnapped with him back to Korea. And the moment he achieves that goal...! He moves to destroy the Azelan Continent, which is trying to destroy the human race of Earth by invading the gate.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

195704.description:
Volume 1 (2025/02/01)
Cover: Tsuttsu

1. Watashi no Onee-chan (私のお姉ちゃん) [Neriume]
2. Yuri Omutsu Emaki Dekakuri Shinderera to Omorashi Seito Kaichou (百合おむつ絵巻 デカクリシンデレラとおもらし生徒会長) [Amashoku]
3. Anju. Omutsu Shoujo no Hatsukoi Bibouroku (アンジュ。～おむつ少女の初恋備忘録～) [Maroru Hanawa]
4. Omorashi Musume no Kakurenbo (おもらし娘のかくれんぼ) [T-shirt]

6. Jojisou Omutsu Saikoroji & Shuuchi ga Hito ni Ataeru Nikutai Eikyou (女児装おむつさいころじぃ & 羞恥が人に与える肉体影響) [Manaita]
7. Oshiri wo Dashinasai! (お尻を出しなさい！) [Watashiki]

195705.description:
One day, Yeon Woo-Hyeok fell into the world of martial arts and became a civil servant in the martial arts world.

Yeon Woo-Hyeok, a veteran of the martial arts mystery game [The Great Revolutionary King's Great Pokai], one day finds himself possessed by a Po-Kwai in the game without warning. Fortunately, he realizes that the events in the game that he had memorized are exactly as they appear, and begins to adapt to being a Po-Kwai in the game while solving the cases. However, the joy is short-lived as Yeon Woo-Hyeok's ability, 'Young-An', is actually an upper chamber opening, and because of this, he is in danger of dying. No, being a Po-Kwai is difficult, so he has to learn martial arts to become a powerful master?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: How to Survive as a Martial World Civil Servant
How to Live as a Civil Servant in Murim

195706.description:
Hildegard is the best seamstress in Luminian, but her past life was different. Born in Korea, she was raised to work in fashion before she died in an accident. Now reborn in a fantasy world, she turns to sewing again, unaware that her talent has caught the eye of the crown prince. With an ambition to advance his empire through textile arts, he makes her a surprising offer to become the empress. As fate unwinds like thread from a spool, this choice will reshape her life—and the empire—for good.

(Source:Tapas)

195707.description:
The Korean War. The story of Korean soldiers fighting together in a foreign legion of different nations and races.

During the Korean War, the Korean soldiers and civilians assigned to the French battalion transported supplies as the 'Porter Unit'. At first, the French soldiers seemed distant, but as the battles continued, they became close and eventually became comrades who were more relied on than anyone else. The story of them fighting as one despite being from different countries and races.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

195708.description:
Veteran actor Cha Jae-Hwan has built his career on discipline and perfection. So when a close director friend asks him to star in the historical film Ja-Hwa, he expects a challenge, but not this one. At the first script reading, Jae-Hwan meets his co-star, Shin Seong-Hyeon, a rookie actor with raw potential but zero polish. His delivery is flat, his timing off, and his presence all over the place. For someone like Jae-Hwan, who breathes precision, it’s unbearable. Yet instead of walking away, he finds himself guiding Seong-Hyeon, patiently at first, then with a curiosity he can’t quite name.

“Shin Seong-Hyeon is an invasive species,” the director jokes. “You can’t control him. You just have to let him adapt.”

But as rehearsals blur into something far more intimate, Jae-Hwan begins to wonder who’s really changing whom…

The performance, it turns out, isn’t just on camera.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.native: 長身ボーイッシュ子、「メス」の喜びを味わう。
title.romaji: Choushin Boyish Ko, "Mesu" no Yorokobi wo Ajiwau.

title.native: よく一緒にバスケした長身ボーイッシュな幼馴染
title.romaji: Yoku Issho ni Basket shita Choushin Boyish na Osananajimi

title.native: 心だけでなく身体も満たしてくれるち◯ぽに出会った女子大生
title.romaji: Kokoro dake de Naku Karada mo Mitashite Kureru Chinpo ni Deatta Joshidaisei

title.native: 距離感近いクラスの陽キャ女子
title.romaji: Kyorikan Chikai Class no Youkya Joshi

title.native: 夏祭りに誘って告白する予定だった好きな子にラノベ貸し
title.romaji: Natsumatsuri ni Sasotte Kokuhaku suru Yotei datta Suki na Ko ni Ranobe Kashi

title.native: 時の止まった世界で〇〇てする話
title.romaji: Toki no Tomatta Sekai de 〇〇te suru Hanashi

195716.description:
The sacred heavenly gate looms high in the boundless sky, while the abyss of time and space wreaks havoc upon the world. As twelve spiritual springs rise from the earth and the moon slips beyond humanity’s grasp… where will our destiny lead? The realm of gods? The domain of demons? No, this is a world that belongs to humanity! I will claim the crown that no one else dares to bear and rise as the king of a new era. My name is Ren Jie, and to live is to be extraordinary!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 熱血体育教師（既婚者）VSヤリラフィー

195718.description:
Sora Hoshino is an unassuming college student who loves astronomy. One day, a handsome man appears before Sora completely nude, and introduces himself as Regulus, prince of a dying alien species with an extremely low fertility rate. While scouting for a new breeding partner, Regulus has been watching Sora from space, and asks for his hand in marriage. Sora has his doubts, but Regulus's tentacles and mysterious cosmic powers feel too good to resist...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I Found A Cute Earthling So I Asked Him To Mate With Me
title.native: 可愛い地球人がいたので交配を申し入れてみた
title.romaji: Kawaii Chikyuujin ga Ita node Kouhai wo Moushi Iretemita

195719.description:
Iori Tachibana has never had any problems with women. He made his debut as a romance novelist with stories based on his own experiences, which both made him quite famous and started his extravagant spending habits. Now, for reasons he doesn't wish to disclose, Iori has writer's block, so he travels to a secluded inn in the mountains looking for a cure... The inn is run by his old friend Madoka, and she assigns cute, young Souma as his room attendant. But, Souma's a guy! Iori had been hoping for a girl... In particular, he'd been hoping for the beautiful female dancer he briefly saw outside. He thinks she might just be able to cure him... With that, he starts searching for her, but has no luck actually finding her. As a last resort, Iori asks Souma about the dancer, but while Souma knows her, he won't tell Iori anything... Could she have something to do with Souma's secret...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Room Attendant to a Naughty Novelist!
title.native: イケナイ作家と仲居クン！

195720.description:
The chef who cooks the delicious grated carrot salad at Wolf's Bistro is a very handsome guy, but he also tends to cling to his lovers and stalk them. And yet, it turns out that Yuma, a food reporter, kinda digs this strange form of affection!! This compilation is full of hot and mind-blowing content with two chaptered stories, two one-shot stories, and lots of previously unpublished works!!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 犯され系アニマルセラピ

195721.description:
“I was so eager to meet you. Become mine this time."

Though she used to be a hero in a different world, Haruna reincarnated as an ad agency worker in Japan. It turns out that Mao, the handsome man she keeps seeing in her office and in her favorite pub, was actually the Demon King she slayed in her previous life! She thought that his clingy love and absurd personality was ridiculous but... “I'll definitely cherish you...! I want to do... erotic things too..." He is all affectionate while kindly and erotically touching her sensitive nipples and inside, so Haruna can't resist anymore...!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 이번 생에 용사와 마왕은 필요 없어

title.english: But You Like Me So Much that You Tried to Destroy the World!
title.native: 世界滅ぼしちゃうくらい私のこと好きなくせに!
title.romaji: Sekai Horoboshi Chau kurai Watashi no Koto Sukina Kuse ni!

195722.description:
Rokumeikan Women's University is a rich girls' school full of extremely wealthy students whose parents can easily buy them apartments nearby. The story unfolds when three girls—Andou, ​​Bessho, and Chikara, who have no common ground other than attending the same women's university—meet. Andou is a soft-spoken beauty with a reputation for being a bitch; Chikara is a solitary, cool beauty; and Bessho works at a bistro near the school.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated and edited)
synonyms: Marriage of a Fallen Young Lady

195723.description:
One day, Kaneko Kasane, a tax accountant who has just been divorced, is visited by a beauty influencer named Binan. He turns out to be Kaneko's younger childhood friend, Yoshio, who she was separated from after a fire at her family's apartment. The two decide to team up to help people in need...

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

195724.description:
An omnibus story set in Kabukicho, Shinjuku. The first episode begins with Ami, a high school teacher, reuniting with her former student Yagi at a host club in Kabukicho. Ami is confused by the unexpected reunion with Yagi, who confessed his feelings to her in high school, but they continue their relationship as host and customer.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195725.description:
An omnibus about bodies that people should be able control but can't. It contains the stories of seven people, including Mayumi, who tries a menstrual cup to overcome the depressing effects of her period, Takashi, who has a sad story about hair removal, and Nanami, who became bad at speaking after being teased about her voice in middle school.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 体にまつわるエトセトラ

195726.description:
A story about women in their 30's running a share house. Mugi, a woman who was dumped by her boyfriend after prioritizing her idol activities over their anniversary date, reexamines her way of life and how she interacts with others, and consults her best friend Tomoyo about her worries. Tomoyo suggests to Mugi that they work together to create a share house that will be "a women's garden where girls can be independent and support each other." Despite not knowing how to find tenants and how to interact with the people they live with, this manga depicts how the girls build their ideal home where they can be themselves.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: むぎのはな～shared life is beautiful～
title.romaji: Mugi no Hana: shared life is beautiful

195727.description:
Yamato, a high school student, is troubled by a recurring dream. In these dreams, mysterious tentacles do naughty things to him, which he finds increasingly pleasurable. The tentacles attack him wherever he goes, even during class or in the nurse's office... what is their true identity?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Neko to Janken (ネコとじゃんけん)" and one extra chapter.
synonyms: 幽霊とぼく〜のうらんの夢〜
Yuurei to Boku: Nouran no Yume

195729.description:
On the outskirts of Glyn Glyn, there is a house among the fields of cabbage and cauliflower. Three old maids live in this house, and a boy who claims to be the orphan of King Britain Grable arrives. His name is Tarr Boo Beck. He is sent to school the next day, but strange things start happening, such as his hat exploding and cabbages coming from the fields into the house. It's a spell that Posy has cast that went wrong. The three are witches. Despite all this, Tar Boo Beck lives his school life, but one day, while Tar Boo Beck is in the classroom, Posy uses magic to deliver an umbrella to him. Tar Boo Beck is scolded for this and ordered to clean the principal's office as punishment. There, he discovers a secret: when thunder strikes, the principal transforms into a rabbit. It seems like everyone in this town is a little quirky...

(Source: Translated, Moto Hagio Works Library)

title.native: キャベツ畑の遺産相続人

195730.description:
When Hyeon-U moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeon-U soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeon-U realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: テラリウムの住人たち

195731.description:
The greatest genius painter of this century, Choe Hu-Ram, plagiarized the painting of android Zeta while in a severe slump. A four-week art festival begins with Choe Hu-Ram trying to hide the fact and Zeta trying to dig it up! The irony shown by humans who are less than human and androids who are more than human. Who will be the final winner?

(Source: Naver, translated)

195732.description:
After a brutal breakup, Yubyeol flies to Spain alone where one wild, blurry night with a stranger named Seonu changes everything. Back in Korea, fate brings them together again… but this time, they only have 90 days before Seonu must return to Spain. Between unresolved heartbreak, unexpected chemistry, and a deadline she never asked for, can Seonu find his ticket into Yubyeol’s heart before the final boarding call?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: รักนี้ไม่ต้องมีวีซ่า

title.english: Finding a Ticket Into Your Heart

title.native: 震える夜に…〜一花が後輩クズ男に体を許した理由
title.romaji: Furueru Yoru ni...: Ichika ga Kouhai Kuzu Otoko ni Karada wo Yurushita Wake

195735.description:
Note: Won the 4th Kodansha Manga Award for Shoujo in 1980.
Volume 3 contains the one-shot Seishun no Spotlight (青春のスポットライト)
synonyms: 青春のスポットライト

195736.description:
Killed when her employer, the drunkard Timothy Reynold, is accused of treason, Agnes May Graham wakes up 14 years in the past. Eager to change her fate, Agnes becomes young Timothy's tutor in order to guide him toward a better path. However, she soon learns Timothy's misbehavior stems from the negligence of his guardian and her killer, the distant Duke Ethan Battenberg. Educating children is Agnes' expertise, but how can she solve this problem when it's her employer who really needs a lesson?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'll Change the Ending Through Home Education
Let's Change The Ending To Home Education
Rewriting the Ending with Proper Upbringing

title.english: I'll Change the Ending With Education

195737.description:
Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, I-yeon Yu. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day... "Let's live together." Do-hyeon An, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to her. No one can ever discover their contract marriage or her true identity. Under the same roof begins a thrilling and breathtaking romance of secrets and deception.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

195738.description:
Haunted by her mother's life as a mistress, Minkyeong carries only bitterness toward her father. She builds a fragile peace away from him, until a stranger named Jinhyeok enters her world. With calm but forceful resolve, he declares that wherever she runs, he will always find her. What begins in fear slowly becomes a dangerous comfort. However, on the day she offers him a birthday gift, the fragile boundary between them collapses. What follows after is not happiness, but a love steeped in destruction.

(Source: Tappytoon)

195739.description:
Da-Eun has been living as a workaholic since her parents' sudden accident. The near-death accident became a new turning point that changed her values ​​in life. She confides her determination and secret to only one person.

"I want to have a child."

Jae-Han has been by Da-Eun's side for a long time while hiding his feelings. One day, Da-Eun confesses her shocking plan to undergo artificial insemination. She wants to have a child with a sperm of an unknown man? Rather...

"I'll give it to you."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: จุดเปลี่ยนแห่งรัก

195740.description:
There's no way you won't fall in-love by having sex with an idealistic man. Miyuki is a serious guy working at a supermarket. He wants to change the serious part of him that keeps himself from doing well in life... With the help of some alcohol, he makes a profile on a matching app for gays. The man named Kuzumi that he quickly matches with and meets, happens to be younger and more handsome than expected. "I'll hit all the areas you can't reach yourself." He easily takes the lead for inexperienced Miyuki, showing him what he can't do on his own... Inexperienced Miyuki becomes engulfed by the alluring sex with Kuzumi......

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: First Let Me Strip Off My Seriousness -The beginning of Love With An Ideal Friend With Benefits-
title.native: まずはマジメを脱いでから～理想のセフレとはじめる恋～
title.romaji: Mazuwa Majime wo Nuide kara: Risou no Sefure to Hajimeru Koi

195741.description:
Socially, omegas are lowly regarded and the world in this story is just like modern Japan. To correct this social inequality, the "omega employment act" was passed and it requires companies to actively hire omegas. The main character, Arata, is an omega and he's one of the many hired by a major company thanks to this act. His company is a famous one where it's hard even for alphas and betas to be hired, but the role he's given there is a special type of "slave" that has to take care of certain needs of his alpha and beta co-workers...
Due to his stress, he doesn't have regular heat cycles anymore. Full of mental and physical exhaustion, one day Arata stumbles upon a cat cafe on his way to work and decides to use it as a napping spot. There, Arata meets the cafe owner, Touya. But, when the two come close together, Arata goes into heat even though he's not supposed to...

(Source: Renta!)

195742.description:
Byeong-Pil, who was just discharged from the military, is conflicted about whether to return to the department he had chosen out of necessity or to find another future. At that moment, he receives a request from his senior and friend, Man-Su, to find his uncle, and with financial support from Man-Su's family, he works part-time to 'ind Man-Su's uncle with Man-Su. Since the disappearance was not related to a crime, the police drew the line that it was not their job, and since his whereabouts were completely unknown as a missing person, even the detective agency gave up, but Byeong-Pil searches for traces of his uncle through his own investigation. By entering the world of his uncle, which he had no interest in and no need to know about, and encountering his uncle's agony, joy, and ideals, Byeong-Pil's eyes are opened in a new way. Byeong-Pil meaningfully organizes his career path that he had been contemplating.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

195743.description:
Society has discovered that in addition to alphas and betas, some people are born as "omegas." However, omegas face severe discrimination. Abandoned by his parents at birth due to his omega status, Sei grew up in an orphanage, but he escaped as soon as he reached maturity and started living free, like a stray cat, off any man he could find.
One day, Sei bumps into a childhood friend he hasn't seen in forever, Yuki Omiyata, a.k.a. Omi. Somehow, this leads to him moving in with Omi! For the first time ever, Sei's living a wholesome life in a stable home. Not only that, Sei realizes Omi's been harboring feelings for him all this time, and finds himself attracted to Omi, too. But, one day, Sei finds out he's got a baby of his own growing inside him...! This spinoff weaves a tale of young love, taking place more than ten years earlier than "The Siesta Mates."

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Omega At Dawn -This Cat Doesn't Need A Mate!-
title.native: 暁のオメガ～気ままな猫は番（つが）わない～
title.romaji: Akatsuki no Omega: Kimama na Neko wa Tsugawanai

195744.description:
Tachibana, an alpha who turned from salaryman to yakuza, works under Gotou, a beta and the young head of a group backing an omega brothel. But the truth is, Tachibana was ordered to secretly keep an eye on Gotou. What is the secret of Gotou, who rose to the top of the group’s ranks as a beta...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 素晴らしきこのクソ世界

195745.description:
Takai was killed by his wife after she found out he was gay. But when he wakes up, he finds himself back in his college days...!? A BL time leap about a man who never fell in love and wants to start over.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

195746.description:
Grace, the daughter of a duke in the Kingdom of Centport, is cruelly betrayed by her fiancé, Crown Prince Lucas. With their engagement annulled and her noble status stripped away, Grace is forced into the life of an escort. In her quest for revenge, she chooses none other than the tyrant Emperor of Solvalence as her patron.

“If I become your patron, what merit is there for me?”

“I can grant your wish, Your Majesty.”

What began as a relationship of mutual convenience takes an unexpected turn. So why does His Majesty keep calling me to his bed every night?

The fallen, bewitching Grace and the mad dog of an emperor she’s tamed embark on a sharp yet sweet quest for revenge!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: I'll Be Your Genie for a Price
title.native: 暴虐皇帝を手懐けました

195747.description:
Violetta, striving to support her sister after losing their parents, encounters Theobald, an enigmatic aristocrat who irrevocably alters her life. Taking on the role as Theobald's maid, Violetta navigates treacherous waters filled with political intrigue and forbidden desires. As Violetta and Theobald's relationship deepens amidst a backdrop of betrayal and manipulation, Violetta grapples with her conflicting loyalties and the moral ambiguity of her role as both confidante and pawn in a dangerous game.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 夜になると伯爵様が豹変します

195748.description:
After sacrificing her life to save a cat, Rio Yamabuki wakes up to find herself back in the past, on the very day her future husband proposed fifteen years ago. Back then, she thought marriage would bring happiness. But reality turned it into a nightmare of emotional abuse, exhausting caregiving for her husband's family, and a betrayal so deep that her husband and his lover—her best friend—ultimately took her life for insurance money.

As Rio reels from these painful memories, a grim reaper appears and offers her a second chance: "Have the kind of marriage you want this time." Determined to rewrite her fate, Rio vows to live for herself and seize her own happiness! But just as she’s ready to take her next step, an unexpected twist arises—THREE amazing men, each claiming to be her husband, suddenly appear!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: Watashi wo Aisuru Sannin no Danna-sama
My Three Husbands Who Love Me

title.native: 私を愛する3人の旦那さま

195749.description:
I'm an illegitimate daughter who can't be seen in the light. i've lived a peaceful life with my mother since l was a child. An explosion accident made me lose all my relatives, However, this was not an accident but a murder!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

195750.description:
"Give me back my body!"

Lady Sophia was supposed to marry her beloved prince, Alfred, and live the rest of her life blessed with happiness. However, when the villainess of the story, Rosalie, places a terrible curse on her, their souls exchange bodies! Her once-happy life descends into absolute despair when Sophia--now Rosalie--is accused of a crime she didn't commit and is exiled from the palace.

"This isn't me! I want to go back to my old body!"

As she wanders away from the capital, she meets a merchant named Raul. With his help, Sophia sets off to change her fate and return to her rightful body!

(Source: Pocket Comic)

title.english: A Blessed Villainess, or a Cursed Heroine?
title.native: 悪女に奪われたヒロインの座、取り戻します！
title.romaji: Akujo ni Ubawareta Heroine no Za, Torimodoshimasu!

195751.description:
High-school junior Sosuke Hanada catches his new girlfriend making out with some random hot guy. To make matters worse, it turns out said hot guy, Natsuki Kirishima, just transferred to his class and gets seated right next to him! Sosuke can't stand how Natsuki toys with him, but at the same time, finds him sweet in just the right moments... Sosuke lets his guard down for just a second, which is enough time for Natsuki to steal Sosuke's first kiss!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 桐島くんはいじめたい

195752.description:
Ready to begin his college life in Tokyo, an extremely nervous Fukujiro Honda moves into a shared house, but minutes after arriving, he accidentally breaks an expensive vase...!! The house owner, Akira Monzenji, is also CEO of a men's underwear company. He takes one look at Fukujiro's stunning butt and promises he'll let him off the hook if he can take photos of Fukujiro wearing his company's products...!!!

A devoted-yet-twisted gentleman meets a pure-hearted college student with cheeks to die for. Their sweet love story filled with cute and raunchy underwear is just beginning♪

(Source: Renta!)

195753.description:
The protagonist, Momota, works for a small security company near the Kanto region. He is a good-natured but empty 24-year-old who lives his life in servitude to "what is considered right" - the law, company rules, common sense...
After finishing his familiar job directing traffic as usual, Momota gets a phone call from the company president. He is told to head to a farm to guard against vermin from the next day. There he meets a girl. Momota's life falls apart, and his new one begins.

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

195754.description:
Yusuke, who lives as a kept man, suddenly loses his home one day! When he goes to a bar to drown his sorrows, he ends up being caught by debt collectors. To make matters worse, he's injected with an aphrodisiac...?! In this desperate situation, two attractive individuals, the handsome Kaito and the beautiful Haruomi, appear. Yusuke, whose uncontrollable lust doesn't stop due to the aphrodisiac, is taken home by the two of them, and... “Don't look away from me while we're having sex." “Yusuke, you like having your ass messed up, don't you?" Monopolizing the infatuation of 2 high-spec men. The pampered pet Yusuke's overly naughty threesome cohabitation life!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

195755.description:
Kurokawa works as a cleaner, but dreams of becoming a novelist. Although she believes that "there must be something within me," her dream does not come true. One day, while visiting a place for work, Kurokawa meets Kabe Karate, a novelist she is a big fan of. Kabe is Amano, a bullied boy who used to sit next to her 10 years ago. This is a modern-day communication story that begins with the reunion of the two.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195756.description:
After being reincarnated into another world, Yuuma defeats the Demon King as a hero and returns safely to his original world. However, he accidentally brings the Demon King to his world as well...!?

195758.description:
Even after Mei's relationship with Yuuki is found out, she continues her intimacy with Aki. And as the days pass by, his deviant demands of her escalate. One day, Aki teases her with sex toys and leaves her in her room to endure the pleasure while he attends school. However, worried that Mei hasn't been coming to school recently, Yuuki decides to pay her a visit... and thus witnesses her unbecoming display. The indecent sight of Mei wriggling and writhing while stimulated by sex toys should be maddening, and yet, Yuuki cannot withhold his desires for her. He reaches out to touch Mei and... After which, Aki returns home and bears witness to the two in the throes of passion, only to say: "Mei, that's not good enough. You must sway your hips in a way that pleases men more." And thus, the three fall endlessly in the depths of debauchery.

This is a sequel to Sotozura no Yoi Osananajimi. It depicts the BAD END flavored route where Mei ends up in a threesome with Aki and Yuuki.

A collection of sometimes tender and sometimes sad short stories depicting different forms of love.

As long as you’re alive, I will always suffer. My older childhood friend is a hopeless jerk, and on top of that, he wants to die. He attempted many times, over and over again. I want to leave him. I know I can’t be happy if I stay with him… Why can’t I leave him?
2. Kurokami no Omoide (黒髪の思い出)
3. Me ni wa Me wo (目には目を)
4. Chalk no Ie (チョークの家)
5. Dekisokonai Robot (できそこないロボット)

195761.description:
26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

(Source: WEBTOON)

195763.description:
When college student Ryota comes home for the summer, a strange man is in his now-empty family home. Said man, Akira, quit his job because of relationship problems and left Tokyo for the countryside. However, he has no life skills whatsoever and is completely unsuitable for life in the country. Ryota, fearing that his precious home will be destroyed if Akira is left alone, says that he will take care of the housework if Akira lets him live there during summer vacation. While living together, Ryota can't help but worry about Akira, who has built a wall between them but occasionally shows Ryota his weak side. Then one night, a sleepy Akira mistakes Ryota for someone else and kisses him. With that, their relationship slowly starts to change... A caring boy and a heartbroken man. How will this strange living situation work out for these awkward guys...?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 間借りの男と恋わずらい

195764.description:
Kenji Kaga, an erotic cartoonist consumed by his unhealthy lifestyle, ends up hospitalized after falling unconscious trying to reach his deadline. His editor, not surprised by the number of times the cartoonist has reached that point, decides to hire an assistant to take care of Kenji. The appointed assistant, Rui Fumitsuki, turns out to be Kenji’s biggest fan. The misanthropic Kenji tries to come up with a way to make Rui quit of his own volition. The plan? Masturbating in front of Rui with the excuse that it's part of his artistic process.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

The story follows 30-year old office worker Misora Kikuna, who is the producer behind the otome game "Nanairo no tsuki" (Seven-Colored Moon). After a fatal run-in with an idol group's car, Misora is reincarnated into the world of "Nanairo no Tsuki" as the protagonist, and the most popular member of the idol group POLARIS7 is reincarnated as the prince.

(Source: Kadokawa)

195771.description:
Stacy climbed her way up to the top of the church as a powerful saintess—but in a male-dominated society, her cruel father just sees her as marriage material for political gain. Tired of being treated like a pawn, she comes up with a solution: a list of 8 unreasonable, non-negotiable, and self-indulgent conditions for any potential husband. That way, no one will possibly qualify, and she’ll be happily single...right?

Until one day, someone actually steps forward claiming he meets every requirement—the King himself?!

What started as a half-serious "perfect husband" checklist turns into a royal engagement!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Takanodai Teruki is a high school student who is just another bespectacled boy at school. After school, he is lost in thought in the former broadcasting club room, where it is rumored that "an eerie voice can be heard from inside." The true identity of the "eerie voice" is Takanodai himself, who tries to drive away the students who visit the room, but one day, the most popular female student in the grade, Koigakubo Keiko, comes to the club room... This is a slightly unusual story of love and youth, in which a mob character boy becomes the "god" worshiped by the honor student heroine.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

195773.description:
Lian, a thirty-year-old who runs a perfume business in the US. While looking for an assistant, she meets Eun-Seo who is studying abroad in the US. From the first time they meet, the much younger woman who flirts with him is funny, but they go to a hotel together. However, at the hotel, Eun-Seo reveals an unexpected secret and slowly strangles Lian, who is terrified.

How will the fatal yet inescapable relationship between Lian and Eun-Seo develop?

Detective Park Do-Hyeon is a towering force of nature, known for his fiery temper and reckless determination to close cases fast. But his habit of throwing himself into danger without a second thought lands him in the hospital once again. Rushing to his side is fellow detective - and lover - Lee Seung-Woo, Do-Hyeon’s complete opposite in both temperament and approach. Exhausted from watching Do-Hyeon get hurt time after time, Seung-Woo finally reaches his limit and breaks things off. Can Do-Hyeon win back the heart of the man who’s always been his anchor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

195776.description:
During the club MT, Han-Byeol and the blunt Wo-Joo start a relationship by taking advantage of the atmosphere. Watching the subtle atmosphere between the two of them, Han-Byeol thinks that Woo-Joo likes him, but Woo-Joo sternly denies it...

195777.description:
In a studio apartment with a broken air conditioner, Han-Young and On-Jo try to cool off with a weakly spinning fan. But for some reason, it just gets hotter...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195778.description:
Campus couple Joo-Won and Min-Hyuk!

They try to have some time for themselves, but it's not easy to share their love at school. Min-Hyuk suggests a 2-day and 1-night trip at this time. They've even made reservations at a hot pension, and it seems like they've planned quite a wonderful vacation...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195779.description:
As the rainy season approaches, Tae-Jun starts having dreams about having sex with an unknown man. Tae-Jun's friend teases Tae-Jun, saying that the ghost who died in an accident during the rainy season a few years ago is visiting him and trying to get him to visit...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

A fictional story of fictional characters set in real places and locations.

195781.description:
In the near future, a red line extends over people's heads. What is the identity of the line? As time passes, people begin to call the red line the S-line.

(Source: Naver, translated)

195782.description: Iku ran away from it all - from his school, from his home, from the burdens and expectations of his influential family. It's not an easy life, drifting from one part-time job to another, but he wouldn't have it any other way. Except, one day he helps a handsome, almost ethereal stranger through a social anxiety attack at a fancy party where he serves tables, and his life changes. This man is the famous author of illustrated books, Mito, and he wants to keep Iku in his life at all costs - including inviting him to live together in his mansion! How will the man who doesn't believe in love and the man who invents fairy tales for a living find their path together?

Ritsu is an alpha who hates alphas. "I want to bear a child," he says as he makes plans to change his sex through the "bitching" process before graduation. Hanano has just started going out with the super-popular boy Hanamiya-kun. But her first relationship is causing her all sorts of worries!?

Ren and Haruma are the archery club's unwavering aces. Despite being together since they were little, these two childhood friends still spend every day arguing... Being rivals is fun, but deep down, they both want more attention and secretly long to keep each other’s smiles all to themselves. They struggle to be honest and often express the opposite of their true feelings. One day, Ren's older brother and Haruma's idol, Jin, joins the archery club as a coach. Ren, who has an inferiority complex about his brother, is annoyed by Haruma’s excitement over seeing Jin, and ends up drunkenly kissing him...!?

One day, Yu-I meets Bae Yeong-Yeon, who says he fell in love with his performance at first sight, and he gradually opens his heart to Yeong-Yeon, who follows him around and helps him like a manager. Welcome to Leaders Academy for the Superhumanly Gifted! As Korea’s most elite superhero institution, we aim to bring out the best in our students and encourage them to use their powers for the good of— Pardon? Class F, you say? Apologies, but we don't talk about Class F here.

One year ago, her parents vanished.

Left all alone, Charlotte spends her days working as a maid in the castle. On her days off, she always returns to her family home, keeping it tidy so that her parents can settle back in the moment they return. But one day, she arrives to find a complete stranger inside!
