Will this unlikely pair be able to live together in peace—and perhaps even love?

(Source: Manta)

195818.description:
Damian is a powerful duke with a demihuman condition that makes him averse to human scents. So when he sees Kanna—a girl sold into slavery by her own family—at an auction, he cannot resist buying her. Will this attraction grow into love, or remain a mere carnal instinct?

(Source: Manta)

195819.description:
While struggling with hardships in her life, Yu-Na meets mysterious I-Yun at a bar. The night she spent with him was supposed to be a fleeting moment. But fate, or rather I-Yun, had other plans—for his meeting with her was far from a coincidence.

(Source: Manta)

195820.description:
Transmigrating into the body of a blonde-haired villain at the start of a yuri novel, Mu En just wanted to survive. But… why does the story seem to be going off track?

The princess is drugged and unclothed — so why hasn't the heroine shown up to save her yet? Why does the heroine’s childhood friend, a noble and pure saint, keep giving me flirtatious looks? Even my obedient personal maid has started looking at me in alarming ways!

Where is the heroine?! Please save me!!

"If you're going steal my women, you better be prepared to take responsibility…" the protagonist told me, with a kind smile on her face and a sharp machete in her hand.

(Source: SFACG, translated)
synonyms: The Blonde-Haired Villain in Girl Overlord Novel Also Longs for Happiness
The Yellow-Haired Villain in the Female Main Character's Novel Wants Happiness
The Yellow-Haired Villain in Soaring Phoenix's Novels Also Desires Happiness

title.native: 凤傲天小说里的黄毛反派也想幸福
title.romaji: Fengaotian Xiaoshuo Li De Huangmao Fanpai Ye Xiang Xingfu

195821.description:
Fed up with being treated like a child, Ye-Seo Han asks her husband, Ji-Heon Seo, for a divorce on the day she graduates from college. Although Ye-Seo wanted to move on from her first love, Ji-Heon refuses and instead offers to truly show her what being husband and wife is all about.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

195822.description:
To save her father, she has no choice but to accept a marriage arranged by her family. On the night of her engagement, the man she once secretly loved reappears. Now, he is the powerful figure behind the Royalcore Corporation and the man responsible for her father’s downfall. Cold and cruel in public, he secretly watches over and protects her…

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 娇妻甜蜜蜜：总裁，有喜了

title.english: Obsessive CEO, Please Let Me Go

195823.description:
After breaking up with a boyfriend who disrespected her career, Ji-Won spends a drunken night with a man who seems like a stranger. But he turns out to be a figure from her past – and now he's back in her life in a way she never expected, for better or worse.

(Source: Manta)

195824.description:
19 years ago, Jung-Won took in a scrawny girl named Hye-Jun, seemingly abandoned in the middle of the road, out of pity. It began as mere compassion, but what he couldn't have realized back then... was that this pitiful girl would become the woman who would steal his heart.

(Source: Manta)

195825.description:
One day, Mia, a mermaid with big dreams of romance, is reeled out of water by Jack, the coarse captain of the Heaven Pirates. To her disappointment, Jack looks nothing like the blond Prince Charming of her dreams, but Mia can't help but find herself mesmerized.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: กาลครั้งหนึ่งดั่งฝัน

195826.description:
Julia returns home after spending 12 years in a convent to find that Benjamin, the boy taken in by her father, has inherited her father’s earldom. She’s drawn to the kind and charming Benjamin, so when he asks to enter her room late one night, she finds herself unable to resist...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: รังรัก รังแค้น

195827.description:
Will Heaven triumph or will the fairies conquer all?

A siren prince, Heaven has it all — talent, beauty, and powerful abilities. But one day, the fairies attack and he's forced into hiding, dressing as a woman and selling snake oil to get by. The surviving sirens dream of revenge and the return of their royalty... but Heaven's got other plans.

(Source: Manta)

195828.description:
Do Wong-Yeol, an illegitimate son desperate to end his half-brother’s tyranny, enlists the help of a mysterious butcher named Gong Hyeon. Known for his uncanny archery skills, Gong Hyeon becomes the lethal weapon in Wong-Yeol’s plan for revenge. However, as they navigate a world where betrayal is the only currency, a forbidden heat begins to stir between the master and his assassin. Their path toward vengeance is paved with a misery neither can escape, leaving them to wonder if their bond is a source of salvation or their ultimate undoing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195830.description:
The protagonist, exhausted from working at a black company and longing for a peaceful life, is reincarnated into another world. However, the person in charge of reincarnation is a strange goddess who loves maids. A slapstick harem fantasy where the protagonist and various maid girls fight!!!　

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I'm an Isekai Master?!: About That Time I Got a Skill to Make Anyone "My Personal Maid"

title.native: 俺が異世界のご主人さま！？ ～誰でも「俺の専属メイド」にするスキルを手に入れた件～
title.romaji: Ore ga Isekai no Goshujin-sama!?: Dare Demo "Ore no Senzoku Maid" ni Suru Skill wo Te ni Ireta Ken

195831.description:
When deciding on the roles for their school's original play to be held at the school festival, Umino-kun, who is in charge of the script, suddenly selects Mashiro as the heroine...!?

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title.native: 新からふるＳＴＯＲＹ　ぐり～ん　かれんだあ
ひとりじゃないってば！

195837.description:
1. Shortcut (ショートカット)
2. Ko-i-bi-to (こ・い・び・と)
3. My Foreplay Music

195839.description:
1. Rockwell ga Waratteru (ロックウェルが笑ってる)
2. Hersey wo Ageru (ハ－シ－をあげる)

title.native: ロックウェルが笑ってる

195840.description:
1. Manatsu Monogatari (真夏物語)
2. Ame wa Tenshi no Nioi (雨は天使の匂い)
3. Ringo (林檎)

title.native: アンリさんは妊活している
推しと僕〜アイの証明はカラダに〜
title.romaji: Oshi to Boku: Ai no Shoumei wa Karada ni

195848.description:
One day, the protagonist wakes up in the body of Charlotte, a gentle healer living in a world of magic and nobility. Her new life seems peaceful, until she discovers that Charlotte had just accepted a suspicious commission: to create a love potion. The problem? Charlotte isn’t a witch, just a misunderstood herbalist mistaken for one. And before she can figure out who requested the potion, the Crown Prince himself shows up at her door. Convinced he’s the mysterious client, Charlotte panics. If she refuses now, she might lose her head for disobedience! So she decides to fake it till she makes it, brewing potions by instinct and stumbling into one awkward royal encounter after another. But the more she tries to survive, the more tangled her fate becomes with his.

“Wait… isn’t this one of those classic romance clichés?”

Apparently, it’s now her life.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ラブポーション・パニック〜愛の妙薬から始まる関係〜

title.native: パーティの女の子の方だけ呪いでサキュバス化しちゃうやつ
title.romaji: Party no Onna no Ko no Kata dake Noroi de Succubus-ka Shichau Yatsu

195850.description:
Dal-Ho is a sex therapist. One day, his best friend asks him a favor to reignite his wife's sexual desire. So begins an intense, eye-opening therapy session for the couple's sex life...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)
synonyms: 人妻不感症クリニック

195853.description:
1. Tonari no Ayane-san (となりのあやねさん); Comiket 97
2. Tonari no Ayane-san: Itazura Jidori to Oshioki Ecchi-hen (となりのあやねさん いたずら自撮りとお仕置きえっち編)
3. Tonari no Ayane-san: Desaki de Battari-hen (となりのあやねさん 出先でばったり編); Comiket 100

Note: A compilation was released at Comiket 103 (December 31, 2023) under the title Tonari no Ayane-san Soushuuhen (となりのあやねさん 総集編). It was later published by GOT COMICS on May 30, 2025.
synonyms: となりのあやねさん 総集編

title.native: 超乳忍法帖～くノ一搾乳孕み地獄～
title.romaji: Chounyuu Ninpouchou: Kunoichi Sakunyuu Harami Jigoku

195859.description:
In a world where your weapon is a literal mirror of your soul, your strength is determined by the depth and sincerity of your beliefs. Only a select few are able to summon swords of their soul, and those who can, are deemed “Warriors.” Meet Allen, a kind-hearted warrior-wannabe who refuses to let a cruel world change him. While others seek power out of pure greed, Allen’s heart of pure gold drives him to protect everyone with the unstoppable Sword of Purity. But the road to becoming a hero is rigged. The official qualification exams are strictly controlled by the realm’s apex executioners, the 10 swords of the king… who don’t seem too benevolent either. Can this boy who refuses to harm innocents grow strong enough to stay true to his path?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195860.description:
Edmund, a vampire who lives as the famous actor Sharon Thane but has actually lived for hundreds of years, has one problem. His relationship with his subordinate Michael is not what it used to be. When they first met, the stimulating and rough sex was satisfying...

Why on earth has this guy changed?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

195867.description:
When her mother vanished 15 years ago, she told Giselle to mark her words. "Never leave the imperial palace no matter what." Hoping that her mother would one day return, Giselle continued to work as a maid in the Moonlight Palace as a lonely outcast. One day, she was ordered to move to the Sun Palace where she would personally serve the crown prince. Giselle is concerned as Levan Klonitzsche was a fickle character known to fire his maids often. What would happen to her once she got fired? Would she have to leave the palace forever losing her chance of reunion with her mother? But much to her surprise, the crown prince, the man whom he sees in her prophetic dreams, takes a liking to the purple-haired girl. Giselle is not only a beautiful girl who speaks her mind, but unlike the previous kowtowing maids, but her touch also magically seems to relieve his pain, a curse which has been tormenting him all his life. Will Giselle be the one to forever free him of his affliction?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: The Cursed Prince and His Clairvoyant Maid
title.native: 呪われた皇太子の専属メイドになりました
title.romaji: Norowareta Koutaishi no Senzoku Maid ni Narimashita

title.native: 除霊詐欺～ネトられた人妻～

195870.description:
Lin Eun is a professional gamer who has been recruited to a game tester team for "The Last Step," a virtual reality game. One day, a big fire breaks out in the company building. To save a team member trapped in the game, Lin goes through the fire and logs onto the game. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the body of Princess Adriel, an NPC inside the game.

"How have you been, Lin?"

"This can't be real... How are you here?"

Si-Heon Ryu, the leader of the medical team, also gets trapped after following Lin into the game. Inside the game, he is another NPC named Richard Blanc Tesca, who is Adriel's fiancé.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.native: 種付けおぢに犯されたい

195875.description:
Seong Geun-Jong is possessed by a ghost while filming a horror movie. Geun-Jong, who has been suffering from ghosts visiting him at dawn, hears a rumor about a freshman at his university named Jeong Hae-Tae who sees ghosts. Geun-Jong desperately seeks out Hae-Tae to ask for help. Hae-Tae tries to refuse, but falls for Geun-Jong's charm, who has become a pitiful handsome man due to lack of sleep. And so the two begin a soft and strange journey together to shake off the ghost.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note:
-The side stories are rated R19.
- Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: It Didn't Exist, but It Did!
There Was None, but There Is!

195876.description:
Someone has appeared who seems to know me better than I know myself.

"That's right, you don't know me, do you? My name is..."

(Source: DAYcomics)

195884.description:
Soo-Hyun is an ordinary middle school boy who lives alone and has long hair. He enjoys going out to play after school with Jun-Hwi, who sleeps a lot, and Jeong-Hoon, who is shy. One day, he skips his usual after-school class to go out to play. Contrary to what he thought would be an ordinary day, he gets caught up in an incident...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

195888.description:
Two years after the brutal murder, Jun-Hwi is about to become a senior in high school. On the outside, he seems to be making friends and doing okay, but he still sees ghosts of his dead friends and cannot forget what happened.Then one day, the surroundings start to get noisy again due to a serial disappearance of women in their 20s, a dark shadow looms over Jun-Hwi and his friends, and the sound of a camera shutter. What on earth will happen to them?

The full-fledged school thriller After School 2 begins now.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Include two extra chapters.

195889.description:
The long-awaited final series of the trilogy!

A bigger scale and conflict. And the truth that is revealed too late. Did he really commit an irreversible act? - Jun-Hwi calmly caught the murderer even when his friends were murdered and in dangerous situations. But did he get too deeply involved? As the murder organization begins to watch his cleverness, he becomes anxious that 'I might end up like them someday.'

The story begins with Jun-Hwi waking up in an abandoned building with no memories from the past two months.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

195893.description:
What would have been another ordinary day for delivery driver Hyeon-Ho turns into an intimate fan meeting when he realizes his latest customer is Hae-Woon, his absolute favorite Mukbang creator. Flustered by the starstruck fan at his doorstep, Hae-Woon lets Hyeon-Ho inside. Overjoyed to meet his favorite creator in real life, Hyeon-Ho's excitement quickly gets the best of him—and his admiration turns hands-on as he begins boldly exploring Hae-Woon's surprisingly toned body up close and personal.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195894.description:
A clumsy girl who wants to make sweets for her younger brother asks a slightly gloomy, lonely boy for guidance! They're not family, but this is the beginning of a sweet and gentle relationship.

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

195895.description:
The Goddess of Love, Asa, accidentally shoots herself while trying to target a smug high school student named Nagi. Transformed into a human and stuck with a forced, one-sided crush, she must now find true love if she ever wants to get her wings back!!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)
synonyms: Too Soon to Fall in Love With a God

title.english: Too Early for a God to Fall in Love

title.native: NTRた青春～両想いだったはずなのに～
title.romaji: NTRta Seishun: Ryou Omoi Datta Hazu Nano ni

title.native: ネトラレライブ カレシ以外のチ○ポとめちゃくちゃ交尾した。
title.romaji: Netorare Live: Kareshi Igai no Chinpo to Mechakucha Koubi Shita.

title.native: デリヘル呼んだら妹がきた！
魔術高等学校優等生アリサ ～最愛の姉が寝取られる日～
title.romaji: Majutsu Koutou Gakkou Yuutosei Arisa: Saiai no Ane ga Netorareru Hi

title.native: 女聖騎士リン〜オーク侵攻にて敗北〜
title.romaji: Onna Sei Kishi Lynn: Orc Shinkou nite Haiboku

title.native: 君の好きにしていいよ

195906.description:
An otaku-minded older brother Arata and his gyaru younger sister Hana live together in the suburbs. The two of them spend this summer vacation they never expected to have as they please.

(Source: Web Action, translated)

synonyms: My Shitty Life Is All Because of the Tanuki

title.native: 俺のカスみたいな人生は全部タヌキのせい
title.romaji: Ore no Kasu Mitai na Jinsei wa Zenbu Tanuki no Sei

195908.description:
Tani, a university student looking for a cheap place to live, was introduced to a property where "super ghosts" have appeared, with a rent of 10,000 yen and no deposit required. However, unable to bear the supernatural phenomena, he seeks out roommates, and the people who show up are two peculiar men...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195909.description:
Lise the mermaid has a secret treasure among her companions. It is a painting of a beautiful young man that was on board a sunken ship. She breaks the mermaid tribe's rule of not getting close to humans and frequents the seaside castle, where she finds small happiness in gazing at the prince, who resembles the painting, from afar. She has had unrequited love for the prince ever since he saved her as a child. With her feelings for the prince and her interest in the human world growing, one day Lise decides to enlist the help of a witch to become human, but...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195910.description:
1. Sanagi (サナギ)
2. Ashidaka (アシダカ)
3. Houkou Eru Shoujo Tachi (彷徨える少女たち)
4. Mushi Monogatari (蟲モノガタリ)
5. Mushigurai (蟲喰い)

195911.description:
"Let's look at it together someday..." A vague memory of a promise made to the girl he had his first love with in his childhood to look at the chrysalis of the leucanthemum butterfly, which was said to be very beautiful. Hideaki, who had been living like an outcast, confined himself to a dimly lit, dilapidated room after falling ill and never going outside, began to dream of that past time again and again. One day, Hideaki picks up a strange, rainbow-colored butterfly chrysalis from a child making noise outside, and notices that it is getting bigger and bigger...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195912.description:
"I could never be the heroine, and there's no such thing as a prince on a white horse."

It’s been a year since Nao and Satomura became a real couple. Riko, who felt like her best friend had been taken away and that she was left behind, grew more and more fed up with Sosuke, Satomura’s friend, who frequently showed up at her workplace. One day, Riko’s ex-boyfriend, who is tied to a painful trauma from her past, suddenly shows up...

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

title.native: 賭けからはじまる最後の初恋
title.romaji: Kake kara Hajimaru Saigo no Koi

195913.description: A stalker and a detective walking the edge of the law?! Detective Peng Yanqing suspects he is being watched. The neighbor he suspects, Yi Fu, suddenly appears at his precinct as a major suspect. The tension between them starts to build, while strange cases quietly close in…
synonyms: My Neighbor Always Stares at Me
My neighbor is always watching me

title.romaji: Wo De Linju Zong Shi Dingzhe Wo

195914.description:
The path to greatness begins… tomorrow! It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: カノジョのママとの関係
title.romaji: Kanojo no Mama to no Kankei

title.english: Robin at the Break of Dawn
title.native: こまどりは今際の目醒め
ジャイアントロボ 地球が静止する日
title.romaji: Giant Robo: Chikyuu ga Seishi Suru Hi

195919.description:
The popular Dragon Age comics are now being made into a novel for the first time!

In this world, maids who can no longer stand their unreasonable masters have started a maid revolution. Fujiwara Naeka, the strongest swordsman in town, and her maid-loving younger brother Kosuke are waiting for their missing parents. Who are the two maids who serve them?

title.native: 仮面のメイドガイ メイド革命Ver.
title.romaji: Kamen no Maid Guy: Maid Kakumei Ver.

195920.description:
Upon turning 18, Third Prince Lucas was betrayed by his fiancée and witnessed his personal knight, Licht, killed before his eyes. Overwhelmed by grief at the loss of someone dear, Lucas cried out in anguish, plunging into the depths of despair... When he opens his eyes again, he finds himself back in the “world before the incident”!? Faced with the same gentle Licht as always, Lucas is overcome with love and tells him he's dismissing him from the position of his personal knight to prevent history from repeating itself. But suddenly, Licht's eyes change, and he seizes Lucas's lips—“If I'd known this would happen, I should've claimed you as mine sooner.”

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)
synonyms: Dark Sword for the Beloved Future

title.native: 愛しき未来に黒い剣を
title.romaji: Itoshiki Mirai ni Kuroi Tsurugi wo

195921.description:
"Don't you remember? We've done it before."

Towa works as an influencer for an apparel brand while paying off his ex-boyfriend's debts. One day, the president of a production company he knows asks him to appear on a dating reality show. Joining only for the appearance fee and with no intention of falling in love, Towa feels completely out of place. However, one of the participants, the charismatic composer Minami, rumored to have countless lovers, keeps persistently pursuing him. As it turns out, Minami was once a client back when Towa was selling his body for the sake of his ex-boyfriend...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ＃この恋愛はフィクションです

195922.description:
"Owner, your insides are crazy good..." An alpha's dick is inside me. This is not good...

The former legendary host, Tsubasa Hasumi, climbed up to the top of the nightlife districts by hiding the fact that he's an omega. He now runs a top-notch host club. One day, while interviewing the newcomer Hikaru Igarashi, Tsubasa suffers a violent heat that he has never experienced before. A carefree and pushy young host vs. the strait-laced and beautiful former emperor of Kabukicho. Omegaverse story about a superior who is overcome by love, heat, and his employee!

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Choose me as your lover at 2AM

195923.description:
After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. With her funds quickly deteriorating, Siella sets out on a mission: she must find a sponsor before it's too late!

(Source: Tapas)

195924.description:
After easily beating the Abyss of the Maze on its highest difficulty, Kaleb faces a new challenge…surviving his favorite video game for real! Even as a powerful mage, Kaleb learns things won’t be as easy as foes pretend to be friends, allies need rescuing, and danger is always a turn away. Armed with an insider’s knowledge and a magic hourglass that allows him to plan devastating attacks, Kaleb must save his friends and prepare for a battle with the Maze Master if he ever wants to get home!

(Source: Tapas)

195925.description:
A revolutionary novelization of the popular manga currently being broadcast as a TV anime!

Naeka is a busty high school girl and the granddaughter of a wealthy man. As soon as she put on the mysterious golden bra, a space-time quake occurred! Naeka and the housemaid Fubuki were sent to the Inca Empire! What will the maid do when her master is in big trouble?

title.native: 仮面のメイドガイ インカ帝国の逆襲 Ver.
title.romaji: Kamen no Maid Guy: Inca Teikoku no Gyakushuu Ver.

title.native: ハイスクール重機動作戦

195928.description:
Eri Moriyama, who dreamed of a glamorous life in the workplace and new encounters, spent her days dissatisfied at a small office in the countryside. She just couldn't accept that her much older, bossy senior had a super handsome boyfriend. "That's not fair," she thought, "I'm better," and her selfish unrequited love drove Eri out of control. Is this love, hatred, or a curse?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195929.description:
Sofia is reincarnated as a mob character in the world of her favorite otome game. Faced with the threat of her family's downfall, she uses her knowledge from her previous life as a seamstress to start "making clothes." After opening a tailoring shop, she receives various requests... A work-related fantasy in which a poor young lady changes the world with the magic of clothes!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

title.english: Fantasy-world Dressmaker Sofia: The broke noble daughter will make clothes using modern knowledge to enrich everyone's lives
title.native: 異世界仕立て屋ソフィア 貧乏令嬢、現代知識で服を作ってみんなの暮らしを豊かにします
title.romaji: Isekai Shitateya Sofia: Binbou Reijou, Gendai Chishiki de Fuku wo Tsukutte Minna no Kurashi wo Yutaka ni Shimasu

195930.description:
Brad Thring was a struggling DJ at the radio station KTUN. He gained popularity as a psychic DJ who could talk to spirits by having an acquaintance pretend to be a spirit and make requests on his show. He even stole the primetime slot from the legendary DJ Donald Walker. But then something happened and he was able to really talk to spirits...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195931.description:
A smug, boastful man named Jack has died. His son Dick goes to the town market to sell his father's belongings, a broken harp and a bird feather. These are the items his father had boasted about having obtained from the palace in the clouds by climbing up a magic beanstalk. When an old man notices the harp in the market, Dick realizes that his father's story is not a lie but the truth, so he sets out to get the magic beans himself...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: ジャックは豆の木の下で
title.romaji: Jack wa Mame no Konoshita de

195932.description:
There was a poor shoemaker and his wife. One night, Jean, the husband, fell asleep with some leather cut, and the next morning, he found a pair of beautiful shoes. The couple was shocked, but the shoes made by a mysterious person were sold and they gradually became more prosperous. Marie, the wife, wanted to thank that person, but...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: こびとと靴屋とその妻と
title.romaji: Kobito to Kutsuya to Sono Tsuma to

195933.description:
Shuuko, an office worker, has recently been treated coldly by her boyfriend Makoto, who works in the same company, saying that he is busy, so she decides to get her ears pierced to spite him. However, shortly after that, her coworker Yukari, who had her ears pierced before Shuuko, gets into a traffic accident, and Shuuko can't help but feel uneasy when she sees her coworker Yukari, who had her ears pierced before Shuuko, lament that the piercing had changed her "luck"...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195935.description:
Thirteen years ago, Yoh's mother suddenly disappeared without coming to pick him up from daycare. Even now that he is a high school student, Yoh is still traumatized by his mother and his own birthday. When his childhood friend Kanoko wishes him a happy birthday, Yho evades the call by saying "there are swarms of mosquitoes" and runs away. When Yoh returns home alone while his grandmother, with whom he lives, is away on a trip, the person waiting for him there is... his mother, who disappeared on his birthday thirteen years ago!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

195936.description:
"Even in death we never say it," is what people really think. But what if they really die...? Yes, the dead, who no one will listen to, end up blurting out their true feelings in the hopes that someone will listen. A part-time worker who loves to hear the cries of the dead and can hear their voices listens to the cries of the dead who have fallen into the hell of adultery.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

195937.description:
Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time running out, will Deoksun seek revenge or take another chance at love?

(Source: WEBTOON)

195938.description:
Once upon a time, there was a hungry wolf. Nowadays, animals are cautious and stay indoors, so the wolf has no time to eat. Then, he finds a house where seven careless little goats are staying at home...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)
synonyms: The Night Tale of the Wolf and the Seven Little Goats

title.romaji: Ookami to 7-biki no Koyagi no Yoru

195939.description:
Beyond the end of an affair lies even more hell. The mistress thought she had won but was dumped. The wife was hurt when she found out about her husband's affair and went to the mistress's parents' house. The wife's sister gets caught up in the affair, and the two-faced, devious husband is the root of all evil. Is it the wife or the mistress she clings to? The reality of the end of an affair is an extreme horror, a hell!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

synonyms: Isekai no Sumikko de Kaiteki Monodukuri Seikatsu

title.native: 異世界のすみっこで快適ものづくり生活 ～女神さまのくれた工房はちょっとやりすぎ性能だった～
title.romaji: Isekai no Sumikko de Kaiteki Monozukuri Seikatsu: Megami-sama no Kureta Koubou wa Chotto Yarisugi Seinou Datta

195942.description:
Killed by her own husband, the prince, Lady Amelie wakes up one year before her doomed marriage. Determined to change her fate, she proposes a contract marriage to Duke Gazelle Isaac—infamously known as the “Grim Reaper.”

His only condition?

She must bond with his emotionally scarred twins.

Surrounded by secrets and shadows, can Amelie rewrite destiny—for herself and the feared duke?
synonyms: I Became the Contract Mother of the Grim Reaper Duke's Family, and They Became Obsessed With Me
The Grim Reaper Duke’s Obsessive Contract Mother
사신 공작가의 계모가 됐더니 모두가 집착한다

title.native: 死神公爵家の契約母になったら執着されすぎました
title.romaji: Shinigami Koushakuka no Heiyaku Haha ni Nattara Shuushaku Saresugimashita

195943.description:
A whirlwind encounter transforms my once-ordinary and tedious life...

Mitsuba Uno, a university student attending on a scholarship, spends her days consumed entirely by her studies and part-time jobs. Then, one day, she crosses paths with Rei Mitsuya—an art major—and agrees to take on the job of cleaning his studio for 3,000 yen per session. Rei is a strange character: taciturn, aloof, and—to top it all off—a picky eater who has a knack for recklessly soiling his expensive designer clothes. Yet, touched by the occasional glimpses of kindness he reveals, Mitsuba finds herself growing intrigued by Rei—a young man who inhabits a world entirely different from her own...

It is precisely because something is missing that it becomes precious. A truth we have yet to realize... A coming-of-age ensemble drama about young people confronting their unfulfilled desires.

(Source: Kadokawa, machine translated)

195944.description:
Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new “puppy” to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That’s how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

"Forget my wife. Try me."

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: What About Me, Besides My Wife?
妻じゃなくて僕はどう？

195945.description:
Kotoha is a second-year high school student who puts all her energy into her part-time job, her studies, and her fashion sense. One day, when she returns to her boarding house, she finds out that Itsuki, a university student, is her temporary landlord!? Itsuki is great at cleaning, cooking, and being considerate, but Kotoha can't hide her excitement and confusion at his perfect landlord skills and his doting attitude!

A peaceful battle between an independent-minded honor student gyaru and a naturally charming university student begins.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

title.native: 女子の恋バナが絶対おかしい件
title.romaji: Joshi no Koibana ga Zettai Okashii Ken

title.native: 悪役令嬢の継母に転生したので娘を幸せにします、力尽くで。
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Mamahaha ni Tensei Shita node Musume wo Shiawase ni Shimasu, Chikarazuku de.

title.native: 悪役令嬢の継母に転生したので娘を幸せにします、力尽くで。THE COMIC
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Mamahaha ni Tensei Shita node Musume wo Shiawase ni Shimasu, Chikarazuku de. THE COMIC

195949.description:
Chiyo, who was offered as a sacrifice to the dragon god, wants to be eaten along with the poison that seals her godly powers in order to protect her younger brother. However, the dragon god, who everyone fears, decides to do the opposite of eating Chiyo. Instead, he dotes on her respectfully!? The story of the misunderstandings that occur between the strong, kind, and beautiful Ginrei and Chiyo, who works hard to improve herself so that she can be eaten, begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 生贄乙女の婚礼 龍神様に食べられたいのに溺愛されています。
title.romaji: Ikenie Otome no Konrei Ryuujin-sama ni Taberaretai no ni Dekiai sarete Imasu.

195950.description:
I'm supposed to be reading the air so I don't screw up,
I'm doing what everyone else is doing,
Why can't I get things done?

Rise Azumino, a university student, was lost in her life,
One day, guided by an invitation letter left behind by her late grandmother, she enters “Wonderland".
There she meets a girl named Alice and they begin their journey together.

Rise meets the White Rabbit, the Caterpillar, the Queen of Hearts, the Trumpeter, the Mad Hatter and the March Hare, Humpty Dumpty, the twins Tweedle Dum and Tweedle Dee, the Cheshire Cat and ......
The residents of Wonderland appear one after another in front of Rise!
And the crazy commotion that ensues!
What kind of future will Rise choose in this crazy adventure with Alice?

This adventure will surely bring a smile to your face tomorrow!

(Source: Official Site, Translated)

title.native: 不思議の国でアリスと -Dive in Wonderland-

195951.description:
A "poison consort" with access to all kinds of poison and a boy who is a "cross-dressing consort" solve the mystery lurking in the harem!

The time is the Great Tang Dynasty. A boy named Gyokuran, who entered the harem as a cross-dressing consort in place of his missing sister, meets the poison consort Dudu, who is said to have access to poisons from all over the world, past and present. The two of them must try to solve the mystery of the mysterious incidents that have been unfolding in the harem...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195952.description:
Rinrei, who has a plain face, transforms with makeup. Normally Rinrei is plain and quiet, but when she puts on makeup, her heart is brightened and she becomes a confident and beautiful woman. Rinrei loves cosmetics, and her love for them has led her to develop cosmetics herself, which become popular products in the capital. However, worried that this will cause her to miss her chance to get married, her father schemes to have her taken to the harem...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195954.description:
Living quietly in the depths of a quiet forest, Sheena, a reincarnated person who lost her family, and an old traveler who knows the world, are together. Sheena's magical powers have been strong since she was a child - so strong that they are called "curses". One day, a holy knight named Fel, who has been asked to defeat a witch, crosses Sheena's magical barrier and visits her. However, he is attacked by a forest beast, but is saved at the last moment by Sheena's overwhelming magic and..."Would you like to take me as your apprentice?"

A fantasy about a love journey that begins with an apprenticeship, woven by a reincarnated strongest magician who looks like a little girl and a carefree younger exiled holy knight.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Revia - A Journey Around the World

195955.description:
A war that took place in a tropical country, a jungle war. In this war, the Korean army sent troops to fight, and many soldiers were killed and died in battle. As time passed, the long war began to come to an end. Most of the soldiers returned to their homeland and adapted to society, but some were different. The soldiers who had adapted to the slaughter and became broken could not live in society. They gathered in a large building like the Kowloon Fortress on the outskirts of the city and lived relying on each other. Just as the war was ending. A monster of jungle warfare. Sergeant Kim of the 1st Platoon of the White Tiger Battalion. For some reason, he gathered his platoon members and raided the house of the company commander, Captain Seo. Sergeant Kim broke down the door and entered, and after a fierce battle with Captain Seo, he killed the captain. However, Captain Seo's son was hiding in the closet, and he could only watch his father being killed. Now, 20 years later, Sergeant Kim was reigning over the broken soldiers in the Kowloon Fortress. His platoon members were also soldiers who had been flying and crawling, so they each took a position as executives.

A world without war was empty and free to them. And then one day, Captain Seo’s son came to visit him in the closet. His goal was clear. To kill all the people who killed his father that day, and Sergeant Kim.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

195956.description:
All the people I love are dead. My parents... My master who taught me how to fight with a sword... And my friends who are still alive, and my past lovers.... I miss them. So even today, I pursue revenge in the pursuit of souls....

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195957.description:
This is a world ruled by eight million gods. One day, the shrine maiden Kagura Miyabi is led by a mysterious crow to a large tree.There she finds Yakumo, a beautiful white dragon god. As soon as he sees Miyabi, he tells her: "I've been waiting for you." After their fateful encounter, Miyabi and Yakumo set out on a journey to save all the gods in the country. What awaits them there?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195958.description:
Yu Mei is reincarnated into a Chinese-style parallel world with all her memories of her previous life as a nurse. She lived a poor life in the countryside, but when an opportunity to serve in the harem came up, she arrived full of hope, thinking, "I'll be able to experience the glittering yet muddy world I saw in Chinese dramas!" But when she arrived at the harem, certain rumors were flying around...

The new palace maid solves all the troubles, curses, and human relationships in the harem with her medical cheats!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195959.description:
Ma Baek, the best in the world and known as the best man in the world for a hundred years enters the world of martial arts. With Ma Baek's appearance, past grudges come flooding in.Death remains wherever Ma Baek passes, and Lee Gun-Ak, who pursues that death, faces a grudge of a hundred years.

The wheels of death and revenge begin to roll in the world of martial arts, the Four Seasons of the Forest.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195960.description:
Louis wakes up in a mysterious dungeon, where he meets Claude, who saves him from a monster, and realizes he's been transported to another world, the Tower of God, the setting of a popular otome game. The other transported person, Mayu, has a mark that proves she is the heroine. However, Louis has no mark and cannot use magic. In order to return to his original world, Louis accompanies Mayu as a burden mob character, despite being bullied by her. Meanwhile, as Louis connects with the capture targets, the mark of the heroine begins to appear on him──!?

Will he take the place of the heroine in the labyrinth dungeon?! A great reversal love fantasy begins.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Until I, a Supporting Character, Become a Heroine

title.native: 脇役の私がヒロインになるまで
title.romaji: Wakiyaku no Watashi ga Heroine ni Naru Made

195961.description:
As the son of an undertaker and a coffin seller, Gunak is pursued by the Geumgeomseong while searching for the secret story of the mysterious sect, the Galaxy Heavenly Palace. Gunak, who fell into the evil group Jijungcheon, meets the legendary Fantasy Martial Arts Immortal and is resurrected as the Ghost King to avenge his father and the four great sects. In the midst of a flurry of schemes and conspiracies, the Four Hegemons clash, and the righteous Ghost King who punishes evil is the afterlife!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

195962.description:
Omega and aspiring cop Hanwool has a big crush on Heejin, a sexy dominant alpha who regularly buys XL condoms at the convenience store where Hanwool works. But when Hanwool mistakenly orders 100 boxes of Heejin's go-to brand, the alpha agrees to buy them all on one condition—they use them together!

(Source: Manta)

195963.description:
Kaguya has spent her days being scorned and tortured as the "Demon Princess." Since she was a child, Kaguya has had a strange power. This power was supposed to be the power to exterminate the monsters and demonic shadows that shake the country, but no one understood her and she lived with pain in her heart. Then Gion Takakatsu, the commander of the "Black Kites" who exterminate demonic shadows, visits Kaguya and asks to enter into a temporary marriage...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

195964.description:
Erina, the only daughter of a huge merchant corporation, lost her voice completely after the shock of losing her mother, and her childhood friend Noel, whose growth has stopped due to a curse and who remains in the form of a boy. For 15 years, the two lived like a family, and Erina was only able to speak to Noel. One day, Erina, who believes in the superstition that "if you kiss a man of the opposite sex on the day before your 20th birthday, you will be happy for the rest of your life," kissed Noel, but the next day, Noel was in his adult form! This incident triggered Noel, who had originally had feelings for Erina, to grow even more obsessed with her...!

"I wish she would choose me instead of the other man..."

A status-disparity romance that begins with a kiss between a young lady who has never known true love and a secretary who can't stop doting on her!

(Source: Comico, translated)
synonyms: I Accidentally Raised My Childhood Friend to Be an Obsessive Man

title.native: 幼なじみを執着男に育ててしまいました
title.romaji: Osananajimi wo Shuuchaku Otoko ni Sodatete Shimaimashita

195968.description:
In this world, there exists a class of people who differ from humans in appearance and in special abilities. These humanoids are known as demipeople and have integrated into society, living and working just like humans. And for some people, the allure of demipeople is hard to ignore...

Mane-san is a demiperson known as an Abyssinian. Her dark skin and golden hair make her hard to overlook, and that's exactly why she's been hired as the newest maid at a lavish mansion. Though some may consider her suspicious and mysterious, everyone who works with and interacts with Mane-san winds up smitten with her! Could she be just what the master of the manor has been looking for?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter under the title "Kawatta Maid ga Atsumaru wo Yashiki no Hanashi", later licensed by Kadokawa under the current title for commercial release.
synonyms: 変わったメイドが集まるお屋敷の話
Kawatta Maid ga Atsumaru wo Yashiki no Hanashi
That girl I'm interested in is a maid from the abyss.

title.romaji: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko wa Shinen Maid

195969.description:
Former mixed martial arts champion Sasori has disappeared from the public eye. He has fallen so far that he has begun fixing matches in shady underground fighting events, but there is a reason behind this...!? Unheard of!! A truly "unconfirmed" martial arts manga begins!!

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

校内で一番可愛くて一番おっぱいがデカくて一番オカズにされてる一番スケベな江藤さん
title.romaji: Kounai de Ichiban Kawaikute Ichiban Oppai ga Dekakute Ichiban Okazu ni Sareteru Ichiban Sukebe na Etou-san

195975.description:
For fourteen years, Yi-Hyun Han has hidden her love for her childhood friend, Yu-Jin Jo. But when the two suddenly end up living together, Yi-Hyun is forced to confront her buried feelings for him — feelings that soon take a sensual turn. With Yu-Jin harboring sparks of his own, will their friendship finally ignite into romance?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ร่วมเตียงเคียงเธอ
Princess-nim, Please Take My Misfortune Away!

title.native: 彼女がセパレートをまとう理由― 女陸少女と中年おじさんのカンケイー
title.romaji: Kanojo ga Separate wo Matou Riyuu: Onna Riku Shoujo to Chuunen Oji-san no Kankei

195978.description:
Viviana Lorentz, the Duchess of House Fortuna, becomes utterly displeased with her far-too-rigid husband, Alto Fortuna, the duke who rarely entertains her at night. When she finally snaps and clashes with him, she ends up tumbling back in time, exactly a month before their destined marriage. Determined to escape the marriage this time, Viviana requests to call it off, only to be taken aback by Alto's firm refusal. As a final measure, Viviana decides to make a rather lustful "deal" with her current fiancé, not realizing she will end up facing his unexpected secret.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Secret of the Wolf Duke
ความลับของดยุกหมาป่า

195980.description:
Jarn comes to the capital to search for his missing aunt - and somehow ends up employed at the estate of the mysterious Duke Ordin. His job? Feeding the unidentified “monster” locked in the basement. Uh, sure. Things take a sharper turn when he accidentally sleeps with the Duke, and now Jarn’s juggling monster-sitting, sneaking around for clues about his aunt, and…discovering some very unexpected pleasures as a late-blooming virgin. Between horny dukes and basement creatures, Yarn’s hands are both metaphorically and physically full, and he has no idea what truths are waiting for him at the end of it all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.
synonyms: The Beast of Bahal Does Not Miss Its Prey
巴哈的野獸絕不放過獵物

title.english: The Beast of Bahal Never Misses its Prey

195981.description:
Do-Young witnesses her boyfriend of 10 years cheating. As she falls into despair, a younger, affectionate man named Ji-Hoo appears in front of her, and the two impulsively spend a night together...

"I will take good care of you from now on, Manager Min Do-Young."

The new employee who just joined the company is the man she spent the night with last night?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

195982.description:
In Caladrius, the prosperous capital of the peninsula, endless schemes unfold as noble houses vie for the throne. Many aristocrats use their mysterious abilities to tighten their grip on power, while others indulge in them for personal pleasure. Among them is Vicente, a royal with the power to seduce anyone he desires. He wields his gift recklessly, reveling in its excess...until he encounters a commoner who, despite his clumsy and naïve appearance, remains completely immune to Vicente’s allure. For Vicente, what begins as misfortune may soon become an entirely new beginning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

195983.description:
Hinata, who is an ordinary middle school girl from every angle, is the twin sister of the popular idol Hikari! In order not to disappoint Hikari's fans, Hinata has always kept her sister a secret and behaved in a low-key manner. One day, in order to save Hikari from a pinch, Hinata switches places with Hikari and jumps into a glittering world!! The hugely popular work from Aoitori Bunko has been made into a comic!!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

195984.description:
Breeding succubi is a matter of status and prestige among the rich men of society... One day, a poor man living in such a world... spending his miserable life without healing, or stimulation... just so happens to happen upon a small succubus in an alleyway! While she may be pathetic excuse for a succubus... a succubus, is a succubus! Surely he will nonetheless be able to have fun with her, he thinks, and takes her place to his place. However... much to his disbelief, she informs him that erotic stuff is off the table!! Utterly infuriated, the man shoves his dick deep inside her throat, and ravaging her mouth like a faphole, he cums inside! Then he slams his virgin dick down her tight little sluthole and fucks the succubus hard teaching her a lesson about the pleasures of a woman's body!! In order to transform the inept and inexperienced succubus into a full fledged perverted succubus, thus began one man's sexual discipline days filled with the finest fuck lessons around!

(Source: DLsite)

195990.description:
As a child, Yul opened the door to the village shrine, which was taboo, with the village children, and the monster that came out of the door killed the village children and disappeared, and Yul was driven out of the village. Years later, Yul returned to the village and faced the monster again, and Ji-Soo, the son of the village shaman, told Yul that only the person who opened the door to the shrine can close it again...

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: Useless moher, but i love her!

欲求不満が溜まって他の男のち〇ぽケースになってしまった奥さん
title.romaji: Yokkyuu Fuman ga Tamatte Hoka no Otoko no Chinpo Case ni Natteshimatta Oku-san

title.romaji: Mama de Bokki shita nara... Mama ni Makasenasai

title.native: みらいいろ〜アタラシイいろ〜

195996.description: "You're about to have sex with a man that you hate." Even though I don't want to, he keeps hitting my softest spots deep inside over and over again...! In order to repay her father's huge debt and to look after her little brother, Iroha had to resort to using a sugar daddy app. She thought that an honest and stable man was going to come, but instead it was Renya, a handsome man whose looks top those of a model...!? Iroha was bewildered, but she ended up spending the night with Renya who understood her situation and was going to put an end to her past. Though he spoke politely, the way he had sex was completely sadistic. On top of that, Renya was really a Yakuza. He told her he'd cancel her debt in exchange for becoming his girlfriend...!! The curtain raises on the battlefield of love!

title.english: A Dangerous Lover's Contract with a Perverted Yakuza - Suck Me to the Marrow

195997.description:
What happens when love becomes a competition between the most exceptional people on Earth?

In this outrageous romantic experiment, thirteen “high-spec” individuals, each a prodigy in their own right, are brought together for a reality show designed to produce the ultimate marriage. Genius scientists, elite strategists, and once-in-a-generation talents must navigate not only romance, but each other’s overwhelming egos and impossible expectations.

As alliances form and collapse, every interaction becomes a high-stakes psychological battle. Romance is no longer simple: every confession is calculated, every date a performance, and every rejection a public spectacle. But beneath the absurdity lies a deeper question: can people who excel at everything truly connect on a human level?

(Source: Titan Manga)
synonyms: High Spec Marriage: Love Reality Show with 13 Heroes

title.native: ハイスペ婚にもほどがある 13人の偉人たちとの恋愛リアリティーショー
title.romaji: High Spec Kon ni mo Hodo ga Aru: 13-nin no Ijin-tachi to no Renai Reality Show

title.native: 好きになったらダメ、なのに-わたしの家に転がり込んだ住所不定無職 ポチ-
title.romaji: Suki ni Nattara Dame, Nano ni: Watashi no Ie ni Korogarikonda Juushofutei Mushoku Pochi
